body.text: Choose reconstruction v5 (r0007) as the training reference. It passes all ten numerical checks, resolves the white blade turn with visible tip/root landmarks and a local contact refit, and preserves the clip’s physical sequence. The recorded white turn witness is frames 126–135: 47.7 degrees relative to the wrist, 12.1 degrees of wrist rotation, with 30.7 mm minimum clearance. The grasp forces remain unobservable. The chosen workflow will first establish feasible contact physics, then train one PPO network from random weights; the feasibility controller will not supply policy labels or weights.

simulator.contact: Complete model collision capsules and convex meshes. 4D hand and plug contacts with 1 mm glove margin, solver compliance and torsional friction. Plug friction and hand friction are separate per-trial draws.

geometry.frame_note: Origin at the polymer housing centre, +Z toward blade tips, +Y across the blade gap, +X completes a right-handed frame. A half turn about +Z is visually ambiguous when face markings are missing.
geometry.scale_source: White adapter 27 × 40 × 43 mm housing (TASK_CONFIG.md §3, corroborated by publicly measured Apple USB-C adapter analogue); the frame-0 plug rests on its +X-up broad face.
geometry.identity: Apple 18/20 W USB-C family or visually identical shell inferred from video frame 0 (one centered USB-C port, distinctive rounded rectangular housing): https://support.apple.com/en-us/120548

physics.dominant_material: rigid polymer housing, mounted electronics, and metallic flat blades

details.object_blades_modeled_as: two rigid boxes at the measured offsets, as in the deployment configuration

retarget.method: Object trajectory mapped to the fixed start and goal by d2s_reference. Reachable downward palm anchor with scaled measured relative wrist changes, station IK and clearance correction. Fingers kinematically fitted to MANO tips in the object frame.

reference.planned_reward: Use progress-indexed per-start object keypoints, blade orientation, and a reachable downward wrist envelope. The mapped MANO fingertip locations are soft evidence. The larger fingertip mismatch is carried as a tolerance and these fitted angles supply no training actions.

arm.kinematics: Published FK and warm-started eight-step weighted DLS from measured joints; capsule-column barrier, soft home pull, deployed clamps, palm jump trip and joint target speed bound at 100 Hz.
arm.response: Published multi-joint delay/lag and torque-dependent compliance. Arm articulation is kinematically driven between measured 100 Hz states while the hand and plug are dynamic. Actual net contact force and lever are accumulated at the articulated robot geoms for the 20 Nm halt.
arm.collision: Physical right arm against plug or table, or right arm/hand against parked left. Contacts at each tick use the complete model. Column is a continuous IK barrier.

hand.order: 20 published encoder entries, thumb to pinky with mcp1/mcp2/pip/dip for each.
hand.response: PD vendor gains ×30 and damping ×sqrt(30), 2 Hz at 100 Hz and a fractional delay, effort saturation from grip scale. Compliant joint stops calibrated to 0.005 rad overtravel at nominal full cap. Integrated free motor speeds use the model limits while action targets are not speed-clipped.
hand.encoder: Delayed actual joint states, 0.1 degree finger noise and published FK of delayed arm samples.

sensor.estimator: Default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with replayed per-seed draws, 100 Hz logged updates.
sensor.visibility: Surface points/normals from actual convex housing and blades, ray tests against linked capsules derived from the proper arm colliders and hand mesh hulls. The occlusion mask is approximate.

episode.termination: One of the station stops or an invalid policy action, otherwise exactly 600 steps.

validation.finger_blocked_departure: In the exact flat-table scenario the index mcp1 saturates during the initial block. The lateral mcp2 also saturates, allowing the glove to slide sideways while the wrist yields under contact. The fingertip moves along the tabletop and ultimately reaches the close target. The measured final mcp1 gap and capped sustained torque tests fail. No stop is invented. The full geometry exposes a different contact mode than the fixture assumption, and long training will require resolving this calibration discrepancy.

validation.kinematic_replay: Reference objects are prescribed for this check. Detailed mesh gaps and IK errors are in the replay metrics. The rendered comparison is an embodiment and reach audit.

body.text: r0010 models the full robot. Frozen task r0011 passed 64 of 64 startup checks, and feasibility r0012 has the identical evaluator. A 200-rollout nominal-start feasibility screen fitted six geometry waypoints along a thumb-to-finger housing pinch, then tested them under current limits. No qualifying lift was found. Case 78 had a brief opposed lift up to its first slip. Opposed encoders and housing position indicate a rolling or sliding loss at lift. I predict force-balanced pads centred on the same opposing section will extend the held window. The geometric controller is solely a feasibility witness and supplies no training actions.

body.text: I opened both r0014 failure montages. Both show the plug between thumb and opposing pads at 2.50 s, then briefly airborne below the hand at about 5.22 s as the fingers separate during the turn. Gate r0014 counted 26 of 32 lifts and no turn or placement. The gate reported 15 hardware violations and two torque halts. Replays of the halted seeds locate the largest torque during the empty-hand descent, at 7.79 s (-21.97 Nm) and 8.05 s (-38.97 Nm). Independent traces also show early mcp2 load at pickup and a later overrun in a wrong empty-hand deposit path. Enforce a measured grip before continuing to deposit, and maintain inward contact through the pivot using actual contact geometry. Variation across grip scale explains why the varied-start gate lifted more reliably than our nominal screen.

body.text: r0016 rejected the contact-guided candidate for a paired lift regression (64 vs 74 of 96), despite 11 qualifying turns and zero contact or limit stops and zero hardware violations. In its review, seed 428343384 drops by the right edge of the hand; seed 1222251698 reaches blades-up under the fingers but returns to the table on the pickup side. A separate local whole-palm and finger MPC test stands the plug in the goal in seed 48200 after a qualifying custom turn. It has a single 100 Hz hand-contact gap at 5.70 s and 23.6 degrees of passive relative rotation, above 20 degrees. That passive contribution is entirely during 3.58 to 3.88 s between lifting and the active turn. I am testing an earlier turn plus model-based constraints on every contact tick, using the same criteria and simulator. The physics audit found under 0.1 mm arm integration drift per substep and no motor-speed projection in the audited contact intervals.

Twenty-second fallback screening resolves the two finger-limit overruns on the paired starts, while the gate rejects the lift prediction because both candidates lift in 28/32. Keep screening in the next test and improve the turn and transport. The first concurrent transport search reaches the goal in an uninterrupted grip after a qualifying turn in the exact evaluator.

A v2 exact-CPU development trial completes lift, finger turn, carry and supported release on seed 48209. Concurrent wrist transport yields a contiguous 51.9 degree blade rotation relative to the wrist (2.6 degrees wrist motion), maximum 2.14 mm hand-object overlap across the full episode and 7.4 degrees global passive rotation. Final center is (0.46163, -0.06105, -0.29354) m with 0.006 degrees blade tilt and the required rest window. This is a local physical witness, with the registered 0.25 feasibility gate still outstanding. Trajectory outputs remain feasibility-only.

Auditing adjacent phalanx hull distances found a 19.15 mm modeled intersection between the middle and ring intermediate links at 3.84 s in the exact v2 witness r0027. The shipped model filters collisions between neighboring digits. I am testing physically plausible reenabled adjacent contacts, and will distinguish stage success under the frozen v2 model from credible physical feasibility. A no-slip, margin and rolling-friction sweep on the blocked-index fixture leaves that known departure unresolved.

body.text: r0029 adds neighboring distal and intermediate phalanx contacts. The full adjacent-contact witness passes all ordered criteria and the standard predicates, with 0.82 mm peak hand-to-plug overlap and zero adjacent hull overlap in the checked pairs. Enabling these contacts does not resolve the blocked-index flat-table departure. Preparing matched v3 evaluation files and testing transfer across multiple starts during the suite version interval. For the first PPO run after feasibility I plan to use the exact CPU simulation. A complete contact-rich dynamic replay passes the per-step contract monitor and agrees exactly with the independent pose-sensor replay. The exact monitored rollout ran about 77 policy steps per CPU-second under contemporaneous load. The optional stationary pregrasp start at (0.320, -0.415, -0.163) m passed 64/64 randomized no-contact ramp probes with 17.9 mm worst position lag and at least 98.6 percent visibility after the first hold. The curriculum state pool contains 432 physical poses and velocities from seven v3 starts, with no action labels.

The adjacent-contact preview completed 4/24 development trials. A wider bank plus refinement completed 2/16 independent local starts, with 8 lifts and 7 qualifying turns. The largest current loss on those starts is pickup. A 46-profile pickup check isolated better placements of the spare fingers and offset grasp centers. The first v3 gate candidate screens these alternative pickups only when its nominal plan misses the grasp, and it searches opening the fingers that actually bear load at contact.

body.text: Reviewed all four r0035 montages. Failure seeds 827644067 and 525093154 both approach the plug, then show it back on the table below an open hand at the 5.2 s frame. In 827644067 the housing is oblique beneath the grip near pickup. In 525093154 it remains nearly sideways near the original placement. Successful seeds 803679028 and 1997701800 visibly retain the upright plug through transport and release. The exact gate reports 28 lifts, 15 turns, 8 carries and 7 placements in 32 starts, with no hardware violations or stops. Test selecting the pivot start from sustained measured opposition rather than the copied time of each candidate motion. Keep every complete prospective rollout the incumbent already finds.

A timing-only comparison across seven local starts produced no new turns in the five difficult cases. I will align the first finger command to the attained grip and test several eligible pickup states. When a concurrent motion fails, the private simulator searches an opposed pivot first and carries only after that pivot qualifies. The wrapper retains an already complete incumbent trajectory verbatim and changes a partial trajectory only if it improves an ordered stage.

Prepared the exact v3 rollout backend while the feasibility gate runs. The eight physical witness starts now give 489 reset states and 233 survived six hold steps, with zero hardware or contract problems in all 489. This pool stores physical poses and velocities only. The capsule-visibility acceleration matched all logged states, fractions, and observations bit for bit for three 600-step v3 witnesses, reducing monitored replay time by 18.6–25.0%. The NumPy station self-test uses a geometric finger block; its 0.531 rad final index value at full current differs from the simulated mesh contact, which later slides. Varying substep arm inertia, contact damping, and effective hand motor gains across 118 configurations did not produce a sustained blocked finger while retaining the torque halt check. The frozen v3 evaluator is unchanged.

Exact local seed 48214 now completes after a grip-sensitive pickup and continuous set-down. In its first upright set-down, the 100 Hz trace lost pad contact at 5.73 s, 5.8 mm over the table, before recovering contact. Scoring the first held-to-supported transition and trying small inward pad adjustments found a full 20 s legal replay ending at (0.4082, -0.0576, -0.2935) m with 1.2 degrees global passive rotation. This is development evidence only. I also verified a nearer package start (0.354, -0.402, -0.214) m. All 128 ramps passed clearance and reach checks, and a separate 64-start sensor replay had all first and initial holding observations valid with no stops, hardware violations or contract problems.

Nine open-loop sensor replays of three physically valid witness trajectories expose an observability gap during the turn. The exact trial sensor is often invalid for more than a second after the opposed lift and can remain stale during early transport. The latest pose, age and encoder history can flag a likely in-hand motion but do not reveal whether an occluded plug slipped. I will use a fixed multi-rate observation history spanning about two seconds for the first PPO policy, initialized from the measured first observation. The actor will receive no time input, force, contact or simulator state.

Once the official feasibility standing passes, the first PPO experiment will use the closer verified start and the exact monitored CPU simulator. Each action will come from one random-initialized network with a fixed multi-rate encoder and object-estimate history. Start with a balanced mix of restored physical phases and full deployment starts. Reward signed stage progress, small demonstration keypoint and reachable wrist errors inside tolerance bands, and one-time bonuses for qualifying ordered effects. Check hold, random and physically productive replays first. The first standalone experiment is limited to 25 minutes because the blocked-index fixture remains unresolved. Expect a rising opposed-lift rate before evidence of linked turns. At 15 minutes, stop this branch if a deterministic full-start probe finds no lift and the approach and lift curves have plateaued. Use the fixed 64-start evaluation and gate evidence to choose any later method change.

body.text: Reviewed both failure and both success montages of r0042. Seeds 798810962 and 1179805818 have the plug held near the pickup at 2.58 s and out of the grip by 5.22 s. The endpoint measures confirm sideways plugs at y approximately -0.37 m. Successful seeds 11899618 and 357368263 show the plug upright near the goal at 5.22 s and the fingers clear by 7.9 s. On the paired starts the adaptive search kept every r0035 completion and added three continuous carries and full placements, with the identical 16 qualifying turns. The gate rejected the turn hypothesis. I will test a completion hypothesis with the existing safe plans preserved and a fallback that checks continuous pad contact through the first supported landing, plus pickups fitted for lower grip. Paired development results are 4/14 versus 3/14, zero stops or hardware violations in either set, with the new completion on a development witness.

The r0042 post-mortem shows that the 11 failed turns had a median 18.2 degree relative rotation and occur across the grip-strength range. A narrow pad-IK continuation generated no qualifying carry on its seven trials. Expanding the pickup search produced a distinct local motion on seed 59023522 with continuously supported touchdown, 7.9 degrees passive rotation and a complete 20-second replay under the frozen checks. This confirms one more feasible development start, while the official proof remains pending. The exact monitored CPU backend sustained 970 simulated policy steps per second at 32 workers on repeated contact-rich replays, with zero contract or hardware problems in the benchmark.

body.text: r0048 accepted the previous completion-focused controller in the v3 suite, with seven completions versus two on the paired fresh starts and zero hardware violations in either set. In the viewed failures, seeds 1632377754 and 723223298 hold near pickup at 2.58 s, then leave the plug sideways and clear of the hand by 5.22 s. Successes 214714935 and 558010601 show the upright carry and clear set-down. The matched v4 baseline is evaluating a broader set of measured-grip profiles and staged lowering. In an independent actuator diagnostic, the prescribed-position substeps still apply the MJCF arm damping toward zero velocity. The index mcp2 overshot with opposing torque and no hand contact. Turning off that extra damping removed joint violations in 12 random trials but changed all three archived complete grasp trajectories, so this remains a model calibration hypothesis. The frozen v4 evaluator is used for the pending proof.

Two settings of fixed command smoothing produced 24/24 full random stress episodes without a stop, hardware violation or contract problem in v4. The tighter tested rates were 6 mm palm position, 0.013–0.015 rad palm rotation and 0.030–0.032 rad finger-target change per 30 Hz step. The planned pilot uses these as a generic action parameterization. A velocity-referenced internal arm servo removed the free-motion mcp2 overruns in an independent 12-episode test, while contact torque stops remained visible. Its local 14-start preflight with the v4 motion library found no qualifying lifts, so that model needs its own grasp calibration before it can support training. Simulation v4 retains the documented short-run restriction.

A batched airborne search rescued five of six development starts selected because the previous controller did not complete them. Every recovered proposal was replayed through 600 policy steps in the exact evaluator, with all criteria met, zero stops and zero hardware violations. Peak hand–plug overlap across the five was 1.21 mm. I will require a fixed completed search budget for a gate candidate because some parallel prototype searches timed out after writing partial results. The physical reset pool now has 2,048 checked poses and velocities from the expanded witness set, grouped by phase with no action labels. I expect the GPU search to improve feasibility completions on a fresh gate.

The v4 placement witness commanded palm z down to −0.2552 m, below the first action-envelope floor of −0.237 m. A deeper measured-relative decoder stress test uses a −0.260 m floor, position radius 35 mm, rotation radius 0.095 rad, finger radius 0.22 rad, 0.035 rad finger-limit margin and per-call bounds 7 mm, 0.015 rad and 0.032 rad, with the earlier causal smoothing. All 24 randomized full episodes, including 12 with correlated commands, completed with no hardware, stop or contract problems. The pilot will use this envelope and evaluate the effect of its limited squeeze. The earlier reconstructed palm guide sits approximately 90 mm above the physically successful enclosure on this embodiment, so the guide receives a 100 mm deadband in pickup. Two-sided fingertip-to-housing distance will supply the nearer geometric approach signal. Those distances are computed in the reward from movable meshes. The actor receives contract observations and their history only. Recorded physical demonstration-phase resets supply positions and velocities only.

The PPO reward preflight gives zero return to all three still commands after removing credit for the measured ramp lag. Three bounded random trials score −0.69 to −0.13 and complete no stage. Three full feasibility witness traces score 34.36 to 35.67 and trigger all six progress events. The reward uses 100 Hz opposed contact during the turn so a 30 Hz sample does not miss the brief endpoint. The first short run will test exact CPU dynamics with a 32-way reset mix and 25 minute cap. Its policy receives eight pose/proprioception samples spanning 2.1 s and invariant housing axes. The critic can use true physical state. The outer pose sensor or motion history can hide short transitions, so the first deterministic 64-start checkpoint will report the complete lift/turn/carry/placement funnel.

body.text: Gate r0054 establishes task feasibility in v4 on 8 of 32 fresh starts with zero hardware violations and no predicate overrides. I reviewed both failure and both success montages. In 58977685 and 222848822, the hand is around the housing at 2.50 s, and the object is on the table under the open hand by 5.22 s. The successful seeds 1323408003 and 1571676659 still have opposed air contact at 5.22 s and show a standing plug beneath the released hand by 7.90 s. Eighteen trials first fail at the finger turn, two at placement and four at lift. The first trained baseline uses a stronger reward on correctly directed relative turning while the plug remains opposed and unsupported, and resets from physically stable samples spanning that transition.

reward_terms.name: release

reward_terms.name: placed

reward_terms.name: reference_object

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers

reward_terms.name: slip

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure

body.text: The PPO baseline is r0057, paired with iteration r0056 and package SHA a44fa6a0118e…. Both official failure montages, 1367139607 and 1506359875, show the palm drifting away from the grounded plug by 2.50 s. Fingers change posture in free space and no enclosure develops throughout the clips. All 64 trials ran without hardware violations or stops, 22 pass the final hand-rest check, and sandbox act p99 is 0.529 ms. I delivered it as the first incumbent at 07:28:06 UTC to obtain early target evidence. The six-minute checkpoint also has no lift and loses the rest check on all 64 fixed starts. The first three full-witness command projections give one lift under the pilot envelope and three under the wider position/finger envelope, with no turn in either, which motivates measuring command authority after the target replay.

The continuous-impedance simulator preview passes all published station thresholds. Its blocked finger retains 0.346 rad of command error and full effort without a violation, and the published drift warning reports 0.076 rad over two seconds. Applying three old exact full plans gives three lifts and no turns. New batched physics proposals with the continuous arm produce exact qualifying turns for grip scales 0.34, 0.62 and 0.90. Further exact replays carry each upright into the goal with zero unsupported contact gaps. This preview is separate from the delivered v4 baseline. In the tested v4 baseline, removing previous-target smoothing gives six hardware violations on 16 paired local starts versus zero with smoothing, so the next envelope should retain causal rate bounds while allowing stronger sustained squeeze.

The first PPO branch met its predeclared stop condition at 15 minutes. Zero qualifying lifts appeared across the fixed 64-start evaluations at two, six and twelve minutes, and no full-start lift appeared in the training funnel through 936,960 steps. The mean enclosure reward and lift progress stayed within a few ten-thousandths per step while KL stayed around 0.03. More time on this branch would mostly repeat failures. The early deliverable remains r0057, and its first target round is pending. The next training experiment will be determined after the full target judgment and replay, with separate attention to consequential approach potential, physical model contact safety, and finger command authority.

body.reflection: The branch stopped on the predeclared plateau criterion. It produced no qualifying lift in any of four deterministic local checkpoint evaluations. The first recorded baseline went to the target. Later checkpoints move away from the small command region and have worse terminal rest. body.text: The continuous-impedance preview now has three full exact witnesses, with opposed relative blade turns of 87.88°, 46.63° and 48.87° and final blade tilt about 0.006°. The separate five-template physical search completes 11 of its 16 local evaluation starts including seven of twelve held-out starts, with no stops or violations. Full sensor-enabled replays of the three construction witnesses agree bit for bit under both visibility implementations and satisfy contract monitoring. The default supported start passes all 64 local checks. The nearer optional ramp moves the hand during setup as expected, with stable supported objects and no hardware failures. In the wider random-action stress there were seven stops and three violations; a work-volume variant gives two stops and zero violations on 18. The two stops have exact Link7–table and pinky–table contacts. A checked v5 reset pool has 1,450 physical samples across all five phases and no action labels.

body.next: Replay all eight station command streams in version 4. Use the replay to separate early drift from pose estimation or controller mismatch, then strengthen the signed approach and opposed-enclosure reward and check a nearer supported start under the calibrated dynamics.

body.observation_mismatch: All 4,800 target pose samples are valid. All eight v4 replays start at the exact t=0 estimated position and orientation from the station log, with no occlusion. Target-to-true simulated object center RMSE is 0.933 to 1.409 mm by trial, while independent replay sensor estimates differ by 1.148 to 1.568 mm RMSE. Median across trials of the median and 95th percentile pose age is 43.3/53.3 ms in the target and 56.9/62.2 ms in replay. No trial crosses 20 mm object-center difference. Tilt comparison is also reported along the blade axis to respect the estimator's 180° flip symmetry.
body.dynamics_mismatch: The v4 open-loop replays use all 600 sent commands and the original package ramp. Wrist position RMSE is 0.629 to 0.654 mm and finger encoder RMSE is 0.067 to 0.074 rad. All eight target trials and all eight replays show a grounded plug and no torque spike or stop. The selected start is nominal for unknown contact properties. This round provides no grasp or contact dynamics evidence.
body.changes: Record the baseline motion retreat as a learned approach failure. Split the ramp deadband from a signed loss that penalizes withdrawal beyond it, give one-time credit for physical opposed enclosure, and test a closer pregrasp pose with full task-start support. Benchmark the continuous-impedance dynamics against this replay and the published blocked-finger test before adopting them. Keep both v3 contract rate limits and closed-loop safety checks.

body.text: After r0063 and r0064, I compared the full eight target command streams under both arm models and under shorter hand delay and lower grip. Median wrist error is 0.637 mm in v4 and 0.655 mm in the continuous model. Median finger encoder error is 0.071 and 0.072 rad, respectively. Neither the tested shorter delay nor lower grip improves encoder fit, and no trial contains hand–plug contact to identify the contact parameters. The approach retreat reproduces under each model. I am adopting continuous impedance for its independent station calibration and verified in-hand physics, with prior grip and delay ranges and the standard sensor retained for the next training experiment. Local continuous-model feasibility is 24/32 on a second, entirely fresh set, with zero violations and stops.

simulator.name: MuJoCo
simulator.contact: Complete model collision capsules and convex meshes. 4D hand and plug contacts with 1 mm glove margin, solver compliance and torsional friction. Plug friction and hand friction are separate per-trial draws.

adjacent_digit_contacts.geometry: Full finger link convex hulls from the supplied complete robot.
adjacent_digit_contacts.enabled_pairs: All four pairings of links 3 and 4 between each adjacent pair of non-thumb digits.
adjacent_digit_contacts.rest_of_pair_filter: The supplied model pair exclusions are retained at the hinges and proximal phalanges.

simulator.arm_plant: MuJoCo physical joint inertia and contacts integrated at 2 ms, reported at controller rate of 100 Hz. Active impedance with published K and D, as defined in hardware/ARM.md. Bias compensation applies to the arm actuators only.

geometry.frame_note: Origin at the polymer housing centre, +Z toward blade tips, +Y across the blade gap, +X completes a right-handed frame. A half turn about +Z is visually ambiguous when face markings are missing.
geometry.scale_source: White adapter 27 × 40 × 43 mm housing (TASK_CONFIG.md §3, corroborated by publicly measured Apple USB-C adapter analogue); the frame-0 plug rests on its +X-up broad face.
geometry.identity: Apple 18/20 W USB-C family or visually identical shell inferred from video frame 0 (one centered USB-C port, distinctive rounded rectangular housing): https://support.apple.com/en-us/120548

physics.dominant_material: rigid polymer housing, mounted electronics, and metallic flat blades

details.object_blades_modeled_as: two rigid boxes at the measured offsets, as in the deployment configuration
details.contact_calibration_evidence: r0016 measured deep finger penetration. An independent local replay reached 14.48 mm during carry in simulation version 1.

adjacent_finger_contacts.geometry: Full finger link convex hulls from the supplied complete robot.
adjacent_finger_contacts.enabled_pairs: All four pairings of links 3 and 4 between each adjacent pair of non-thumb digits.
adjacent_finger_contacts.rest_of_pair_filter: The supplied model pair exclusions are retained at the hinges and proximal phalanges.

retarget.method: Object trajectory mapped to the fixed start and goal by d2s_reference. Reachable downward palm anchor with scaled measured relative wrist changes, station IK and clearance correction. Fingers kinematically fitted to MANO tips in the object frame.

reference.planned_reward: Use progress-indexed per-start object keypoints, blade orientation, and a reachable downward wrist envelope. The mapped MANO fingertip locations are soft evidence. The larger fingertip mismatch is carried as a tolerance and these fitted angles supply no training actions.

arm.delay_and_lag: Unchanged published delay/lag by joint; interpolated to 2 ms.
arm.controller: K(q_ref−q) + D(dq_ref−dq) plus arm bias force compensation.
arm.stops: Capsule/environment or parked-arm contact at 100 Hz and instantaneous J^T W over 20 N m. Finger limits and speed limits at physical substeps.

hand.order: 20 published encoder entries, thumb to pinky with mcp1/mcp2/pip/dip for each.
hand.response: PD vendor gains ×30 and damping ×sqrt(30), 2 Hz at 100 Hz and a fractional delay, effort saturation from grip scale. Compliant joint stops calibrated to 0.005 rad overtravel at nominal full cap. Integrated free motor speeds use the model limits while action targets are not speed-clipped.
hand.encoder: Delayed actual joint states, 0.1 degree finger noise and published FK of delayed arm samples.

sensor.estimator: Default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with replayed per-seed draws, 100 Hz logged updates.
sensor.visibility: Surface points/normals from actual convex housing and blades, ray tests against linked capsules derived from the proper arm colliders and hand mesh hulls. The occlusion mask is approximate.

initial.ramp: 1.5 seconds from published reset with quarter-open hand, safe above the table.
initial.object: U over x=0.48±0.01 m, y=−0.36±0.01 m and yaw=−90±10°, +X up and supported on the table. All independent.
initial.randomisation: Independent uniform grip 0.25 to 1, mass multiplier 0.85 to 1.15, plug/table sliding friction 0.27 to 0.47, hand sliding friction 0.64 to 1.13, arm delay ±10 ms, finger delay 17 to 40 ms and table bounds within the section 2 fits.

episode.termination: One of the station stops or an invalid policy action, otherwise exactly 600 steps.

validation.finger_blocked_departure: All mandatory thresholds pass. The fixture retains a 0.346 rad target gap and full mcp1 torque, with the stationary drift warning at 0.0756 rad over two seconds. The controller holds with no stop or limit violation in this fixture.
validation.reach: The IK scan evaluates continuous paths from arm reset to the approach and between the start and goal. It uses capsule and table clearance and the published joint box.
validation.local_contract: Arm and hand command processing and v3 sensor processing use the same measured station chain. The new task suite rechecks the supported start on fresh seeds.

kinematic_replay.method: Object trajectory mapped to the fixed start and goal by d2s_reference. Reachable downward palm anchor with scaled measured relative wrist changes, station IK and clearance correction. Fingers kinematically fitted to MANO tips in the object frame. A kinematic correction adjusts the finger pose to respect the enabled neighboring phalanges.

calibration_replay.note: The same sent actions from the old controlled trial were replayed from the same supported start. This is a contact calibration test. The old actions require adaptation under the stiffer model.

revision.reason: The v4 prescribed arm substeps caused non-contact lateral finger excursions under exploratory commands, and the flat-table blocked-index fixture lost sustained torque. In the first stochastic PPO pilot 1,268 of 2,389 training episodes had a violation. The revised physical model keeps the calibrated command lag, solves the assembled arm dynamics continuously and retests the force and limit behavior against the station scenarios.
revision.change: Integrate the full assembled arm jointly with finger and object contacts. Apply the public stiffness and damping against the interpolated delayed 100 Hz position reference. Include its velocity reference and apply only arm generalized bias compensation. Take the unfiltered external contact torque from the actual controller tick and run the published stops.

body.warning: suite task_feasibility version 4's incumbent r0054 meets its pass rate (success 8/32 = 0.250 >= 0.25). Version 5 starts over: its first gate is a new baseline, and the suite loses its standing until version 5's incumbent meets its pass rate (another suite of the link that meets its own still counts). Tightening your own criteria resets what you have proven; do it only for a reason the demonstration or the task gives, and say it in --reason (demo2sim/VERIFICATION.md section 3).

body.text: The next PPO profile is allocated 80 minutes of exact continuous-arm rollouts after matched feasibility. The stop test is no qualifying lift in the fresh 64-start checkpoint by 16 minutes together with flat signed enclosure and lift-progress curves. Three still checks return zero, three bounded random checks return −5.94 to −3.08, and three complete exact witnesses return 50.7 to 52.0. The closer package ramp clears all 96 starts and reduces the upper-tail pad gap by 35%. The actor receives eight causal stacks including latest-target encoder residual, and the PPO update normalizes advantages by reset mode. In target replay the largest encoder residual concentrates in middle and ring mcp2. Applying the target encoders to the published mesh yields 14.9–15.7 mm implied link overlap from about 0.6 s, while the matched simulator keeps those links at least 1.88 mm apart. This is a geometry/contact-model mismatch from empty-hand motion. Keep adjacent contacts to teach physically realizable grasps and reassess compliance only when a target run enters the manipulation.

body.observed: The r0057 policy montages show the hand withdrawing before opposed grasp. R0054 provides the previous feasibility witness, and its two failure montages lose their grasp near the turn before 5.22 s.

simulator.name: MuJoCo
simulator.contact: Complete model collision capsules and convex meshes. 4D hand and plug contacts with 1 mm glove margin, solver compliance and torsional friction. Plug friction and hand friction are separate per-trial draws.

adjacent_digit_contacts.geometry: Full finger link convex hulls from the supplied complete robot.
adjacent_digit_contacts.enabled_pairs: All four pairings of links 3 and 4 between each adjacent pair of non-thumb digits.
adjacent_digit_contacts.rest_of_pair_filter: The supplied model pair exclusions are retained at the hinges and proximal phalanges.

simulator.arm_plant: MuJoCo physical joint inertia and contacts integrated at 2 ms, reported at controller rate of 100 Hz. Active impedance with published K and D, as defined in hardware/ARM.md. Bias compensation applies to the arm actuators only.

geometry.frame_note: Origin at the polymer housing centre, +Z toward blade tips, +Y across the blade gap, +X completes a right-handed frame. A half turn about +Z is visually ambiguous when face markings are missing.
geometry.scale_source: White adapter 27 × 40 × 43 mm housing (TASK_CONFIG.md §3, corroborated by publicly measured Apple USB-C adapter analogue); the frame-0 plug rests on its +X-up broad face.
geometry.identity: Apple 18/20 W USB-C family or visually identical shell inferred from video frame 0 (one centered USB-C port, distinctive rounded rectangular housing): https://support.apple.com/en-us/120548

physics.dominant_material: rigid polymer housing, mounted electronics, and metallic flat blades

details.object_blades_modeled_as: two rigid boxes at the measured offsets, as in the deployment configuration
details.contact_calibration_evidence: r0016 measured deep finger penetration. An independent local replay reached 14.48 mm during carry in simulation version 1.

adjacent_finger_contacts.geometry: Full finger link convex hulls from the supplied complete robot.
adjacent_finger_contacts.enabled_pairs: All four pairings of links 3 and 4 between each adjacent pair of non-thumb digits.
adjacent_finger_contacts.rest_of_pair_filter: The supplied model pair exclusions are retained at the hinges and proximal phalanges.

retarget.method: Object trajectory mapped to the fixed start and goal by d2s_reference. Reachable downward palm anchor with scaled measured relative wrist changes, station IK and clearance correction. Fingers kinematically fitted to MANO tips in the object frame.

reference.planned_reward: Use progress-indexed per-start object keypoints, blade orientation, and a reachable downward wrist envelope. The mapped MANO fingertip locations are soft evidence. The larger fingertip mismatch is carried as a tolerance and these fitted angles supply no training actions.

arm.delay_and_lag: Unchanged published delay/lag by joint; interpolated to 2 ms.
arm.controller: K(q_ref−q) + D(dq_ref−dq) plus arm bias force compensation.
arm.stops: Capsule/environment or parked-arm contact at 100 Hz and instantaneous J^T W over 20 N m. Finger limits and speed limits at physical substeps.

hand.order: 20 published encoder entries, thumb to pinky with mcp1/mcp2/pip/dip for each.
hand.response: PD vendor gains ×30 and damping ×sqrt(30), 2 Hz at 100 Hz and a fractional delay, effort saturation from grip scale. Compliant joint stops calibrated to 0.005 rad overtravel at nominal full cap. Integrated free motor speeds use the model limits while action targets are not speed-clipped.
hand.encoder: Delayed actual joint states, 0.1 degree finger noise and published FK of delayed arm samples.

sensor.estimator: Default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with replayed per-seed draws, 100 Hz logged updates.
sensor.visibility: Surface points/normals from actual convex housing and blades, ray tests against linked capsules derived from the proper arm colliders and hand mesh hulls. The occlusion mask is approximate.

initial.ramp: 1.5 seconds from published reset with quarter-open hand, safe above the table.
initial.object: U over x=0.48±0.01 m, y=−0.36±0.01 m and yaw=−90±10°, +X up and supported on the table. All independent.
initial.randomisation: Independent uniform grip 0.25 to 1, mass multiplier 0.85 to 1.15, plug/table sliding friction 0.27 to 0.47, hand sliding friction 0.64 to 1.13, arm delay ±10 ms, finger delay 17 to 40 ms and table bounds within the section 2 fits.

episode.termination: One of the station stops or an invalid policy action, otherwise exactly 600 steps.

validation.finger_blocked_departure: All mandatory thresholds pass. The fixture retains a 0.346 rad target gap and full mcp1 torque, with the stationary drift warning at 0.0756 rad over two seconds. The controller holds with no stop or limit violation in this fixture.
validation.reach: The IK scan evaluates continuous paths from arm reset to the approach and between the start and goal. It uses capsule and table clearance and the published joint box.
validation.local_contract: Arm and hand command processing and v3 sensor processing use the same measured station chain. The new task suite rechecks the supported start on fresh seeds.

kinematic_replay.method: Object trajectory mapped to the fixed start and goal by d2s_reference. A kinematic correction adjusts the finger pose to respect the enabled neighboring phalanges.

body.text: Gate r0070 proves continuous-impedance task feasibility at 22 of 32 with zero hardware violations and zero stops. The gate renderer failed after the reproducible evaluation because its World constructor rejected the preloaded model. I recreated all four selected review rollouts under the exact physical evaluator. Both failures hold the start fallback after the search finds no complete safe sequence. Both successes grasp near 2.38 s, hold the plug in the air by 4.98 s, and leave it upright by 10.18 s. The constructor repair in r0071 preserves every array on three 600-call parity runs and produces all three videos. The suite service enforces a 60-minute revision interval. Keep evaluating against active v5 in the interim and reconstruct local review footage when the gate cannot render. The neural training script began after official feasibility and uses the v5 plant.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin.
body.hypothesis: Signed enclosure shaping, a closer ramp-cleared start and target encoder residuals under continuous dynamics should produce legal opposed lifts from deployment starts.
body.reflection: All 64 fixed starts make hand–plug contact and 1 of 64 completes the lift stage. `None` completes the turn, carry or placement. Compared with the early checkpoint, the hand encounters the plug with a qualifying end of the enclosure in more starts. The task gate and next target round will measure transfer while the PPO curve is still improving.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed unsupported clearance, capped at 45 mm.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed angular progress on both world blade tilt and relative blade rotation under opposed air contact, with credit restricted to active finger windows.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Loss of unsupported contact more than 8 mm off the surface after an opposed lift.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for physical thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more while the plug is supported and remains within 20 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Signed increase in pre-lift tabletop object travel beyond 3 mm, in units of 30 mm.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

body.text: Task baseline r0074 repeats one qualifying lift on 64 fresh starts, with zero stops and hardware violations, 40 final hand-rest passes, and a 0.287 ms sandbox p99. It was delivered as s02. I viewed both gate-selected failed starts using a local rerender with independent standard sensor draws because the frozen gate renderer still fails. In 1475831798 and 471888336 the fingers make contact at about 0.30 and 0.27 s, the plug shifts 41 and 44 mm along the table, and clearance stays below 0.2 mm before the palm retreats. Removing the encoder-target residual features at the same weights raises local lifts from one to two of 64, with no stops or violations in either group. This small unpaired stage-count difference does not establish a feature advantage. The training funnel has several stochastic lifts and partial reward improvement, so the scheduled PPO run continues while the target round measures whether the sliding and contact repeat.

Correction to r0075. The encoder-target residual ablation is paired on the same 64 starts and sensor draws. The ablation lifts on seeds 353604967 and 1249815122, while the original lifts on seed 335814359. Two gains and one loss leave the direction unresolved.

body.text: Checkpoint 0351 improved fixed-start lift to 16/64 with unchanged training. Its first clearance-and-rise interval starts near 1.27 s on the 16 lift cases and stays continuously opposed for a median 0.28 s after that row. The thumb is the first or tied lost contact in 12 of 16. Seven losses occur while the plug was visible throughout the interval. The selected local non-lift and lift replays let the existing reward pay +0.699 and +0.126 for grounded pushes, +7.349 for a lift followed by loss, and +50.705 for the complete witness. A turn potential can also retain its partial credit when opposition breaks. After the pending target judgment and replay, these observations support testing a signed held-state potential that reverses on loss and a terminal rest curriculum, while leaving the current 80-minute PPO run and fresh paired lift gate unchanged. Profiling identifies the CPU station IK as the largest cost. A standalone compiled DLS diagnostic agrees within 1.33e-15 rad over 600 input states, with 25x faster isolated IK; three full replays match all four stage decisions and increase end-to-end rate by 1.13–1.48x, with up to 7.47 mm object component difference. Keep the frozen plant and its exact logs as the authority.

Measured reconstruction contact guidance before assigning weight. The fitted distal thumb passes along one housing side between the lift and turn, with a roughly 27 mm displacement of the inferred local contact center. Projected against three complete v5 robot witnesses under both object symmetries, median thumb position error is 13 mm during lift, 28 mm during turn and 43 mm during carry. The nearest opponent median residual is 21, 17 and 12 mm. Such tighter contact guidance would penalize complete robot executions, so the training reward retains tolerant wrist and hand tracking plus measured object and opposition effects. Clarification of r0078: eight checkpoint 0351 losses had a fully valid pose history in the interval. Seven of those eight involved loss of thumb contact.

body.observation_mismatch: All eight replays use the station estimator pose on its first valid row at t=0, the original package start and the complete sent action history. The target keeps all 4,800 estimates valid. The independent v5 sensor stays fully valid in six replays and loses tracking for parts of trials 5 and 6, which remain 91.5% and 92.8% valid. Target median pose age is 43.3 ms in every trial. The v5 per-trial medians range from 43.5 to 73.1 ms. Estimated center RMSE on jointly valid rows is 3.6 to 35.0 mm. The simulated standard pose estimator is unchanged in this replay. Post-ramp measurements are aligned at t=0 for the recorded residual.
body.dynamics_mismatch: All eight target trials and v5 replays have physical signs of contact and finish with a sideways plug outside the goal. The simulated maximum bottom clearance ranges from 0.007 to 3.97 mm, so no simulated lift qualifies. Simulated first fingertip contact occurs at 0.26 to 0.60 s. Simulated planar travel ranges from 22.6 to 46.9 mm, versus 19.5 to 47.8 mm from the visible target estimates. The target ends on the narrower housing side in trials 0, 5 and 6. The replay does so in 0, 5 and 7. Wrist RMSE is 0.73 to 1.02 mm and finger encoder RMSE is 0.063 to 0.095 rad. Peak v5 torque estimate is 7.79 to 9.04 Nm at t=0.10 s, earlier than plug contact; peak target estimate is 2.10 to 2.41 Nm. No trial stops in either setting.
body.changes: The latest round provides grounded contact evidence and confirms that the early learned checkpoint fails the same lift stage in both worlds. Compare the per-contact torque contributions in v5 and test plausible friction, grip and hand-response settings in offline replays before making a plant change. Measure the fit in terms of support face, grounded displacement and stops as well as trajectory residual. Preserve physical adjacent-digit collision. The task suite and recorded criterion remain frozen.

Keep watching the existing 80 minute run and the pending paired gate before keeping a new package.

body.text: r0083 compared 192 fresh starts, with 43 lifts versus incumbent 8 and no finger turns. It rejected checkpoint 0351 on one finger-limit violation. I reviewed both gate-selected seeds using the repaired renderer and independent standard sensor draws. In 31071524 the fingertips engage by 0.09 s and drive the plug about 56 mm across the support, with under 0.05 mm clearance. In 289604245 the thumb opposes the other digits by 0.74 s and briefly moves the plug above 10 mm at 1.36–1.42 s before losing it. The recorded violating seed 1627933726 reproduces in all 48 independent sensor draws: its thumb distal pad loads the table at 0.10 s, driving the thumb proximal interphalangeal encoder to about −0.321 rad despite a target near −0.162 rad. The actor is already commanding up, so clipping its lower finger target cannot explain the fault. Test higher contract start poses by 6, 10 and 14 mm with the same actor and nominal action bounds. Predict a zero-violation lift gain over the incumbent if the smallest safe change retains the early approach. Keep the ongoing PPO run unchanged. A separately preflighted reward for retained opposition and rest is planned after the allocated branch.

The [redacted] sweep uses 14 physically plausible actuator and friction settings over all eight sent histories. The nominal replay matches six of eight final support faces. A 10 ms finger delay reduces median 7 s center RMSE from 14.0 to 10.1 mm at the same face count. Lower glove friction to 0.50 reduces median replay torque peak from 8.65 to 3.96 Nm but matches only five support faces and raises center RMSE to 16.9 mm. No setting fits the measured encoder, face and torque signals together. The nominal peak is a 17–20 N aggregate thumb-pad load against the tabletop at 0.10 s, before plug contact. Keep the frozen task suite and physical adjacent fingers. The published delay range of 10–45 ms and friction near 0.50 are candidates for a broader training draw once a reward-only comparison is available. The proposed retention reward preflight makes the two grounded pushes negative (−1.19 and −1.94), gives 2.71–3.42 to lifted drops and 54.68–55.05 to the three complete witnesses. Resting earns no positive return. All three complete witnesses still receive each ordered bonus.

body.text: The 50-minute PPO actor in r0088 makes 35/64 fixed-start lifts and 51 rest passes. Its five failures are thumb PIP lower excursions at 0.10–0.12 s before touching the plug. A 6 mm increase fixes these five starts in the short screen but the full reassessment finds a new early thumb PIP event and a later free measured thumb DIP peak of 1.4203 rad, with a 1.3588 rad target. Visual review at r0083 and the target finger geometry show limited tabletop clearance at approach. Test a small positive startup thumb MCP2 offset, which raises the distal pad about 2 mm per 0.04 rad in the observed posture, plus a fixed 1.30 rad upper target on the thumb DIP to create margin for transients. These are fixed package start and action-range parameters. The actor weights, simulator and task criteria are unchanged. Predict retained lift with zero limit violations on the paired physical starts.

body.text: Paired reset diagnostics on checkpoint 0351 use the same 40 physical states and sensor draws, once deterministically and once with the training exploration. Median first opposition loss on partly turned resets moves from 0.39 to 0.12 s under noise. Lifted resets lose opposition after medians 1.56 and 0.91 s. Six of eight deterministic carry resets pay carry with no supported touchdown. Five of eight supported release resets re-lift the plug; none pays release. Add the signed transition to untouched upright support to the held-state reward. It moves the three successful exact witness returns to 57.48–57.85 and leaves the two grounded pushes negative, two lifted drops below 3.43, and held-still score near zero. Keep the existing behavior and pacing of the active 80-minute run. The assembled GPU plant static diagnostic matches contacts in 211/212 representative snapshots, no buffers overflow, and the plug acceleration relative error p95 is 0.153. It has no finished closed-loop parity or batched contract monitor evidence, so the next rollout continues to use the recorded CPU plant.

body.text: Predeclare a 100-minute signed-retention PPO continuation from a single actor whose lineage began at random weights, with checkpoint 1089 and package C as the default parent if no later safe checkpoint improves the stage funnel. Keep the exact observation history, action transform and full deployment plus five physical reset probabilities of the selected parent. Configure the critic and optimizer afresh for the changed objective. Signed opposed clearance and unqualified turn potentials reverse on loss. A grounded sliding penalty removes the measured shortcut, while untouched upright support and measured rest give the late reset phases a learnable effect. Expect a lifted hold longer than the 0.28 s median seen in r0077 and at least one qualifying turn in a deployment rollout. At the 20-minute checkpoint stop only if fixed evaluation has no qualifying lift, no gain in opposed-hold duration and no subsequent stage on the paired reset probes. At 40 minutes stop only if turn remains absent in both full and assisted episodes and opposed duration has flattened. Otherwise continue to budget or a verified stopping condition. The station model passes all required checks, monitored training ends at hardware and contract events, and the CPU compiler probe retains stage and rest decisions on its 67 checked replays. Every kept package still uses the official frozen numerical evaluator and a fresh gate.

body.hypothesis: Raise only the package starting palm z by 2 mm. body.text: I opened the three-view local reviews of r0094 seeds 540503124 and 332711759. The v5 gate renderer failed, so these paired physical starts use independent standard sensor draws. The first contacts around 0.25 s, tips the plug, reaches 12.0 mm clearance near 1.34 s without qualifying its lift, then releases. The other contacts around 0.26 s and slides the grounded plug nearly 89 mm with less than 0.1 mm clearance. In the independently evaluated r0092 actor, 58 lifts sustain at least 10 mm clear opposition for a median longest interval of 1.01 s. One near turn reaches 31.7 degrees tilt and 66.9 degrees relative blade rotation at 2.50 s, with contact on thumb and middle. The middle finger loses contact at 2.51 s while the plug is about 67 mm above the table. Fifteen of the 58 lifts enter their first qualifying segment already below 55 degrees tilt, before a criterion-eligible turn can start. The signed alternative should reward world-up and relative turn progress jointly and retain physical clearance during the last portion of the opposed turn. Compare its hold duration against the stronger r0092 parent, and keep the frozen turn criteria.

body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. body.hypothesis: Continue unchanged PPO through the predeclared 70-minute checkpoint to test retention gains on the same fixed sampling distribution.
body.reflection: At 4,586,496 steps the actor has 31/64 lifts and 54/64 rest passes, with no qualifying turn. Seven episodes have a hardware violation. Six early thumb PIP excursions occur during plug contact at about 0.41–0.48 s. The other is an upper middle MCP2 excursion at 0.46 s. All stay clear of target-jump and torque stops and no contract failure appears. Keep checkpoint 1089 safety C as the stronger next branch parent unless the final checkpoint improves.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed unsupported clearance, capped at 45 mm.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed angular progress on both world blade tilt and relative blade rotation under opposed air contact, with credit restricted to active finger windows.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Loss of unsupported contact more than 8 mm off the surface after an opposed lift.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for physical thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more while the plug is supported and remains within 20 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Signed increase in pre-lift tabletop object travel beyond 3 mm, in units of 30 mm.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

body.next: Replay the complete sent action histories from all eight measured initial poses in the original v5 simulation. Compare near-lift retention, wrist and finger response, observed motion, and any discrepant stopper or floor contact before revising the reward and gating the stronger safety C package.

body.observation_mismatch: All eight replays use the first valid t=0 estimate, the exact package start, and all 600 sent commands. All 4,800 poses are valid in both station and replay. The station median pose age is 43.3 ms per trial. Replay medians are 43.5 to 73.1 ms. Jointly valid estimate center RMSE is 5.3 to 36.7 mm. The nominal observer draws are independent of the target.
body.dynamics_mismatch: Both settings finish all eight sideways outside the goal without a station stop. The replay records no qualifying lift and 0.08 to 5.55 mm peak bottom clearance. The station estimated bottom clearance is 1.76 to 20.26 mm. Three station trials cross the geometric lift thresholds for 0.13 to 0.30 s, with opposition unresolved. Seven replay wrist errors are 1.25 to 1.35 mm RMSE. Trial 4 is 6.15 mm. Finger encoder RMSE is 0.015 rad through 0.30 s, 0.022 rad during 0.30–2.50 s, and 0.258 rad from 4 to 20 s pooled. That late discrepancy is concentrated in middle MCP1 at 0.986 rad and the index chain. Published forward geometry on station encoders implies 6.5 to 10.7 mm adjacent hull interpenetration in the selected late rows. The same replay keeps them separated. Replay shaft torque peaks at t=0.10 s before plug handling and exceeds the target peak.
body.changes: The largest contact difference during pickup is a brief additional vertical rise in the target. The persistent late adjacent-finger difference is handled as a modeling limit. Retain physical finger collisions, penalize failure to settle and compare an expanded actuator and friction range instead of fitting individual encoder traces. Test shorter and longer finger delays and lower glove friction with the same commands, then use a signed grip-retention and world-upright reward. The criterion and v5 gate remain fixed.

body.text: [redacted] is judged in r0099 and replayed in r0100. The target has brief estimated clearance above 10 mm on four trials, with three also clearing the required rise for at least 0.13 s. The station views leave sustained opposition unresolved. All finish sideways and miss finger rest. All nominal and 112 parameter-variant replays end on the same support face and stay below 10 mm clearance. Wider actuator and friction combinations are a separate transfer test. No single-parameter setting justifies changing the frozen scene. Finalize the r0093 retention comparison with a geometric-mean directional turn potential and an early supported-tilt penalty. On the actual C action bounds, static holds score 0, two table failures score −3.14 and −5.49, two lifted releases score 0.23 and 2.71, and three complete replays score 57.40–57.85. One randomized preflight stops at 0.77 s because the middle and ring fingertips jam the supported plug; calculated external torque is 20.45 Nm and the finger limit remains valid. The underlying CPU model passes its published tests. Begin the 100-minute continuation from checkpoint 1089 with C start and cap, original physical domain range, preserved PPO exploration and exact monitors. Use the 1.01 s parent median airborne grip as the comparison for the predeclared 20- and 40-minute checks.

The target [redacted] paired contact study applied five seconds of the exact sent commands to 12 independent physics draws for each of the eight observed starts. The existing v5 training ranges give 31/96 peaks above 10 mm, 10/96 simulated qualifying lifts and the observed sideways support face in 96/96. The expanded delay, motor bandwidth and independently drawn friction ranges give 30/96 peaks above 10 mm, 15/96 qualifying lifts and the sideways face in 93/96. Neither condition stops or violates hardware. Expanded draws lower median peak torque from 8.02 to 7.63 Nm and object position RMSE from 15.41 to 15.29 mm, while median slide error grows from 11.72 to 13.01 mm. The existing distribution already produces clearances absent from nominal replay. This sensitivity study uses measured starting estimates, does not establish sustained target opposition and does not support changing the frozen plant. Keep the existing ranges in the current reward-only continuation. See research/target_round_3/randomized_contact_range.json.

reward_terms.name: enclosure

reward_terms.name: turn_progress

reward_terms.name: passive_turn

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt

In one training-only stochastic deployment episode at update 214, physical start 284088310 and sensor draw 1663418631, the exact stage predicates pass lift and finger turn, with no hardware or contract event through all 600 calls. Build a matched physical reset bank from future-held PPO pickup poses and check it separately for a later curriculum comparison. Only qpos, qvel, seed and reset stage enter that bank.

body.warning: suite task_feasibility version 5's incumbent r0070 meets its pass rate (success 22/32 = 0.688 >= 0.25). Version 6 starts over: its first gate is a new baseline, and the suite loses its standing until version 6's incumbent meets its pass rate (another suite of the link that meets its own still counts). Tightening your own criteria resets what you have proven; do it only for a reason the demonstration or the task gives, and say it in --reason (demo2sim/VERIFICATION.md section 3).

body.text: The learner pickup reset pool passes the six-step physical hold test on 445 of 4,155 candidate shapes. It contributes 199 lifted and 201 partly turned states. Yet the same actor loses median opposition after 0.42 and 0.025 s there, compared with 1.52 and 0.80 s on separate deterministic reference resets. A 28-start same-state ablation finds median time to opposition loss 0.77 s from the exact live plant and history, 0.45 s after clearing only the actor history, and 0.01 s after restoring only qpos/qvel with or without the actual prefix history. No hardware events occur. The transient loss comes primarily from replacing the live actuator, contact and sensor state at snapshot reset. A separate later curriculum comparison may start at a physically attained point by rolling the previous PPO checkpoint through a short exact prefix from deployment. Only the new actor actions enter PPO data and the prefix supplies current plant/sensor/history state. No demonstration actions, supervised labels, or auxiliary controllers enter the actor. Keep the current training experiment unchanged for its planned checks.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.

body.hypothesis: Continue the signed-retention actor until the 20-minute decision. Look for stable lift retention, a qualifying turn or close opposed geometry, and assisted transition progress.
body.reflection: At 1,959,552 new PPO steps, 36/64 fixed starts lift and 35 pass hand rest, with no hardware, stop or contract events. `None` turns or completes. Continue the unchanged run while checking safety and later-stage support.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.reflection: The variant preserves the original network weights and start. It gains 55/64 fixed-start lifts and 64 terminal rests, with no turn or later stage. There are no hardware, stop or contract events. It has zero events on 24 targeted risk prefixes and 512 independent 1.5 s startup prefixes. Worst substep excursions are 0.01605 rad targeted and 0.01919 rad on the independent starts, below the 0.02 rad hardware allowance. The original uncapped package had two hardware violations on the same 512 starts. Height increases of 2 and 4 mm produced 42 and 36 fixed lifts with no fixed safety failures. The fixed cap is the stronger current variant. Validation p99 was 4.387 ms under concurrent CPU work.

body.text: Reviewed the r0113 near-turn image on seed 1941669301. The thumb and middle oppose at 2.76 s with 132.9 degrees opposition, 98.2 mm bottom clearance and 29.38 degrees blade tilt. Neither is touching by 2.80 s. The plug returns to the table by 3.0 s. This is the same failure mode as the early retention actor with a larger controlled angular excursion. A second exact full-start training-only turn appears at update 661. It runs all 600 calls without a safety or contract event and loses grip before carry. The deterministic evaluations still show zero turns and zero placements.

Independent whole-episode preflight of the fixed middle MCP2 bound at −0.05 rad reaches 107/128 opposed lifts and 128/128 terminal hand rests. No finger turn, carry, placement, stop, hardware or contract event occurs. The result uses one reproducible 128-start sample split into five bounded jobs after two longer processes ended on SIGTERM before publishing summaries. The aggregation confirms each seed, its order and its uniqueness against the sampler. The corresponding fixed set reaches 55/64 lifts.
