The unchanged r0094 neural package is now in the v6 task baseline gate.

Both arms resume the same single random-initialized PPO lineage at checkpoint 0567 unless the 40-minute candidate safely reaches a later frozen stage. reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. The prefix supplies environment context. Its actions never enter PPO batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.

body.text: The capture-aligned feature implementation adds 36 causal palm-relative components to the 608-input PPO actor. The original feature prefix is bit-identical on two complete rollouts. With new input columns initialized to zero, the largest action change across 1,200 contract observations is 2.0e−8. A three-update diagnostic build validates v3 at p99 0.984 ms with no time input. It is not being judged for task success. The paired context branches and the pending target package remain unchanged.

Apply the predeclared midpoint stop to the live context branch. Both 16-minute actors have zero fixed lifts, zero later stages and zero hardware, stop or contract events. The live branch median clear hold is 0.385 s on 118 warm resets and 0.11 s on 120 cold resets. The matched control has median 0.44 s across 210 cold resets and two safe assisted turn bonuses versus zero in the live branch. Relative to the matched control, training retention and turn progress do not improve. Stop the live branch after publishing its midpoint and retain the original control until its scheduled end. The original 100-minute signed-retention run continues. Its 60-minute safety failures are all early loaded middle MCP2 excursions. Fixed positive MCP2 targets do not prevent cross-joint contact loads. s04 remains unchanged while the target is running.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The critic and optimizer are reinitialized for this reward.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Continue the originally budgeted signed-retention run and check whether later training recovers a safe grip and turn after the 40-minute regression.
body.reflection: Three of 64 fixed starts lift and none turns. Forty-eight hardware events all occur at middle MCP2 between 0.34 and 0.40 s. The thumb and middle touch the unsupported housing in every event. The commanded middle MCP2 values are +0.144 to +0.211 rad and median substep overrun below the lower limit is 0.02499 rad. Better positive command margin alone cannot prevent the pinch contact load. There are no station stops or contract problems. Eleven episodes pass hand rest. Preserve the early accepted actor and finish the predeclared budget.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.text: The measured exploratory prefix sweep motivates testing smaller PPO noise separately. In 20 matched full-start seven-second prefixes, r0115 lifts 17, 10, 8 and 5 times at raw standard deviations 0, 0.12, 0.18 and 0.27. body.next: Replay every exact sent command in the v6 plant. Compare which starts lift, the loss and final support, finger response and pose visibility. Retain the transferred pickup while improving finger turning under sustained opposition.

body.observation_mismatch: All replays start from the first valid t=0 estimate and use the submitted ramp and all 600 exact sent commands. Six trials have 600 valid pose observations in both settings. Trials 2 and 3 have 434 valid target and 518 valid replay rows. The target loses both at 0.667 s. Median target pose age is 43.33 ms and p95 is 53.33 ms on each trial. Replay median range is 43.52–73.06 ms. The center RMSE at jointly valid rows spans 3.25–22.74 mm. Target and replay sensor draws are independent.
body.dynamics_mismatch: The same six trials visibly lift at the target and qualify lift in the v6 replay. Trials 2 and 3 stay supported during pickup in both. All eight finish sideways and outside the zone with the hand at rest, no stop, and all 600 commands. Replay hardware status passes all eight. On the six pickup trials, target estimated peak bottom clearance is 33.77–55.87 mm and replay modeled peak is 33.76–50.18 mm. Paired absolute peak differences are at most 7.32 mm. Wrist RMS error is 0.742–1.233 mm. Pooled hand encoder RMSE grows from 0.0277 rad through 0.30 s to 0.0425 rad through 4.4 s and 0.1112 rad afterwards. The later errors are largest at index MCP2 and middle MCP1. Early replay torque peaks of 6.78–6.97 Nm at 0.10 s exceed target episode maxima of 1.68–2.33 Nm.
body.changes: Retain the v6 plant. A 112-prefix exact-command sweep varies finger delay, motor bandwidth, grip and friction. Reducing hand friction to 0.50 lowers median peak torque from 6.89 to 3.89 Nm. It also drops support-face agreements from eight to five and lifts from six to five, and grows median object error from 11.83 to 32.05 mm. The wider motor response alternatives preserve lift in most tests without improving the outcome match. Keep the current physical randomization and record the residual as a transfer limitation. Use the accepted actor and unchanged action transform for an on-policy lower-noise comparison. Its aim is to sustain opposition through a directed finger turn.

body.text: Following the six matched pickup outcomes in r0140, begin a 50-minute PPO exploration comparison from r0115 and the exact accepted r0128 action transform. Change the raw action noise from 0.27 to 0.12. Keep episode bias 0.12, ratio-clip settings, reward, 6,233 physical resets, mode mix, deployment cage, and the current hand/arm/sensor distributions. The parent weights are the PPO checkpoint 0175 and no other weights are used. The cap is the fixed middle MCP2 target lower bound already deployed. Use 24 CPU stations with compiled DLS and one CUDA optimizer. Evaluate at about 8, 18, 34 and 50 minutes on the same 64 starts. The test predicts retention of at least half the starts as qualifying lifts and safe new assisted or full turns by the 18-minute check. Stop at that check if fewer than 32 lift and there is neither a safe new turn nor improved held rotation, or if two or more hardware events recur and held geometry gives no improvement. A turn-ready checkpoint still needs independent safety and paired gating. Use an independent constrained reachability probe to diagnose whether this fixed cap preserves turn mobility.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The critic and optimizer are reinitialized for this reward.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Finish the scheduled cold snapshot control and test whether the original reset curriculum recovers deterministic lift after the matched warm branch stopped.
body.reflection: The cold control at its 30-minute endpoint still has zero lifts or later stages on 64 fixed starts. Fifty-nine pass terminal rest. There are zero hardware violations, stops or contract issues. At the same earlier checkpoint and PPO parameters the live branch failed at its midpoint. The control never regains the 36 fixed lifts of its parent. Use the lower exploratory noise diagnosed in r0137 to make a separate comparison from the transferred r0128 actor.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.text: The smaller-noise branch uses the accepted cap and immediately exposes an optimizer issue. At raw noise 0.12 the first update logs mean minibatch KL 0.7682. The existing epoch guard checks only after the full first epoch and its reported values omit the final applied parameter step. This can disrupt the parent even when exploration draws are safer. Prepare an optional PPO backtracking guard that measures the actual full-rollout Gaussian KL and scales down the applied actor update above a 0.040 bound. Critic and optimizer steps remain PPO. Test its first updates on the same initial batch before selecting a separate guarded arm. The current low-noise branch remains in its prescribed check.

A fixed-bound turn-authority probe sampled 192 physical continuations at each of six opposed prefixes of the accepted capped actor. On the same physical start 1466754799, two separate takeover times at 1.35 and 1.80 s yield monitored turns with the middle MCP2 command bounded below by −0.05 rad and thumb DIP capped at 1.30 rad. Relative turns are 81.91 and 67.80 degrees, wrist excursions 12.30 and 14.41 degrees, passive rotation zero, and endpoint tilt 23.98 and 20.33 degrees. The other four prefixes yield no exact turn. Both reviewed successful traces visibly retain the plug while the fingers turn it. These are bounded-controller physical reachability checks, with no controller actions used in PPO. In a separate three-update matched first-batch smoke, the optional 0.040 KL projection applied 15.30 percent of the first actor update and produced actual KL 0.03973. All three applied full-batch KL values were below 0.040. Do not apply the guard to the current unguarded low-noise branch until it gets its recorded checkpoint check.

The unguarded 0.12-noise branch has zero fixed lifts and 39 hardware violations at its first eight-minute checkpoint, compared with 55 safe lifts in its accepted parent. Keep it through its stated 18-minute rule. Start a separate 35-minute comparison from the exact same actor, training seed, 24 stations, noise, rewards, resets, caps and mechanics. The only optimization change is the optional full-rollout applied-actor KL limit of 0.040 confirmed in r0144. Evaluate at 8, 18 and roughly 35 minutes. The prediction is to retain at least 32 fixed lifts with fewer safety events, and to start an eligible held turn. Stop at the 18-minute test if the guarded branch also loses pickup and has neither better held geometry than the parent nor a safe new assisted or full turn. All kept artifacts still need a fresh paired gate.

body.text: R0129 failure montages show stable clearance followed by a sideways drop beside pickup. Static MuJoCo contact replay of the available opposed intervals locates the thumb at median housing coordinates (-8.09, -20.46, -0.57) mm late in 104 learned validation traces and (-5.52, -20.46, 0.59) mm late in six aligned target command replays. Two independently searched bounded turn witnesses reach (-11.78, -19.81, 3.90) mm. The r0007 reconstructed airborne turn frames 119–139 estimate (-11.45, -21.21, 6.99) mm. These estimates suggest a thumb roll near one housing corner may support the missing relative rotation. The two bounded turns are from one physical start and their contact path is diagnostic. Test a training-only signed potential, weighted 1.8, for progress toward the demonstrated patch with a 5 mm tolerance and housing symmetry, scaled by directional turn progress during clear opposition. Contact loss reverses unqualified credit. Record the paired replay preflight before choosing whether to allocate a new PPO branch.

The scored contact-guidance preflight in research/simulation/contact_guidance_reward_preflight.json keeps three stationary actions at zero, three bounded random cases negative and full witnesses at 57.48–57.85. The isolated guide peaks 0.58 on a lifted drop and refunds to zero. The two monitored capped turns get 0.61 and 0.62 guide credit while still airborne, but the underlying training reward grants neither the turn bonus. The first clear anchor at 0.61 s yields just 43.46 and 41.73 degrees relative blade motion at the final upright samples because the plug first rolls the other way. Later valid anchors within the same continuous opposed intervals reach 68.08 and 64.15 degrees at 1.61 and 2.11 s, with zero passive rotation. The frozen evaluator considers these later anchors and both exact prefixes pass lift and turn. Before launching contact guidance, check a training-only turn qualification repair that searches the continuous opposed interval like the frozen criteria. This isolates lost bonus credit from reward shaping. The task suite and criterion thresholds stay frozen.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The critic and optimizer are reinitialized for this reward.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Predeclared r0141 test of raw standard deviation 0.12 with the lifted target package as PPO parent and unchanged signed retention reward.
body.reflection: At 18.04 minutes and 1,002,240 steps, 35/64 fixed starts lift, 26 reach terminal rest, and none turns, stops or violates hardware or contract. Twenty-one exact traces pass both standard rotation magnitudes; none reaches 25 degrees in an eligible opposed interval. Best eligible tilt 43.03 degrees with just 9.53 degrees blade-relative rotation, and lifted median held clearance duration 0.84 s. Across 419 safe stochastic deployment episodes, 155 lift without a new exact turn, and eight assisted starts advance the turn. The midpoint lift minimum of 32 and zero safety events allow the planned continuation.

body.text: The unguarded lower-noise arm reaches 35/64 lifts at its 18-minute decision with no hardware or contract event. It meets the predeclared minimum of 32; continue to the 34- and 50-minute evaluations. Its best eligible tilt is 43.03 degrees and 21 traces meet both standard rotation amplitudes, but no qualifying turn. The guarded eight-minute checkpoint improves early pickup safety relative to the matched unguarded checkpoint but has a thumb PIP excursion and no turn. Keep it running to its own 18-minute decision.

The training-only window bonus preflight in research/simulation/turn_window_reward_preflight.json restores the missing five-point turn bonus and phase advance on both capped exact prefixes. It leaves their continuous opposition and the gate criteria unchanged. All three full witness rewards are exactly unchanged, at 57.40 to 57.85, both failed logged rollouts are unchanged, and stationary cases get zero. Bounded random returns are -5.23, -3.56 and -4.86 with one monitored torque halt. The current reward repair only changes credit once a valid turn occurs. Before allocating a long reward branch, also test signed directional shaping over multiple eligible anchors so PPO can gain a learning signal before a complete exact turn.

Compare two 30-minute PPO continuations from r0150 checkpoint 0435, with fresh critics and optimizers, seed 636862, 12 stations per arm, raw noise 0.12, whole-batch applied actor KL limit 0.040, and the same r0128 start, action transform, v6 plant, curriculum and domain draws. Only the deployment-start turn reward changes. The test searches like the frozen contiguous opposed criterion for its bonus and uses the best angular progress across high-tilt anchors every 0.10 s for signed shaping. On the paired check both bounded turns earn their missing bonus, the near r0150 lift raises transient credited rotation from 0.58 to 0.85 without a turn bonus, and all three full witnesses, three failed trajectories, zero stationary rewards and negative random cases preserve total returns. Three smoke updates export a v3 package validating at p99 4.227 ms. Evaluate fixed starts near 8, 16 and 30 minutes. Predict that the new reward yields an exact safe held turn or materially improves eligible geometry while retaining at least 24/64 lifts. At the midpoint stop both branches if the new actor has fewer than 24 lifts and neither a new safe exact turn nor at least 10 degrees better eligible tilt at 45 degrees or more relative rotation than the control. Current r0129 montages show the plug leaving the opposed grasp on the pickup side of the table.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push

reward_terms.name: safety

body.text: The recovered original retention branch reaches its planned endpoint at about 100 minutes sampled training and 8,771,328 new policy steps across the intact original and recovery segments. It finishes with 3/64 fixed lifts, zero turns and all 64 at rest. The two safe stochastic full-start turn events from the original segment remain useful reachability evidence. The continuation generates 490 safe lifts without a new complete turn. Learning has not made the stochastic turn repeatable. The 34-minute recovery used the saved actor with a fresh critic and optimizer after the interruption, so this evidence does not support assumptions about preserving optimizer state over longer runs.

The exact turn envelope replay supplies stronger reachability evidence than the static joint-cap search. After unchanged learned pickup commands, all projected suffix commands are generated by the actual frozen r0128 action decoder with the live v3 observations. At 1.30 and 1.50 times the original suffix duration, both takeovers on seed 1466754799 meet exact lift and finger turn. Relative blade rotations are 66.22–99.98 degrees, wrist excursions 9.91–19.23 degrees, passive motion zero and endpoint tilt 20.30–23.22 degrees. The 1.00 and 1.13 duration variants lift and miss the turn. No projected turn prefix has a stop, hardware or contract problem. The different imitation controls are used only in the physics diagnostic. All four qualifying traces and the control comparison are in research/learning/retention_eval/checkpoint_0175/safety_middle_min_05/turn_authority_with_cap/envelope_replay. Carry and placement remain untested from these grips.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The critic and optimizer are reinitialized for this reward. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Continue the r0145 matched prescribed KL-bound comparison to its midpoint.
body.reflection: The 18-minute guarded actor passes lift on 33/64 fixed starts and rest on 35. It has 17 with both standard rotation amplitudes and no qualified turn. Seven excursions occur while the plug is still supported or nearly touching the table, six at the lower middle MCP2 boundary and one at thumb PIP. There are no stops or contract errors. Best eligible tilt is 60.49 degrees with 7.92 degrees relative motion and the median held interval is 0.43 s. Training logs contain 125 safe deployment lifts, no safe deployment turn, 21 assisted turn advances and eight safe suffix placements on assisted starts. The matched unguarded actor had 35 lifts and no hardware violations by 18 minutes. The guarded actor reaches the prescribed midpoint lift floor and continues to the planned endpoint.

body.text: The guarded lower-noise comparison keeps 33/64 fixed lifts at its 18-minute decision, meeting the 32-lift floor. Continue to the 35-minute endpoint because assisted starts still produce turn and placement signals. The seven evaluation excursions in the same pickup region, no complete turn and the short lifted holds keep this checkpoint out of the task gate. Separately, seven-second matched exploratory probes at the same raw standard deviation 0.12 yield 12, 10 and 11 deployment-prefix lifts at residual noise correlations 0, 0.75 and 0.93, with one, two and one safety events and no turn. Across 32 lifted or partly turned resets per setting the same order yields one, four and three assisted turn bonuses. The relevant paths are research/simulation/temporal_exploration_deployment.json and temporal_exploration_held.json. The four successful envelopes in r0157 use physics-search commands and never enter the PPO optimizer or copy actions from the demonstration.

The full-arm Warp control probe feeds the exact CPU delayed arm and hand targets into the same 2 ms scene. For two replayed nominal measured [redacted] starts, the six-second GPU cases reproduce the pickup or miss and finish sideways. Plant center RMSE during pickup is 0.14 and 1.10 mm. At the later bounded turn, all 12 worlds retain the grasp, the airborne center RMSE is 0.55 mm and all end 19.30–20.76 degrees against CPU 20.33. At the earlier marginal turn, four of 12 worlds drop late, with final center error 73–77 mm, despite a CPU-held turn. No solver or geometric overflow is flagged in these 48 CPU-conditioned worlds. This is an open-loop plant check only. Continue exact CPU training while the GPU controller, contact monitor, full reset and 128-seed policy parity remain unverified. Use research/simulation/warp_plant_probe/{target,held}_open_loop_control_replay.json. Hollenstein et al. 2024 https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.11091 motivates the correlated-exploration pilot. Our diagnostic at correlation 0.75 has four of 32 assisted turns versus one for independent noise. Four smoke updates with the optional AR(1) likelihood run to an exportable checkpoint. No correlated run has entered a task gate.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry

reward_terms.name: failure

reward_terms.name: enclosed

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.turn_window: The deployment bonus searches the continuous opposed interval like the frozen criteria. Dense shaping uses the strongest valid directional progress among high-tilt anchors sampled every 0.10 s, preserving the first and 31 latest anchors. Assisted reset rewards are unchanged.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The critic and optimizer are reinitialized for this reward. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Matched r0154 control retains the original single-anchor signed retention reward with the same recent PPO parent, seed, action bounds and KL limit.
body.reflection: At eight minutes the control gives 18/64 lifts, 43 rests and no full turn, stop or contract event. Twelve early loaded middle MCP2 excursions occur from 0.36 to 0.41 s. Median opposed hold among lifts is 0.325 s and 15 episodes pass both standard angle magnitudes. Closest eligible endpoint is 47.53 degrees with 49.72 degrees relative motion. Continue to the 16-minute comparison.

body.text: Following the four projected turns in r0157, three held prefixes were tested with 20 constant-grip and small wrist variants each under the same exact action decoder. Ten of 60 settle probes stay airborne for 1.2 s with no violation or stop, and the most upright endpoint is 5.75 degrees. `None` of 60 full travel probes qualifies held carry. The best retains support for 3.41 s and approaches the target at (0.429, -0.066, -0.269) m with 40.79 degrees tilt. Its appended passive motion also loses the harness turn predicate over the full combined trace. The supported release condition has not been tested from these grasps. Evidence is in settle_probe.json and travel_probe.json under the r0157 envelope_replay directory. The two-digit pinch has turn and hold authority; carrying with a fixed squeeze is fragile.

Test a backward reset curriculum with one PPO actor initialized from the deployed r0128 weights. Whole-horizon 16-start probes show 8/16 deterministic safe placement suffixes from supported release and 0/16 from carry for r0128. The r0158 checkpoint has 9/16 and 0/16, with startup safety worse on full starts. At raw noise 0.12 both actors have 2/16 release suffixes. Related prior work motivates advancing from physically valid late states, Qiu et al. https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24392. The current harness uses only PPO and physically verified qpos/qvel resets. Start with a 30-minute phase, unchanged v6 plant, reward, r0128 action bounds, seed 3298744, 24 stations, std 0.12 and applied actor KL 0.040. Only the reset probabilities change from r0145, to deployment 0.29, pregrasp 0.05, lifted 0.06, partial turn 0.04, carry 0.16, supported release 0.40. Evaluate 64 fixed full starts and 16 fixed release states near 8, 18 and 30 minutes. Advance to a carry-focused phase once at least 12/16 release suffixes pass safely and 32/64 full lifts are retained. Save critic and Adam state so a future phase can resume if eligible. At 18 minutes stop if both fewer than nine release suffixes and fewer than 32 lifts, with no safe exact turn or significant held geometry gain. The deployment interface contains no curriculum state.

A backward-reset PPO branch starts from r0128. Its 20 s probes pass 8/16 safe placement suffixes from supported release and 0/16 from carry. R0158 passes 9/16 and 0/16; both pass 2/16 release suffixes at exploration std 0.12. Use the same r0145 seed 3298744, 24 stations, v6, std 0.12, actor KL bound 0.040, action bounds and reward. Only the reset mix changes to [0.29,0.05,0.06,0.04,0.16,0.40], in reported mode order. Evaluate 64 fixed full starts and 16 fixed release resets near 8, 18 and 30 minutes. Advance to carry if at least 12/16 release suffixes pass safely and 32/64 full lifts remain. At 18 minutes stop if fewer than nine release suffixes and fewer than 32 lifts with no safe turn or meaningful held geometry gain. Replay states contain only positions and velocities. The next phase may resume saved critic and Adam states. Backward resets are motivated by Qiu et al. https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24392.

The optional pad-location observation uses only public right-hand FK, measured encoders, the measured palm and the delayed v3 object pose. Across 256 random postures pad positions agree with MuJoCo in the palm frame to 7.2e-16 m, and the deployed palm frame differs from the mesh frame by at most 8.1 micrometers. In moving held rows, capture-aligned thumb and middle pad RMSE falls from 3.79 to 2.71 mm in an r0128 rollout, from 4.52 to 2.99 mm in an exact bounded turn, and from 7.81 to 6.51 and 3.29 to 2.10 mm in two r0140 open-loop replays. Some supported rows worsen. Keep both causal frames to let PPO choose. Two complete traces preserve the existing 608 features bit for bit when expanding to 824 inputs. Four PPO smoke updates export a v3 package with action p99 2.105 ms. This is an observation and package check, without a task score.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing
domain_randomization.distribution: supplied default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with occlusion measured by ray-capsule visibility and independently seeded delay, noise, two-sided orientation flips and dropout

domain_randomization.name: physical reset perturbations
domain_randomization.distribution: prechecked intermediate qpos and qvel with up to ±8 mm xy and ±0.12 rad yaw on world rigid transforms, perturbed mechanics

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Measure the late r0145 lower-noise checkpoint in the matched applied KL experiment.
body.reflection: At 34.02 minutes and 1,543,680 new steps the guarded actor gives 49/64 fixed lifts and 55 rests. One early lower middle MCP2 violation remains. No turns, stops or contract errors occur. Median lift opposition is 0.79 s and closest eligible tilt is 65.33 degrees with 28.76 degrees blade-relative motion. The guarded run continues to its saved final actor. Training has 214 safe lifts in 700 safe deployment rollouts, no exact turns, 39 assisted turn advances and 16 safe placement suffixes.

body.text: At the matched turn-window midpoint, continue both r0154 arms to 30 minutes. The window actor clears the preseason 24-lift floor with 34 lifts versus the control 20, and has one sampled hardware excursion versus 20. Median clear opposition is 0.945 versus 0.47 s. Neither has a complete turn, a stop or a contract problem. The best observed tilt and relative motion in the two arms still fail the full geometry. Neither checkpoint is eligible to replace the active gate.

Compare temporally correlated training exploration with the completed guarded r0145 run. The same PPO parent r0128, seed 3298744, reward, reset mix, v6 plant, 24 stations, action transform and raw marginal std 0.12 apply. The only new setting is stationary AR(1) correlation 0.75. The clipped likelihood and 0.040 trust limit use the actual conditional innovation std 0.07937, so the same normalized limit implies a tighter absolute mean change. No stochastic memory enters deployment. Paired probes in r0159 show four assisted turn bonuses versus one with independent samples, and no new deployment turn. Evaluate at 8, 18 and 30 minutes with 64 fixed full starts. At 18 stop if fewer than 32 lifts with neither a safe exact turn nor a meaningful increase in eligible held geometry. The four-update smoke saved all applied KL below 0.040. The prediction is a safer, longer opposed motion with a higher chance of a qualifying turn. PPO such exploration is motivated by Hollenstein et al. https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.11091.

body.text: Both lower-noise experiments have reached their fixed endpoints. The guarded final checkpoint recovers 51/64 lifts and has zero hardware violations. The unguarded 50-minute actor keeps 33 lifts and reports 14 startup violations. Both lack a qualifying turn on fixed starts. Keep r0128, which has stronger retention and already transferred its pickup to six target trials. A separate GPU controller component check gives 0.00078 rad p95 command difference and 0.20 micrometer p95 palm difference across 1,890 recorded controls. A CUDA graph replays batched inverse kinematics in about 3.8 ms. The 512-state stress check has nine active column barriers and no nonfinite result. One alternate fp32 iterate differs by 0.037 rad with near-identical palm pose. No GPU training or gate outcome is claimed.

After the matched turn reward runs release their workers, test the geometry observation of r0167 against recorded r0145. Use the r0128 PPO parent, seed 3298744, v6, 24 stations, unchanged signed-retention reward, reset distribution, action bounds, std 0.12 and actor KL limit 0.040. Add the 36 current and capture-aligned plug features and 180 nominal pad coordinates together. This tests the combined observation change. Existing inputs and raw means match bit for bit before PPO, and the only new actor columns start at zero. Evaluate 64 fixed full starts at 8, 18 and 32 minutes. At the midpoint stop for fewer than 32 lifts without a new safe exact turn or an improvement of at least 10 degrees in eligible tilt at 45 degrees of relative movement against the fixed-start incumbent. Predict more continuous held rotation and fewer load-driven limit events under the delayed pose estimates. New package runtime input remains contract v3.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.

body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: R0165 and r0166 increase the share of supported-release initial states while retaining the deployment-start share and all other PPO settings.
body.reflection: At eight minutes the learned package completes the full 20-second supported-release suffix in 15/16 fixed states, all safe, against 8/16 in the deployed parent. It has 56/64 fixed full-start lifts and 56 rests with zero hardware violations, stops or contract errors. Median continuous lift opposition is 1.175 s. Full-start turns remain zero and closest eligible tilt is 59.45 degrees. The predeclared thresholds of 12/16 release suffixes and 32/64 full lifts both pass. Advance to the carry-focused reset phase using this single PPO actor and saved training state.

body.text: The multi-anchor reward gives the exact turn bonus to both capped physics witnesses before training, but its early improvement over the matched control disappears by 30 minutes. Endpoint lift is 13 versus 41, and limit violations nine versus one. There are zero full turns. Keep the task gate incumbent and finish this matched run. Correlated exploration has a separate eight-minute signal of 48 lifts, 1.85 s median opposed clearance and 40.85 degrees at 55.37 degrees relative motion, with two early hardware excursions. Allow the preregistered 18-minute comparison. The supported-release curriculum advances to carry from its passing checkpoint.

Budget up to 50 minutes alongside CPU training to determine whether this full-arm GPU station can scale PPO. Same delayed commands at 512 worlds produce 54,827 controller ticks per second, 99.75% finger-contact agreement, 99.39% support agreement, 2.06-degree p95 opposition error and 0.045 Nm p95 torque error over a two-second measured-start pickup. Starting from the exact CPU ramp state, a 16-world probe computes DLS and actuator delays on GPU under the recorded palm and hand demands. It has 99.67% contact agreement, 0.28 mm object height RMSE and no GPU stop or overflow. Implement and test GPU ramp, domain draws and pose sensor, then measure paired 128-start actor outcomes and contract monitoring before any training adoption. The existing GPU plant can lose a marginal contact that stays stable on CPU, as r0160 documents. If the timed prototype does not support the complete monitored policy comparison, continue the registered CPU setup. Artifacts are under research/simulation/warp_plant_probe.

A full GPU parity rollout now uses the same randomized v6 parameter values, a GPU ramp and actuator delays, frozen sampled ego visibility, the provided CPU pose sensor with paired noise seeds, and a numerically checked tensor copy of r0128. The first 16 two-second episodes pass the contract monitor without safety events. Across 923 paired static poses, the GPU visibility maximum difference is 2.94e-8, and the copied actor matches 1,200 command rows within 3.05e-8. Before the 128-episode comparison with the r0119 independent CPU slate, set diagnostic expectations of at least 90% paired lift agreement, GPU full-call hardware and stop counts within two episodes, and at least 95% paired terminal-rest agreement. Run the supplied outcome check as well. Zero full successes on both sides can only establish early-stage policy parity. Use complete feasibility commands separately to probe contact through turn and placement.

body.text: Continue correlated exploration through 30 minutes. Its midpoint has 47/64 safe lifts, clearing the 32-lift floor, and zero qualifying turns. Eligible tilt and median held clearance regress from its own eight-minute checkpoint. The carry phase retains 15/16 release suffixes while completing zero carry suffixes and zero full-start lifts at eight minutes. Evaluate again at the predeclared midpoint. The geometry-observation branch also continues to its 18-minute comparison.

Stop the pad-observation branch under r0176. At its 18-minute fixed evaluation it has zero lifts, zero later stages and zero hardware, stop or contract events. Fifty-nine of 64 trials rest. Its stochastic training prefix has no safe exact deployment turn. Twenty-two lifted or partly turned reset episodes advance the turn and five assisted suffixes finish, without recovering pickup from deployment. The causal encoder passes timing and geometry checks. This run does not justify keeping its actor or passing the observation change through the task gate.

Test PPO update acceptance based on actual pickup retention. Start from the r0128 capped actor with unchanged v6 plant, signed retention reward, reset mix, seed 3298744, 24 stations, std 0.12 and actor KL bound 0.040. After each eight PPO updates, test paired four-second deterministic prefixes on 24 new training seeds. Compare with the fixed initialized actor. Keep the block if it loses at most one lift and has no higher number of safety or contract failures. Otherwise restore the accepted actor, critic and Adam state and reduce LR by 30% to a floor of 6% of initial. Accepted blocks increase LR by 8% to its original maximum. Check prefixes are internal optimization decisions and do not supply training actions. Three smoke blocks accept 4/4, 3/4 and 4/4 lifts with zero safety. A forced rejection restores all trained tensors. Allocate 40 minutes with fixed evaluations near 8, 18 and 40. At 18 stop for fewer than 10% accepted blocks and no held geometry gain or safe turn. Predict retained pickup and fewer loaded joint excursions while exploration pursues the turn. Latest gate montages r0129 show a clear pinch dropping the sideways plug near pickup.

body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Training samples stationary Gaussian AR(1) exploration. PPO likelihood ratios and KL condition on the stored random offset and use the innovation variance. The deployed mean actor adds no exploration.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Finish the r0172 AR(1) exploration comparison at the 30-minute endpoint.
body.reflection: There are 39/64 fixed lifts, 35 rests, nine loaded lower middle MCP2 violations, no turn, stop or contract issue. Median held opposition is 0.40 s. Closest eligible tilt is 39.02 degrees with 28.36 degrees relative motion. The eight-minute actor has a stronger held turn precursor. There is no new deterministic or safe stochastic full-start turn. End the planned branch.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.
