body.text: The r0253 noise probe sees 51 lifts and two limit events at each scale on 64 paired deployment prefixes. Lowering noise in the airborne turn does not add six safe exact turns, so keep ordinary post-lift exploration. The r0254 live context probe reaches all 36 selected prefixes from 13 fresh training starts. Of 36 safe continuations at each setting, 18 deterministic, 19 with 0.33 exploration and 16 with ordinary exploration qualify a turn. `None` starts transport. That raises ordinary stochastic turn incidence in the targeted states well above the full-start rate. The training-source snapshot has five successful PPO smoke updates.

Train 38 minutes of exact v6 PPO with the anchored pre-turn contexts from r0254 and r0259, from the r0248 actor. Use 16 stations, seed 773421, std 0.12, pickup factor 0.33, KL 0.040, original six-mode reset mix, eight-update four-second lift screen, same bounds and r0251 turn-continuation reward. Only the turn reset group changes: 80 percent start from one of 36 monitored r0248 prefixes, retaining actual actuator, sensor, causal actor history and turn anchor. The other 20 percent keep physical pose resets. No prefix actions enter PPO batches. Evaluate near 8, 20 and 37.5 minutes. Expect at least one safe held 10 mm transport transition from the context branch. At midpoint stop for fewer than 32 safe full-start lifts with zero safe exact turns and zero safe anchored transport transitions. Keep ordinary deployment for every fixed checkpoint and future gate.

The r0258 excursions occur before lift, with thumb and middle distal pad loads on the supported housing. In three reproduced risk starts the final contact lists show no tabletop contact on the middle finger itself. Test the single frozen actor under ramp-only planar changes x ±4 mm, y ±4 mm and a separate +0.08 rad middle MCP2 initial pose. These alter the approach placement without changing the learned actions or fixed decoder. First compare the same eleven risk starts with two sensor draws plus 24 fresh starts through 1.4 s. Advance only a pose with zero safety events there, then check four-second lifts and full learned turn preservation on separate draws before any gate.

Across the six safe r0248 and seven safe r0258 turns, thumb targets change little and the middle DIP target extends by 0.148–0.265 rad in the roughly 0.18 s preceding qualification. Every turn is still on the thumb and middle finger at qualification, and all lose continuous hand contact shortly after. To test causality, replay all 13 learned episodes from their exact monitored ramp and run the original actor except for a local diagnostic cap on middle DIP extension, applied 0.23, 0.13 or 0.06 s before the logged turn. Compare original, 0.023, 0.010 and 0 rad of allowed extension per call through a short continuation. Record safe qualifying turns, 0.20 s retention and a held 10 mm transport start. The diagnostic commands will not enter PPO or a package.

`None` of the r0261 ramp changes passes the paired startup screen. On 22 targeted prefixes the original actor has 20 limit events. X minus, X plus and Y plus 4 mm each have nine, Y minus 4 mm has 15, and initial middle MCP2 +0.08 rad has 13. All variants still have two to four events across 24 fresh starts. Keep the original ramp and action transform. The contact audit and paired results are under research/learning/risk_start_eval/checkpoint_0200/eval.

r0262 replays all 13 original turns, then tests all nine single-joint timing and extension settings. All 130 prefixes stay safe. The intervention settings retain 11–13 exact turns out of 13, like the 13 original turns, but none retains continuous contact for 0.20 s after qualification. There is zero transport or carry. A middle DIP opening rate alone does not explain the grip loss. The traces and metrics are in research/simulation/middle_dip_extension_probe/results.json. In the r0260 anchored PPO run, update 81 has one safe sampled turn plus the complete 10 mm and 0.20 s transition bonus on physical seed 1000926863. Its independent stage outcome is lift and turn with zero carry. The episode is an assisted continuation, counted separately from deployment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: The exact opposed-turn window should let PPO retain qualifying turns that the older single-anchor reward misses.
body.reflection: At the midpoint 64 of 64 fixed deployments lift with 63 rests and zero hardware, stop or contract events. Still zero qualifying turns or later stages. Closest eligible geometry retreats to 60.52 degrees tilt and 30.95 degrees relative. Continue to the planned endpoint.

reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Bonus on the r0009 continuous lift and finger turn window on deployment starts. The shaped partial-turn criterion still applies to assisted reset stages.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt

reward_terms.name: release_progress

reward_terms.name: rest_progress

reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Start PPO near the learned turn with its intact monitored context, so exploration can encounter the first transport transitions more often.
body.reflection: The eight-minute actor safely lifts 57 of 64 fixed deployment starts and qualifies two exact turns. No turn enters transport in fixed evaluation. One separate early loaded middle MCP2 violation reaches 0.02085 rad excursion. Training has 32 safe anchored continuations, 20 exact turns and two safe transport starts, without ordered carries. Continue to the planned midpoint.

body.text: After r0265–r0267 all r0251 comparisons continue to their predeclared endpoints. Both ordinary reward branches lift 64/64 with 63 rests, zero violations and zero turns at the midpoint, and still have equal weights. The risk branch has 45 safe lifts and five true turns, six distinct early MCP2 events and no transport. r0268 live-context PPO gives 57 safe lifts, two safe turns, no transport in fixed deployment, and one separate limit excursion. In its training records two of 32 safe anchored continuations meet the held 10 mm criterion. A repeat-curriculum smoke completes 45 safe short continuations, including 32 repeats, 18 exact turns and two transport starts. Twelve matched replay-to-snapshot checks match every plant, observation, action, monitor and reward array bit for bit for 80 calls, with median prefix reset 3.52 s direct versus 18.4 ms cached under the current load.

The round-five target loses pose tracking for 5.57 s from 0.633 s in trial 0 and 4.43 s from 0.833 s in trial 4. These are the two no-lift target trials, while their open-loop sim replays have no invalid estimates. The logs alone cannot order physical pickup failure and estimate loss. Test a paired closed-loop sensitivity probe from 32 disjoint physical starts with r0238 and r0248. Two measured timing patterns drive zero visible fraction through the standard delayed sensor. Compare safe lift, turn and retained opposition against nominal sensing. Any augmentation would be training-only and require a substantial paired effect, at least six lost safe lifts or qualifying turns without the outage.

Prepared a bounded training-only physical margin term. It charges at most 1.30 when the worst substep finger joint excursion grows from 0.006 to 0.020 rad, with zero credit for activity or stationary holding. The standard contract monitor still terminates violations. In r0248 fixed trials 33/64 exceed 0.006 rad and six exceed 0.012, while in r0258 54 and 34 do. Three safe complete exact v6 traces retain all checkpoints and returns 57.328–57.826 with at most 0.115 margin penalty. Holding returns zero, random returns −6.948 to −4.694, and the six-update PPO smoke completes. Compare to the matched turn-continuation reward once r0251 frees a station group.

Timing audit following r0262 and the r0269 anchored smoke uncovered an evaluator implementation error. The 0.13 s lift helper returns the end of the whole uninterrupted interval. The turn loop incorrectly uses that end as the first eligible turn time. In the recorded smoke replays, the plug can already stay upright and move left well before this last row. r0238 montage seed 903955589 shows uninterrupted elevated manipulation from 2.50 to 7.90 s and releases by 10.58 s. The example highlights the ordering problem, and its passive rotation still fails the turn threshold. The recorded criteria explicitly allow overlap and impose a minimum 0.13 s lift, so I will test a copied evaluator with the earliest row completing the same lift duration. Keep all limits, other predicates, starts, physics and success thresholds. Existing gates remain under their original implementations.

body.reason: Implement the originally recorded minimum lift duration with its earliest satisfying row, allowing uninterrupted ordered turn and carry as described in the demonstration. No thresholds change.

gate_evidence.seen: r0238: seed 903955589 shows the plug already elevated at 2.50 s and still manipulated in the same grip at 7.90 s before it drops. The replay exposes why the tail of clearance cannot be used to timestamp the 0.13 s minimum. Passive rotation remains a separate failure.

body.text: Round-five closed-loop sensor sensitivity r0270 is complete. Imposed occlusions give median gaps 6.63 and 5.50 s versus zero nominal. All 32 incumbent pickups and all 31 turning-parent pickups persist in every paired setting, with no safety events. The incumbent has zero turns throughout. The development parent has two, four and two turns, and median grip duration 4.93, 3.44 and 3.80 s. This misses the predeclared criterion for a training change. Preserve the sensor and record longer tracking loss as an observed target-model discrepancy.

Criteria version 2 is recorded in r0273. The synthetic continuous hold now yields lift, turn, carry and placement; the same trace was scored as lift and turn only. A sub-threshold lift, broken grip before carry, and missing opposition through rotation still fail their intended checks. The copied evaluator differs only in criteria_eval.py. Rescoring the same 576 recorded deployment episodes under both versions changes one safe turn in the unsafe risk-start checkpoint and changes no lift, carry or success. The former incumbent and six-turn parent scores match. Keep earlier gates and iteration scores on their original versions. The new task registration is `suite-20261121T142913Z-obpq`, with a matched feasibility registration and fresh proof to follow.

Correction to r0275: the unchanged-trace timing comparison contains 640 recorded deployment episodes across six 64-start and two 128-start datasets. The single changed safe finger turn and zero changes to lift, carry and success are unchanged in the audit.

body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Pay the larger part of a turn bonus after real airborne target progress to discourage the demonstrated grasp from ending at the turn.
body.reflection: At endpoint 64/64 lift with no violations, stops or contract errors, but zero qualifying turns or later stages. Only 44 rest, and median opposed hold is 8.46 seconds. The late reward does not establish terminal skill from ordinary resets. End this run and retain the anchored comparison as research.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.text: r0280–r0282 close the ordinary matched phase at 61, 64 and 42 safe lifts on 64 fixed starts, with one, zero and zero turns and zero carry. The risk branch ends at 12 limit violations and the other two have none. r0283 anchored midpoint preserves three safe turns and 56 safe lifts, with four independent startup MCP2 violations and no qualifying carry. Continue the anchored branch under its predeclared stop rule. The corrected timing rescoring of all four 64-start cohorts leaves all their stage totals unchanged. Rechecking r0262 under the corrected timing finds at least 0.20 s of continued contact in eight of 13 untouched turns and 8–11 per extension-cap setting. No setting gains the 10 mm transport event. This corrects the older hold conclusion and leaves the decision against the cap unchanged.

Use the eight exact safe sampled transports from the repeated-context smoke as candidate carry reset geometry. Test states before final contact loss and only after the corrected qualifying turn, with intact grip and no table support. Consider physically feasible translations of the same grasp +75, +150 and +200 mm toward the goal and bounded initial flexion preload 0, 0.06 or 0.12 rad. Keep only states that sustain held upright clearance for six calls with the standard station and monitor, and record their checked counts. This is a curriculum diagnostic using physical states only, with no action imitation. Require at least twelve checked carry poses from at least four physical source starts before an assisted suffix probe.

After the corrected v7 feasibility proof, run a 40 minute matched PPO pair. Use the r0248 parent, v6 plant with r0273 scoring, 16 stations per branch, seed 773421, standard r0260 six-mode mix, raw std 0.12 and pickup factor 0.33, KL 0.040, eight-update screen, live turn fraction 0.80 and leave normal deployment starts untouched. In both branches cache the exact monitored prefix and end a sampled anchored suffix if the shared grip is lost, then allow up to three extra independently selected anchored suffixes before drawing again from the normal reset mix. Compare the existing turn-continuation reward to the same reward with the r0271 bounded peak joint margin. Fixed assessments at about 8, 20 and 39.5 minutes. Expect at least five safe sampled transport starts and one safe deterministic deployment turn. At midpoint stop a branch with fewer than 32 safe full lifts, no safe exact turn and no safe anchored transport. The original nonrepeating r0260 comparison keeps running at its own predeclared duration.

The r0285 carry-pose check admits 380 of 480 candidates from 40 hold samples across six source physical starts. Counts at 0, 75, 150 and 200 mm goalward shift are 96, 97, 96 and 91. Each retains legal opposed-to-held geometry with upright clearance through the six neutral monitored calls. Probe the r0248 parent and r0283 anchored midpoint on the same 32 poses, both deterministic and ordinary exploration, to measure actual assisted carries, placement suffixes and early grip retention before choosing any new curriculum.

The carry-pose probes use the same 32 checked resets for each actor and both noise settings. All 128 suffixes remain inside the hardware and contract limits. Neither actor reaches a carry or placement bonus. Median first grip loss is 0.295 s deterministic and 0.215 s stochastic for r0248, and 0.310 s and 0.260 s for r0283. These states sustain static hold but the closed-loop networks still lack transport. Keep the current curriculum comparison and reserve these physical presets as a possible later training variant.

The pose-only carry reset gives zero carries despite 380 hold-checked poses. Test whether exact live context helps. For each of the eight safe PPO transport traces, reproduce the saved start through 0.13 s after its first corrected qualifying turn, keeping the running actuator, sensor and v3 actor history. Compare r0248 and r0283 from that physical context on deterministic and fresh Gaussian suffixes. Require the reconstructed state to match the trajectory, and report intact hold duration, real goal progress and ordered carry. This is a diagnostic replay only. The saved targets provide physical history and are never regression labels or optimizer rows.

body.hypothesis: The copied v6 physics and physical controller should remain feasible under criteria version 2. The earliest valid lift completion preserves the demonstration order in the uninterrupted grasp.
body.observed: r0120: both success montages show a held carry and upright release by 10.58 s. The legacy monitor used the end of the whole lift interval. The revised check timestamps the already required first 0.13 s of qualifying clearance.
body.success_rule: every stage, at rest over the last 0.5 s (finger joint range <= 0.05 rad, palm range <= 0.005 m), hardware within limits, no stop
body.reason: first gate of this suite version: the baseline, now the incumbent

body.text: The operator extended the authoritative budget to 24 hours. At 14:43:19 UTC the clock shows 12.037 h remaining, with projected expiry near 02:45 UTC before any further target waits. Continue the same ordered protocol and stopping rule. Five target rounds are already fully reconciled. Allocate about two hours to the repeat-versus-margin study and a near-goal carry curriculum, about four hours to longer matched PPO continuations and measurement, about three hours to fresh gates and transfer-driven repairs, and protect at least one hour for the final gate, latest target reconciliation and the required final records. These workstreams can overlap and are reallocated at their predeclared checkpoints.

r0290 reproves corrected task feasibility at 18/32 fresh starts, with zero stops or hardware violations. Both failures 2075986430 and 538869152 idle beside the unchanged grounded plug in all three views. Successes 1031409660 and 132039832 keep the elevated grasp through carry and release by 10.58 s. They finish near (0.433, −0.086) and (0.428, −0.059) m at 0.006 degrees blade tilt. At 14:42 UTC started r0286 paired repeated_live and repeated_margin on GPUs 0 and 1 with the exact CPU stations. A fresh task baseline for the already delivered r0238 package is pending as gate-20261121T144206Z-m8kn. Corrected-clock cache parity remains 12/12 bitwise.

The r0289 exact live replay reproduces all eight physical prefixes across 80 trials and remains safe, but the parent and anchored actor retain half a second in only 7/40 and 6/40 respectively, with maximum additional progress 13.52 and 10.97 mm and zero carries. The r0285 left-only pose pool also has zero starts inside goal XY, because the object remains at x at least 0.4849 m even with its largest shift. Test the same actual grasp states shifted in both axes by 75, 90 and 100 percent of their geometric distance toward the fixed goal center. This should produce physically checked states already inside the goal for initial carry practice. Train only from checked positions, velocities and reset metadata, with no prior policy or feasibility action labels.

The goal-aligned r0293 preflight accepts 277 of 360 contact-preserving physical states, including 183 already inside goal XY. The 75%, 90% and 100% goalward translations retain 94, 93 and 90 states. All keep the original wrist orientation and meet monitored hold, clearance and tilt criteria. Two paired 32-pose suffix probes compare the turning parent and supported-release PPO checkpoint with deterministic and ordinary exploration. The begin-in-goal resets will remain assisted measurements.

body.hypothesis: Re-establish the last accepted and delivered PPO package as the baseline under the corrected lift timestamp. The package and training simulator are identical to r0238.
body.observed: r0238: seed 903955589 retains an opposed grasp at 7.90 s and drops by 10.58 s, then remains sideways and outside the goal. Seed 426086772 drops before 5.22 s. The timing correction preserves those outcomes in the absence of a valid turn and carry.

body.text: r0295 is the corrected task-suite baseline for the already-delivered r0238 manifest. All 64 fresh starts lift and rest with no stops or hardware violations, but none qualifies a turn or later stage. In the first failure montage seed 217464613 holds at 2.50 s and the plug is grounded by 5.22 s. Seed 343638490 holds at 2.50 s, has already returned the plug to the table by about 5.22 s and separates by 7.90 s. Measured relative rotations are 33.5 and 37.6 degrees. Both finish sideways near y −0.38 m. Use these two montage failures for the next task gate hypothesis. Target [redacted] reviewed the same delivered package, with six lifts and no completion.

Profiling three exact v7 PPO rollouts with compiled arm IK attributes 11.58 of 30.54 instrumented CPU seconds to the live contract monitor, including 6.77 seconds to its palm FK. The earlier r0226 wrapper compiled only shape (7,), but the installed monitor calls its FK with shape (1, 7), so it silently used the stock function. Support this existing batched singleton shape in the training-only wrapper. Require bitwise equality for states and decisions on 16 paired full runs and at least 1.15 times median unprofiled speed before adoption. Keep the stock monitor active and leave the frozen evaluator and installed files untouched.

Start a 46-minute PPO trial of the supported lowering transition using the r0177 checkpoint, critic and Adam. In the r0294 paired probe this actor pays the held in-goal carry bonus on 22/32 deterministic and 20/32 stochastic assisted starts, but no touchdown. It previously completed 15/16 supported-release suffixes. Following the reverse reset idea of https://proceedings.mlr.press/v78/florensa17a.html, replace only the carry-stage reset geometry in the earlier ramp from r0178 with the 183 monitored in-goal grasp states, and keep the other reset groups. Use its six-mode mix 0.29/0.05/0.07/0.04/0.40/0.15, seed 3298745, std 0.12, KL 0.040, fixed 600-call deployment episodes, r0177 bounds and v6 exact CPU physics with corrected criteria. Allocate 16 instead of 24 stations alongside the other studies. Check fixed64 deployment and matched16 carry and release suffixes at ages 8, 22 and 45.5 minutes. Advance on at least eight safe supported touch-down suffixes, 12 release completions and 32 deployment lifts. At midpoint stop if zero safe touchdown, no improvement of held geometry and fewer than 32 safe deployment lifts. This experiment uses physical qpos and qvel resets, without action imitation.

The original live pre-turn PPO run reaches its endpoint. On its fixed 64 deployments it lifts 61 and turns safely in five, with no hardware violations, stops or contract errors, zero ordered carry and only 24 terminal rests. Run 128 new paired complete starts with the active r0295 baseline under corrected scoring and a separate 512-start 1.5-second startup margin census. Also probe the previous physical failure starts with fresh sensing. Consider a turn gate only if safety is clean and the paired start results preserve lift. The earlier 38-minute live run remains separate from the repeat-sampling pair.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Keep exact monitored turn contexts during PPO to expose physical held transport transitions.
body.reflection: The 38-minute endpoint safely lifts 61/64 and turns in five fixed starts with zero hardware violations, stops or contract errors. It rests in 24/64. Fixed carry and completion are zero. Near-limit replay with fresh sensing exposes one of 24 earlier-risk violations and two of 24 fresh ones, so the actor remains development-only while the independent complete and safety screens finish.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing
domain_randomization.distribution: supplied default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with occlusion measured by ray-capsule visibility and independently seeded delay, noise, two-sided orientation flips and dropout

domain_randomization.name: physical reset perturbations
domain_randomization.distribution: prechecked intermediate qpos and qvel with up to ±8 mm xy and ±0.12 rad yaw on world rigid transforms, perturbed mechanics

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves.

Compare ±3 mm X or Y and +2 or +6 mm Z, holding policy weights and decoding fixed. Include physical incursions 283910588, 1394105071 and 914579041 in the targeted sample, with ordinary fresh starts separately. No ramp goes forward without zero targeted and fresh events and clean independent startup and full-episode rechecks.

reward_terms.name: carry

reward_terms.name: touchdown

reward_terms.name: release

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers

reward_terms.name: slip

reward_terms.name: action_rate

reward_terms.name: failure

reward_terms.name: enclosed

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: A small peak joint margin penalty should improve loaded startup safety without sacrificing the repeat curriculum's new turn signal.
body.reflection: The midpoint has 51 safe lifts, four turns, 54 rests, five joint limit excursions and zero carry or success. Fixed safety is worse than the matched control at this checkpoint. Continue under the predeclared minimum first-stage condition.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: joint_margin
reward_terms.formula: One signed decrease for each worsening measured finger joint excursion beyond 0.006 rad, normalized by the remaining 0.014 rad to the allowed physical overrun. Episode penalty is bounded at 1.30. No rate, command or activity credit.

domain_randomization.name: finger grip

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.joint_margin: Adds a bounded training penalty for increasing the maximum physical finger overrun inside the allowed tolerance. Contract, criteria and decoder are unchanged.

body.text: The r0300 full independent candidate check under corrected criteria has 120 lifts, 11 qualifying turns, no carry and five hardware violations over 128 starts. Its 512 fresh startup prefixes also have five violations with peak excursion 0.02412 rad. All seven r0302 ramp variants still fail targeted preflight, with 2–10 recorded violations. `None` advances to a gate. The r0286 midpoint controls continue because safe full lifts remain 52/64 and 51/64 with six and four safe turns.

The r0305 lower-state check accepts 353 of 480 physical poses. Across 96 deterministic continuations from 9, 13, 18 and 24 mm bottom clearance, both PPO actors remain safe and have zero supported touchdowns. Every one of their first palm targets rises: medians +6.77 mm for r0177 and +5.36 mm for r0306. Probe symmetric Gaussian widening in only the vertical raw-action coordinate while holding the plug in goal on assisted carry resets. Compare ordinary noise with 4 and 7 times that coordinate scale, using identical physical and sensor seeds. Test whether at least six additional safe monitored touchdowns appear without more than two additional safety events. This affects exploration only. A PPO continuation would use the exact per-coordinate variance in its likelihood and KL.

The paired 128-start comparison finishes. r0295 lifts and rests on 128/128 without safety events, while r0300 has 120 lifts, 11 exact turns, 44 rests and five violations. Retain r0295. Test whether its robust early actor can continue directly from the 36 exact monitored r0248 pre-turn prefixes, at zero, 0.33 and ordinary stochastic exploration. The earlier actor supplies only the physical and causal reset context. No prefix action trains the current actor. This will inform a pickup-preserving, single-actor PPO continuation once the repeat-sampling studies finish.

r0310 widening vertical exploration gives zero, zero and zero safe touchdown for r0177 and two, zero and three for r0306, with no added safety events. This misses six additional touchdowns. Inspecting the reward reveals that the signed lift potential in [redacted] still pays rising clearance to 45 mm, including inside the goal before its 0.10 s dwell. The observed first commanded rise can earn that term while delaying lower contact. Test a task-phase correction. Inside the goal during [redacted], use a signed held clearance band with a lower ramp from 8 to 12 mm, full value through 16 mm, and a modest outward slope for excess clearance. No credit accrues for holding steady. Lowering and support bonuses still require the ordered carry, and the final criteria are unchanged. Preflight held, random and successful exact traces before a continuation.

Stop r0298 at its planned midpoint. Checkpoint 0593 has 14/64 safe deployment lifts versus 42 at the earlier checkpoint, zero turns or carry, 39 rests and no safety events. Its fixed supported release passes 16/16, but the 16 airborne carry starts still have zero supported contacts and median clear hold regresses from 0.350 to 0.235 s. The measured carry-stage improvement condition is unmet. Archive the scheduled midpoint and reserve its station group for the task-phase clearance reward after preflight.

The robust r0295 actor safely continues to a qualifying turn in six of 36 exact r0248 pre-turn contexts deterministically and five of 36 under ordinary exploration, with no held transport yet. Keep its existing actor weights as the parent for a longer paired PPO test after r0286 ends. Both use the verified compiled-monitor optimization, the same repeated anchored curriculum, unchanged r0295 package start and action caps, and the existing 8-update pickup screen. The variant also limits mean conditional actor KL on true full-reset steps before the first lift to 0.008, with the ordinary full-rollout limit 0.040 in both. This constrains the PPO update only. The eight-update integration smoke records maximum applied whole and pre-lift KL 0.039993 and 0.002127. Allocate 90 minutes, 16 stations per run, seed 773421, raw std 0.12 and pickup scale 0.33. Fixed64 at 12, 32, 55 and 89 minutes. Expect safe deterministic turns while retaining at least 58 safe lifts. At 32 minutes stop for fewer than 48 safe lifts, zero safe turns and no held transport or geometry gain. Independent safety and the task gate decide any change.

With the evaluator lift timestamp corrected, rerun the three r0197 complete CPU feasibility command traces in four MuJoCo Warp copies each. This diagnostic tests whether the prior zero GPU supported placements was entirely a scoring-timing artifact or reflects later physics. Keep the CPU and GPU action streams identical. Before any GPU Training use, still require outcome parity on matched full starts, demonstrably usable later contact behavior, and contract monitoring during rollout. CPU PPO remains the active method.

body.text: The r0312 clearance reward preflight passes. All three complete witnesses preserve stage bonuses with total returns 57.481 to 57.826, three still rollouts return zero and all random rollouts are negative. The six-update PPO test also passes. Start 58 minutes from the same r0177 actor, critic and optimizer as r0298, with the same in-goal carry pool, r0177 action and start bounds, 16 stations, seed 3298745, standard raw std 0.12, reset mix and KL 0.040. In-training change is the low clearance band. Use the bitwise verified monitored FK acceleration. Fixed64 plus fixed16 carry and release suffixes at 8, 22, 45 and 57 minutes. At 22 minutes close if fewer than 32 lifts, zero safe supported touchdowns and no improved held lowering. Advance on eight safe supported touchdowns, 12 release suffixes and 32 safe full lifts.

r0315 corrected-timing Warp replays give 12 lifts, four turns, four carries and one supported placement across 12 complete command trajectories, with all 12 rest checks and zero hardware or contract events. The exact CPU witnesses each complete, and all four GPU replicas of seed 32012322 miss the turn. Six GPU endpoints are upright, including five without a verified supported placement. The clock scoring correction leaves the late-motion discrepancy. Keep exact monitored CPU training. Also confirmed the r0314 guard binds a synthetic PPO update that passes the global cap but exceeds pre-lift KL. It backtracks to global 0.0008 and pre-lift 0.008.

The r0314 paired runs `incumbent_repeat_run` and `incumbent_prelift_run` started at 15:22–15:23 UTC after both r0286 optimizers finished. The r0317 goal-clearance run started at 15:19. Independent corrected replay of 55 saved safe r0286 control training transitions confirms all 55, with median post-turn hold 0.62 s and goalward progress 13.88 mm, maximum 26.64 mm. The paired margin run has 14 audited starts with median hold 0.55 s and progress 12.20 mm, maximum 18.43 mm. Neither reaches carry. Fixed r0286 endpoint assessments are pending.

The r0286 control learned many assisted 10 mm moves, but the current large turn-continuation bonus finishes paying at that point and ordinary carry progress then weighs 3.5 per 280 mm. Test a further signed physical potential, beginning only below 35 degrees tilt after an exact turn and 0.20 s of continuous clear hand support. It increases from zero at 10 mm goalward motion to at most three by 55 mm. Refund on lost grasp before carry, keep credited progress only after the actual carry condition is achieved, and give no extra credit for static holding or for table motion. Keep the existing exact turn, 10 mm and ordered carry bonuses. Preflight complete, static, random and partial learned traces before considering a trial.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.turn_continuation: Uses the exact-window turn event. Forty percent pays immediately and the balance requires 0.20 s continuous opposed-to-held transport with 10 mm real progress and endpoint tilt at most 35 degrees.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Test whether a bounded peak joint margin term preserves safety in the repeated pre-turn curriculum.
body.reflection: The fixed endpoint has 57 safe lifts, one turn, 37 rests and two joint limit excursions in separate episodes. Zero carry and placement. The variant has fewer sampled held transport events than the matched control and fails deployment safety. End the planned trial.

body.text: r0324 loses its initial carry grasp after a median 0.240 s on the 16 assisted cases. At update 500, 554 of 556 selected carry episodes occupied all 600 calls, no carry episode touched down, and the typical observed opposed hold is about 0.31 s. The balanced PPO batch is therefore filled with far more post-drop transitions than usable lowering transitions when these states are drawn. I am probing a bounded repeat curriculum, stopping an assisted carry when its initial grip ends without qualified support, then using a new checked physical state and sensor seed. Ordered case checks distinguish valid support and release from a drop followed by recontact. Contract monitors still consume each full action. Normal deployment and supported-release episodes retain 600 calls. No network input or package behavior changes.

The 12-update repeated carry smoke completes 171 assisted attempts, 159 repeat resets and a median 13 calls in place of 600, with zero safety or contract events and zero touchdown. A three-second paired diagnostic applies a symmetric comparison of unchanged and downward raw vertical outputs only while the initial near-goal grip remains. On 32 identical lower starts, offsets 0, -0.70 and -1.35 give 0, 0 and 4 continuous supported touchdowns. All 96 remain safe. The four reach support at 0.21–0.23 s from three 13 mm resets and one 9 mm reset, then none achieves release. Unmodified first targets rise in all 32, median +5.86 mm, and held clearance rises 12.46 mm by the last held row. This isolates vertical control as a contributor while grip and release continue to matter. These diagnostic offsets are excluded from PPO and deployment. Evidence research/simulation/goal_clearance_band_vertical_offset.json and research/learning/carry_attempts_smoke.

The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
