checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Under the same exact repeat curriculum the extra pre-lift PPO update constraint should reduce pickup regression and retain safety while allowing post-lift learning.
body.reflection: At 12 minutes, 59/64 fixed deployment starts lift safely and 64 rest. There is no exact turn, later stage, hardware event, stop or contract event. Median clear opposition is 1.13 s among lifts. The paired control has stronger held geometry at this time. Continue to the predeclared midpoint.

body.text: r0330 reached 55 safe lifts, so the r0317 branch continues under the preregistered rule. Its fixed carry starts have a median 51.37 mm initial clearance and only 0.235 s of continuous opposed hold. The r0326 support witnesses start at 9–13 mm. I am using the lightly loaded fourth device for a 42-minute eight-worker exploratory curriculum branch. Batch two curriculum changes and name their effects separately: use only the 353 lower physically checked carry resets at 9, 13, 18 and 24 mm, and use up to 16 fresh attempts after irreversible early grip loss. Keep the r0317 parent, Adam, reward, nominal reset weights, action limits, and physics. Scale minibatch to 256 for the smaller rollout. Fixed64 plus two 16-case suffix sets at 8, 20 and 41 minutes. Use matched low starts for the candidate and parent. Stop at 20 for zero safe supported touchdowns, less than 4 mm improved held descent and fewer than 32 safe lifts. Advance at eight safe supported touchdowns, at least 12 supported release completions and 32 safe full lifts. Also yield the lane if ordinary branch throughput falls more than 20 percent for five minutes. No diagnostic actions enter batches.

The post-turn grasp audit compares 55 physically monitored partial PPO continuations with 24 local exact completions from the feasibility controller. All PPO turns start with only thumb and middle finger, and none adds ring or little through 0.45 s. Their median thumb and middle housing contacts are at local z +2.88 and +20.62 mm at 0.20 s. The complete group has thumb median z -21.80 mm, middle median +15.85 mm where present, and ring contact on 17/24, chiefly on blades. Complete motions initially move a median 5.65 mm away from the goal, consistent with a regrasp. The r0007 inferred human ring patch is near z -16 mm in turn and carry, with the thumb above center. A precise ring housing patch would therefore encode an embodiment-specific mismatch. I will score the signed development of thumb/opposing longitudinal support across the plug center during true late turning and carry, allowing either orientation and any opposing digit. Derive the scale from the demonstrated span, use a finite tolerance and refund on grip loss. Require zero still return and preserve complete witnessed bonuses. Feasibility commands are diagnostic only. Evidence research/simulation/transport_grasp_comparison_housing.json and reconstruction_contact_guide_audit.json.

The first instantaneous support-span prototype earns a transient 1.6 in each exact complete replay but loses it when the final manipulation changes contacts. Preserve peak potential only within the same unsupported grip and retain it when that grip reaches supported touchdown; a hand-contact interruption cancels it. The revised replay gives all seven original stage bonuses on each of three complete physical witnesses, net new credit +1.6, zero total on three holds, and negative random returns unchanged. Four partial PPO continuations have no measured support-span progress and gain zero. Their shared physical start limits this comparison. A 14-update monitored PPO smoke is running to assess live feature and reward availability. No parameters have been selected or gated.

The broad carry curriculum has 1713 stage-3 states, 25 below y -0.23 m and none below -0.2362 m. The current anchored PPO continuations start at pickup and have no more than 26.64 mm of verified progress. That leaves most of the early transport workspace unsampled in the assisted carry objective. I will screen unlabeled physical positions and velocities from the first continuous transport segment of the 24 local exact completion witnesses. Retain only a six-call monitor-clean neutral hold with clearance, safe contacts and independent sensor start. Use it first to measure whether the current actor can continue that grasp. The feasibility controller completes 18/32 in the registered suite; its commands and network labels are excluded.

The support-span reward completed 14 monitored PPO updates. Among 235 sampled anchored segments there are 127 exact turn events, seven measured transport starts, zero carries and zero safety events. Span progress appears at two updates and reverses when the grip breaks. The net new credit is negative 0.52495 over all segments because some exact prefixes already supplied a positive support potential before the PPO suffix began. Fresh standalone still traces remain zero. I will compare this mechanism with the distance reward once a full-size lane opens. Evidence research/learning/longitudinal_support_smoke and research/simulation/longitudinal_support_reward_preflight.json.

Early carry reset screening retains 259 of 384 candidate positions and velocities from 23 physical starts. Six neutral policy calls pass with safe hand contact and clearance. New reset y ranges -0.395 to -0.235 m, median -0.302 m. On 32 matched cases per condition, r0248 retains hand contact for 0.08 s median deterministically and 0.10 s with ordinary noise, with qualifying opposed-clear spans of about 0.03 s. It advances 10 mm on 11 and ten cases, with one safe 62.0 mm diagnostic and no in-goal carry. r0295 gives 0.11 s median hand contact at both settings, 10 and six cases with 10 mm progress, maximum 33.9 mm and zero safety events. The single stochastic r0248 safety event is retained in the local evidence. These are assisted geometry tests. The contact contrast points to the initial neural commands as a contributor, and the pool is available for a future curriculum trial. Evidence research/simulation/early_transport_curriculum.json and early_transport_*_probe.json.

At the first r0331 checkpoint, 3663 of 3887 shortened assisted carry episodes receive the four-point clear in-goal carry bonus and every episode breaks the grasp before support. Median total return is +0.433 despite zero touchdowns. This is a direct reward shortcut in the assisted distribution. I will preflight withholding carry credit until the same held grip reaches supported tabletop contact, with unchanged geometry, dense movement, pickup and release rewards. The three full verified witnesses should preserve all stage rewards. Uninterrupted carried progress still has its signed horizontal and lowering terms. Use this preflight and the separate symmetric vertical exploration test before selecting the next lowering trial.

The disjoint 48-case lower-goal probe compares the r0177 PPO actor with symmetric vertical Gaussian exploration scaled by 1, 5 and 10 only during assisted held lowering. All 144 trials remain safe. Continuous supported touchdowns increase from 0 to 4 to 12 of 48, with exact training reward touchdowns matching and zero releases. First downward wrist targets are 0, 12 and 18. The 10x factor produces a measurable source of successful contacts while leaving the unshifted Gaussian center. I will add the optional training sampler and use the actual per-axis conditional variance in PPO likelihood and KL. Deployment and evaluation use the ordinary deterministic actor. Evidence research/simulation/low_goal_vertical_exploration_extended.json.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Repeated exact pre-turn resets from r0295 should advance the held turn without sacrificing safe pickup.
body.reflection: At 32 minutes, 61/64 fixed starts lift safely, 60 rest and 11 meet both standard rotation magnitudes. Held opposition median is 2.36 s among lifts. Best eligible angular geometry has 35.68 degrees blade tilt. Zero exact turns, carry, placement or safety events. Continue under the recorded rule.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.text: The 14-update vertical PPO smoke uses 546 scaled vertical actions of 3584 and bounds applied analytic KL at 0.039942. Two of 47 assisted segments reach supported touchdown and remain safe; there is one safety violation after another touchdown. Neither safe touchdown completes release. A separate reward replay keeps all stage bonuses on three complete skill traces, with holds at zero and random returns negative. The paired assisted reward audit uses identical actions and states from checkpoint 0308: old carry bonuses on 15/16, new carry bonuses zero when all 16 lose the grasp. Median return changes -0.614 to -4.614, and every non-carry term and contact event matches. Evidence research/learning/goal_vertical_exploration_smoke and research/simulation/supported_carry_*preflight.json. Prepare a matched longer vertical exploration trial, leaving the alternative carry-credit reward for a distinct comparison.

The unchanged r0331 low-reset branch obtains its first monitored supported touchdowns after checkpoint 0308. By update 497, seven assisted trials from four physical starts earn the touchdown event, avoid an earlier grip break and complete 600 calls without safety or contract problems. Two also earn a half-second stable release bonus during the episode, but none keeps the full placed-and-rested suffix at the end. A distinct eighth touchdown trial exceeds a finger limit later and is excluded. This is measurable training progress, so keep the planned fixed midpoint and track final release stability independently. Evidence research/learning/short_carry_attempts_run/episodes.jsonl.

A paired early-carry reset diagnostic tests preload 0, 0.06 and 0.12 rad under the same r0248 actor and reset cases. All 96 run safely. Median continuous hand contact increases from 0.085 s to 0.220 and 0.285 s. At least 10 mm goalward progress is 11, 11 and 17 of 32. Maximum progress falls from 62.0 mm to 41.3 and 39.9 mm, so this is a grasp-duration signal with a mixed long-travel result. The preload acts only on initial physics and is excluded from deployed actions. Preserve ordinary starts and use a separate checked reset comparison before any allocation. Evidence research/simulation/early_transport_preload_probe.json.

Checkpoint r0339 now gives 10, 8 and 8 safe exact turns in the 36 monitored pre-turn contexts at exploration scales 0, 0.33 and 1, against r0295 6, 5 and 5. All 108 are safe. No 10 mm transitions. Use r0339 as the common parent for the next matched 65-minute reward pair after the r0317 lane is free, eight exact CPU workers per branch. Compare r0320 distance credit and r0332 longitudinal support against their shared turn-continuation base. Same deployment start, action bounds, seed, 256 minibatch, episode bias, ordinary settings, cache, three repeat attempts, eight-update pickup screen, and original physical reset mix. Both PPO critics and optimizers start afresh. Fixed64 at 10, 25, 45 and 64 minutes. At 25 stop a branch with zero safe exact turns and no new held transport if it also lacks either 48 safe lifts or any improvement in eligible turn geometry or its measured assisted reward. Progress should show turns first and then longer uninterrupted real carry. Evidence research/simulation/live_turn_incumbent_repeat_midpoint_probe.json.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: A signed low clearance window should help held lowering after arrival while preserving full acquisition.
body.reflection: At 45 minutes, 16/64 full starts lift, 23 rest and zero turn or continue. Twenty-six other starts exceed the lower middle MCP2 limit during loaded supported pickup at 0.28–0.35 s, largest substep excursion 0.02805 rad. There are zero stops or contract issues. All 16 assisted carry starts meet the carry geometry and clear hold improves to 1.025 s median, with zero supported touchdown. Separate release completion regresses to three of 16. The predeclared endpoint is pending.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed opposed clearance as in the original reward through lift and turn. During carry inside goal XY, value rises from zero to one across 8–12 mm true bottom clearance, remains one through 16 mm, and decreases by at most one half over the next 45 mm. The goal band requires uninterrupted airborne hand contact and pays only changes in the object state. Carry dwell and supported set-down conditions are unchanged.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.text: Reproduced all eight r0347 deterministic supported touchdowns with identical contact times and rewards. `True` contact occurs at 0.31–0.61 s while tilted 25.68–33.62 degrees. All leave the goal behind its y edge by the end, finishing between y -0.1784 and -0.1146 m. Six stand upright and two lie sideways. Every case has no hand contact in the final window, and five exceed the final encoder range limit. Median peak after-touchdown planar drift is 62.16 mm, minimum 39.55 mm, versus 14.38 mm median and 29.86 mm maximum in 24 exact complete feasibility traces. I will preflight a signed post-support planar loss for moving outside the goal or crossing a 30 mm displacement tolerance from the supported event. It measures object movement only and leaves the full stage tests unchanged. Training also has two safe 600-call assisted sequences with all final suffix rewards by update 845. Evidence research/learning/short_carry_attempts_eval/checkpoint_0690/eval/assisted_touchdowns and research/simulation/supported_planar_drift_audit.json.

The supported planar shaping passes replay preflight. All three full exact skill traces keep every bonus and earn zero new loss, as do the static holds. All bounded-random returns stay negative and unchanged. The eight r0347 drift logs receive between -1.46 and -6.00 by the same formula. This isolates a stable-placement error after continuous touchdown. The option is confined to the trainer and will be compared from an actor with verified assisted lowering. A 12-update integration smoke is running. Keep the vertical exploration and deferred carry reward as separately measured changes.

The 58-minute r0317 run ended at checkpoint 2106. Its scheduled 57-minute evaluation is still completing. The r0345 matched reward pair has started in the freed lane at about 16:18 UTC as from0744_distance_run and from0744_support_run. First monitored updates complete with no safety event. Both starts use the exact r0339 PPO weights and package, the matched configuration in r0345, and a fresh critic and optimizer. The planar-loss smoke initially failed before simulation due to a missing reward index map. After correcting the map, all 12 updates complete with four safe assisted touchdowns in 31 attempts, zero safety events and nonzero measured loss, with no terminal placement. No smoke checkpoint is promoted.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.text: Viewed the early assisted set-down renders for reset indices 4585 and 4803. Fingers remain around the plug as it approaches upright support, with no prompt clean release. The eight traces leave the goal 0.08 to 0.84 s after touchdown, median 0.41 s. Five are still hand-contacting on the boundary crossing and all eight had hand contact in the prior 0.10 s. The wrist has moved a median 22.9 mm toward pickup by that crossing. Last contact happens 0.65 to 1.42 s after the crossing. These data support a post-touchdown object-motion term. The shorter curriculum has five assisted full suffix events on five distinct starts as of update 1068. Evidence research/learning/short_carry_attempts_eval/checkpoint_0690/eval/assisted_touchdowns.

After r0331 ends, select between the fixed midpoint and endpoint by safe continuous touchdown followed by final carry-suffix placement and pickup safety. Run a matched 65-minute continuation pair from the selected actor and saved Adam and critic. Four exact CPU workers per branch fit the released lane. Both keep the 9–24 mm carry states, 16 bounded attempts, original reset weights, 96-call rollout length, std 0.12 and applied KL 0.040. Use 128-sample minibatches. One branch uses the existing goal-clearance-band reward and the other changes only the r0349 planar loss. Fixed full64 and 16 carry plus 16 separate release starts near 10, 26, 45 and 64 minutes. At 26 stop a branch if zero safe deterministic carry placements, fewer than six safe final upright goal states in its 16 carry cases, and zero safe complete carry suffixes in the last third of its new training rows. Expect more supported releases inside the actual goal, with a follow-up acquisition-preserving curriculum still required if full safety regresses. No phase advances on assisted scores alone.

The paired lateral-support diagnostic replays r0347 with identical physics and normal actor commands through all eight supported touchdowns. After each touchdown, holding only the last commanded palm y produces seven upright endpoints in the goal versus zero previously, and three of eight assisted 20-second placement rewards versus zero. All eight remain safe and upright. The one remaining endpoint is 1.0 mm outside the near y boundary. This isolates rearward commanded palm motion as a contributor. The intervention is diagnostic only. No modified controls enter the actor, PPO samples or any package. Evidence research/learning/short_carry_attempts_eval/checkpoint_0690/eval/assisted_touchdowns/diagnostic_lateral_hold.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: The standard PPO trust region with repeated exact pre-turn contexts should increase safe turns from r0295.
body.reflection: At the 55-minute checkpoint 51/64 full starts lift safely and 48 rest. Nineteen meet both standard rotation magnitudes, zero meet the continuous exact turn or later stages, and six other starts have loaded middle MCP2 excursions. No stops or contract errors. Median lifted hold is 1.69 s. Continue to the recorded endpoint.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed opposed clearance as in the original reward through lift and turn. During carry inside goal XY, value rises from zero to one across 8–12 mm true bottom clearance, remains one through 16 mm, and decreases by at most one half over the next 45 mm. The goal band requires uninterrupted airborne hand contact and pays only changes in the object state. Carry dwell and supported set-down conditions are unchanged.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.

body.text: In r0359, the distance branch first assisted transport example was logged after checkpoint 0232. Its checkpoint-bounded totals are 112 safe anchored segments, 38 exact turns and zero transport starts. r0360 through checkpoint 0224 has 120 safe segments, 45 exact turns and two measured transport starts. Both fixed deployment sets are safe and have zero exact turn. A separate physical reset bank now connects 232 checked early transport states at y -0.395 to -0.235, 232 existing intermediate carry states and 353 checked low in-goal carry states. Initial 0.12 rad preload is present only for the early group. All 259 early candidates pass safety checks and 232 hold the full six calls. The bank changes training state coverage only. A disjoint paired probe will test the early preload with the safe r0295 actor before a training allocation.

The r0314 pre-lift trust region has 61/64 safe lifts at both 32 and 55 minutes and clean fixed safety at all three checks, while its paired control loses pickup safety at 55 minutes. It produces few strong turn geometries. The r0237 held-turn PPO surrogate weighting passed integration smoke and has not had a measured long run. Once the original r0314 lanes free, allocate 85 minutes with 16 exact CPU stations to the r0314 pre-lift configuration from r0295, changing only the opposed airborne turn surrogate weight from one to six, normalized by batch mean. Keep the critic and analytic KL unweighted, including the 0.008 pre-lift cap. Use the same reset pool, seeds and standard rollout settings. Fixed cohorts at 10, 28, 52 and 84 minutes. Stop at 28 if fewer than 48 safe lifts with zero exact safe turns and no eligible held geometry gain. A stage gain with clean independent safety is required before a task gate.

In a disjoint 48-state early-carry comparison with r0295, all 192 probe rollouts are safe. With initial preload 0.12, median continuous hand contact rises from 0.125 to 0.260 s deterministically and 0.175 to 0.255 s with ordinary noise. Ten millimeters of real goalward travel rises 21 to 28 and 24 to 26, and one case per preload condition crosses 60 mm, versus none at zero preload. reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed opposed clearance as in the original reward through lift and turn. During carry inside goal XY, value rises from zero to one across 8–12 mm true bottom clearance, remains one through 16 mm, and decreases by at most one half over the next 45 mm. reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: An opposed longitudinal contact potential should encourage held regrasp and longer transport.
body.reflection: At 25 minutes, 56 full starts lift and 54 rest, all with clean safety. Zero exact turns and later stages. The original two assisted transport events stand with no additional occurrence and no carry. Best exact-window angular deficit regresses to 55.56 degrees. End under the recorded rule.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: longitudinal_support
reward_terms.formula: Signed increase in the best opposed contact span straddling the plug center along its blade axis in the same unsupported grip. The demonstrated span supplies a 4–16 mm one-sided depth band, with continuous weighting between 45 and 25 degrees of blade tilt. Any opposing digit and either contact orientation can contribute. The potential is refunded on early loss and retained at valid supported touchdown.

The control is exported once and the second case resumes from 25 completed fixed seeds, both in detached monitored evaluations. The r0362 and r0363 runs started around 16:53 UTC as weighted_turn_run and weighted_carry_curriculum_run. They use the same r0295 PPO parent, exact deployment bytes, the checked pre-lift KL cap and the same opposed-airborne PPS sampling weights. Their curricula are the only matched difference. Both first updates complete without a safety event.

The median sum of the old pickup and turn terms is six, and median overall return is +1.418 despite zero final placements. Earlier stage payouts therefore subsidize an unrelated retry in the release curriculum. Preflight suppressing rewards from stages that were supplied by an assisted reset, with the same active physical dynamics, safe full horizon and complete deployment reward. Supported release retains its own stability and final-placement credit and ordinary safety penalties. The original runtime policy does not change.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

body.text: Stop both r0353 branches at the preregistered 26-minute criterion. The control and planar potential have 11 and nine safe geometric assisted touchdowns at their fixed checkpoints. Both have zero carried placements, zero safe final goal states on those carry starts, and zero safe complete carry suffixes in the last third of training rows. The separately supported release control gets one of 16, with two other hardware events. Variant gets zero of 16 with none. Full deployment gives 15 and 16 safe lifts with 21 and ten hardware events respectively, and no turn. Preserve both measured midpoint packages and end their later evaluations. The next release study will test upstream credit suppression from the earlier release-capable r0177 PPO actor.

The assisted-stage credit preflight preserves all full witness bonuses and identical hold/random returns. Under matched physical release actions, duplicate pickup credit falls 12/16 to zero and median return falls +1.171 to -2.642. The r0177 actor preserves all 15/16 safe supported-release placements and median return +15.480. A 12-update real-monitor smoke completes with one supported-release suffix success and zero safety events. Allocate 58 minutes on eight exact CPU stations from r0177, restoring its critic and Adam and matching r0331 physical pool, reset mix, seed, action bounds, sixteen carry attempts and PPO settings. The only reward change is omitting upstream credits on late assisted resets. Fixed64 plus matched 16 carry and 16 release suffixes near 9, 26, 44 and 57 minutes. Stop at 26 for fewer than eight safe continuous touchdowns, fewer than 12 safe supported-release placements and zero complete safe carried suffixes in recent training. Seek preservation of release while lowering is learned. Full deployment safety and task tests still gate any advancement.

The r0248 PPO actor has retained exact deterministic turns and still fails a few loaded middle MCP2 starts. Previous package tests varied pose translations and command bounds. Compare only optional start-palm yaw by -4, -2, +2 and +4 degrees, leaving the package weights, target bounds and palm translation unchanged. A small world-z orientation change could reduce lateral finger load during ground enclosure. Use 32 matched two-second prefixes per variant, eight physical starts including the three observed independent hardware cases and four sensor seeds each. Advance yaw only if all targeted starts are clean and at least 28 of 32 fresh starts lift safely. Then require independent 512-prefix and 128-full-start safety, plus preservation of at least five of the ten known turns before a gate. No installed asset is edited.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: The unchanged low-carry control establishes the placement learning expected from the same actor and starts.
body.reflection: At 26 minutes, 15 safe full lifts and 34 rests of 64, with 21 other hardware violations and no later stages or stops. Eleven of 16 assisted starts reach safe continuous touchdown and none finishes upright in goal. One of 16 separately supported starts meets final placement, with two other safety events. No completed held carried suffix in recent training. End under r0377.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: continued_transport
reward_terms.formula: Signed net goalward movement after the exact turn, beginning at 10 mm and reaching full weight at 55 mm. Requires at least 0.20 s of uninterrupted hand contact without external support, 8 mm bottom clearance and blade tilt no more than 35 degrees. Early grip loss refunds the potential. A valid carry ends this term.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing
domain_randomization.distribution: supplied default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with occlusion measured by ray-capsule visibility and independently seeded delay, noise, two-sided orientation flips and dropout

domain_randomization.name: physical reset perturbations

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.continued_transport: After an exact turn and the held transition, shape 10–55 mm of goalward movement. The loss of the same unsupported grasp refunds transient credit until the carry predicate is achieved.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Upweight opposed airborne turn transitions while maintaining the established pre-lift PPO trust region.
body.reflection: At ten minutes the weighted control has 58 safe full lifts and 62 rests, zero exact turns, later stages or hardware events. Median opposed hold among lifts is 2.435 s. Eleven of 16 early assisted carries move at least 10 mm and best is 44.04 mm. Low assisted carries have zero supported touchdown and 13 separate supported release starts finish placed. Continue to the common midpoint.

body.text: The +6 degree start leaves two targeted hardware events. The +8 and +10 degree variants pass all 32 targeted prefixes with zero contract problems or stops, peak measured overrun 0.01432 and 0.01547 rad respectively. Both now receive matched 32 fresh full starts from a disjoint seed and the ten previously safe turn starts. Only a variant retaining the declared pickup and turn thresholds proceeds to the 512 independent startup and 128 independent full screens. Evidence research/learning/yaw_start_probe/extended_yaw_prefixes.json.

Close the r0379 startup yaw diagnostic. Both +8 and +10 degrees clear the 32 targeted two-second prefixes and pass package validation. On an independent 32-start full check they lift safely on 25 and 21 starts, with 28 and 25 rest passes and no hardware, stop or contract events. On the ten previously safe exact-turn seeds each lifts on all ten and neither reproduces a turn. Both miss the preregistered pickup and turn thresholds. Keep the incumbent startup pose and end the branch. Full and paired results are in research/learning/yaw_start_probe.

The exact CPU profile spends material time in the five Python-to-MuJoCo substep calls and repeated hand speed and limit arrays. Test a native training-only loop against the current compiled-IK and compiled-monitor-FK baseline. Use paired deterministic new pickup starts, the existing exact turn and hardware-limit starts, and up to eight complete feasibility command replays. The latter are diagnostics only and provide no policy updates. Require bitwise matching trace fields, all safety and criterion decisions, and at least 1.08 median single-process CPU speedup before training adoption. No model, station constants, sensor, reward, policy interface or registered evaluator changes.

The current anchored turn bank comes from r0248 and selects near-turn outcomes. Test whether the incumbent r0295 presents a different turning opportunity just after its own robust pickup. On 64 new training-only physical draws select up to three boundaries 30, 180 and 400 ms after the first continuous opposed lift, with blades still tilted 55 to 87 degrees. Selection uses observed physics through the lift and no later turn success condition. Restore the exact history, delayed sensor and actuator state, then measure both PPO actors on 32 matched boundaries with mean, reduced and ordinary exploration. Use no prefix steps for the optimizer.
