reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed opposed clearance as in the original reward through lift and turn. During carry inside goal XY, value rises from zero to one across 8–12 mm true bottom clearance, remains one through 16 mm, and decreases by at most one half over the next 45 mm. The goal band requires uninterrupted airborne hand contact and pays only changes in the object state. Carry dwell and supported set-down conditions are unchanged. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

body.text: The reward may see too few coordinated rolling attempts from an opposed grip under independent joint noise. Compare scalar exploration with a zero-mean covariance stretch along the local thumb and opposing fingertips' Jacobian direction for an object roll. Only the symmetric random innovation changes, and neither direction is prescribed. Use the already monitored 36 r0248 pre-turn contexts and the separate 32 first-lift incumbent contexts. Test factors one, four and eight at raw std 0.12 with matched random draws. Require six additional safe exact turns or at least three more safe held transport transitions while retaining baseline turns, with no extra hardware, contract or stop events, before applying a conditional-likelihood PPO change. This exploration is training-only, and the actor, observation, action contract and evaluation stay unchanged.

In the recent weighted-turn control, the median applied PPO actor step is about 0.076 of the proposed update. The pre-lift backtracking scales the entire step even if the early-state change is the only limiting part. Test a differentiable pre-lift Gaussian KL penalty of 1.0 inside every minibatch, relative to the observations and mean of its current on-policy collection. Repeat the same small exact PPO smoke with coefficient zero. Keep the hard 0.008 early KL and 0.040 overall bounds, same PPO lineage and v3 actor as r0362. No frozen target policy or action labels. Before long training require finite updates, both safety bounds honored, and paired median applied step at least 25 percent larger when the baseline median falls below 0.50.

The first-lift collection r0389 yields 190 boundaries from all 64 safe r0295 starts. It reserves 94 boundaries from 32 physical starts for possible training and one boundary from each of the other 32 for paired continuation checks. Both the incumbent and the r0248 turning actor accept all 32 at each noise setting. Each gives 32, 32 and 31 safe results at factors zero, 0.33 and one, with zero exact turns and no 10 mm post-turn travel. The panel misses the eight-turn threshold, so do not start this curriculum. Turn covariance screening remains a separate diagnostic.

Close the r0392 covariance and r0393 minibatch KL preflights. Rolling covariance factors one, four and eight give 16, 15 and 16 safe turns on the 36 r0248 contexts, all safe with zero transport. On 32 incumbent first-lift contexts all three give zero turns and transport, with 31, 31 and 32 safe cases. The two fourteen-update penalty smokes meet both KL bounds and have zero safety events. Median applied actor fraction falls from 0.231 to 0.175, below the improvement threshold. Keep the current PPO likelihood and hard KL update rules. Analysis is in research/simulation/turn_covariance_near_turn.json and turn_covariance_first_lift.json, and research/learning/prelift_penalty_smoke_0 and prelift_penalty_smoke_1.

The same ten starts that r0248 turns have median palm-local blade Z component minus 0.317 at the first settled lift and minus 0.450 after 180 ms. The safe incumbent on those starts has plus 0.016 and minus 0.009. The other 104 safe r0248 lifts have plus 0.020 and minus 0.012. All 24 complete local feasibility witnesses enter at a median minus 0.648. The reconstructed reachable reference at frames 112, 116 and 121 has minus 0.341, 0.424 and 0.577 at a representative draw. Test a 1.4-unit refundable potential for degrees of tilt into the palm at the first measured opposed lift, with a 9 to 24 degree ramp and the standard palm-down and clearance conditions. No repeat holding pay. Refund before a turn if the grip breaks or the episode ends. Keep all true stage conditions and existing reward terms. Preflight three complete witnesses and hold and random controls, exact paired partial replays and a short training integration before committing a longer comparison.

The unrestricted r0396 alignment score preserves all three witness completions, each gaining 1.40, and all hold and random controls have zero new credit. Two of three safe-incumbent failures briefly reach full alignment before their loss. Restrict positive credit to the 0.35 s after the same lift first qualifies, since the measured readiness difference occurs at the first settled lift and within 180 ms. Refund and stage conditions stay unchanged. Recheck the same controls and traces before the smoke. Evidence for the initial reading stays in research/simulation/lift_blade_alignment_preflight_unrestricted.json.

body.text: The revised 0.35 s blade-alignment preflight retains all stages and adds 1.40 on each of the three complete robot witnesses and each of three r0248 exact turn replays. All three paired incumbent failures keep zero net credit, two after temporary alignment, so alignment is a progress cue and is insufficient for turn. Holds remain zero and bounded random returns remain negative. A 16-update exact CPU smoke finishes with no stop, contract or hardware event. Run one 58-minute continuation, eight workers and CUDA2, from r0295 with the r0362 action, startup, pool, exploratory noise, turn weight six and KL caps. The reward is the only learning-method change, with smaller collection and minibatch counts for the available CPU lane. Fixed64 near 9, 26, 42 and 57 minutes. Expect more early blade alignment and then safe exact turns. At 26 minutes stop if fewer than four starts show either a safe exact turn or an eligible tilt below 30 degrees with at least 40 degrees relative movement, and the full-start early alignment rate has no gain over r0295. A task gate additionally needs independent safety and a true later-stage gain.

The turn-to-carry failure may be loss of support against a particular object wrench during regrasp. Lin et al. measure bidirectional contact wrench coverage in POISE, https://arxiv.org/html/2609.13761v1. Adapt that measure as geometry-only evidence at the first qualifying turn and after 100 and 200 ms. Use the same 55 partial PPO transports and 24 exact complete witnesses already compared in r0332, with no actions supplied to learning. Look for at least 0.75 pairwise separation at the first or 100 ms sample and consistency across sliding-friction assumptions. The proxy does not establish real grip-force capacity. Any later reward must pair it with actual held goalward progress and give zero credit to stationary holds.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Weighting exact opposed-airborne turn samples gives PPO a stronger turn update while protecting deployment pickup.
body.reflection: At the 28-minute paired checkpoint 61 of 64 lift safely and 51 pass final rest, with no hardware, stop or contract events. The median opposed clear hold is 12.34 s among the lifted cases. No full turn or later stage qualifies. Seed 1390520165 reaches a best eligible local pair at 33.86 degrees tilt, 38.25 degrees relative rotation and 19.95 degrees local passive rotation, with global passive at 40.9. The safe early carry suffixes travel at least 10 mm on 11 of 16 with 58.41 mm maximum. No low held touchdown occurs. The separate release panel finishes 14 of 16. Continue under the preregistered midpoint rule.

body.text: Across 24 complete exact feasibility witnesses, a per-call fit to the trained actor transform has translation error above 1 mm on 765 of 1644 carry calls and finger error above 0.02 rad on 899. The 95th percentile translation error is 17.31 mm. Five hundred five sent carry steps exceed the transform's 9 mm translation step cap. Test the exact current decoder against a translation-only variant with 95 mm measured-relative reach and 22 mm per call, holding the workspace box, rotation, finger transform and station safety fixed. Replay after the first true turn on the same witnesses with the correct delayed sensor and baseline physical prefix. Advance the action parameterization only if the wider suffix gains at least four safe carries or two safe placements without additional violations or stops. These are feasibility diagnostics with no action labels entering PPO.

The r0404 warm-support diagnostic accepts 42 of 48 new reset indices. All 168 matched continuations are safe. The cp0959 actor reaches a final valid plug window on 12 warm and six fresh-history cases, with zero final robot rest passes among those valid plug windows. The r0177 actor completes the assisted plug and robot final checks on 23 warm and 25 fresh-history cases. Broaden the pool with checked lower states from other physical draws before training, keep independent indices and keep one PPO actor from a single checkpoint. No role switching in a deployed package.

The r0406 matched projection directly reproduces all 24 feasible completions. With the current decoder after the first true turn it gives six safe carries and one safe placement. Wider translation gives 17 safe carries and nine placements, plus a torque halt at call 215 on seed 1587638663 with the object in the goal. It passes the stage-count threshold and fails the safety threshold. Keep the incumbent decoder. Reproduce the halt loads and check a separate horizontal-only translation expansion that preserves the current vertical output when the palm is near support. No trajectory commands will enter PPO.

A broader reset pool from successful feasibility grasps retained 172 of 262 lowering candidates across 18 starts through the two-call physical check. With cp0959, none of the 172 supplies an intact supported continuation. All are safe, with 161 losing their early reward phase and 11 still held lowering when the strict check ends. The shorter neutral hold did not establish compatibility with this PPO actor's grip. Probe newly turned physical grasps from the two earlier PPO actor families on previously unused physical seeds, align to the goal and retain only six-call safe held states. Use state, velocity, physical seed and preload only.

The horizontal expansion returns 19 safe carries and 14 placements out of 24, plus one halt on a different start, 44842877. At the original wide halt the index distal contacts the table with three roughly 13 N contacts and joint four reaches 20.89 Nm. At the horizontal halt the thumb distal loads the table and joint four reaches 20.81 Nm. These are physical contacts. Screen two fixed smaller amplitudes at 65 and 85 percent of the added horizontal reach and slew, with the ordinary small-amplitude map intact. Require the r0406 stage gain and zero safety events before a new training action transform, followed by a fresh PPO startup check.

body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.

body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. body.reflection: At the first fixed checkpoint 59 of 64 lift safely and 45 pass rest, with zero hardware, stop, contract or later-stage events. Median clear opposition is 11.65 s among lifts. The early assisted carry panel is safe and 13 of 16 reach 10 mm with a 44.90 mm maximum. No low held touchdown, and 14 of 16 separate supported starts finish. Continue to the midpoint.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: lift_blade_alignment
reward_terms.formula: Increase in the best opposed, clear high-tilt blade alignment toward the demonstrated palm frame. body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Spread physical carry resets through the early to goal interval under the same turn weighting.
body.reflection: At the 52-minute checkpoint 58 of 64 lift safely, 34 pass rest and two have loaded middle MCP2 violations. No exact later stages qualify. Zero low held touchdowns and nine of 16 separate supported placements. Continue to the planned endpoint.

body.text: Both smaller horizontal variants complete the paired physical safety check. The 65 percent map gives 19 carries and 13 placements of 24, while 85 percent gives 20 and 11. Choose 65 percent for its higher completion count and smaller authority change. The old r0295 weights produce bitwise identical actions on 46,080 archived action calls and a valid v3 diagnostic package. All 128 independent 2-second prefixes are safe with peak overrun 0.01633 rad. When the lowering lane completes, run 68 minutes on eight exact CPU workers and CUDA2, from r0295 and the r0363 expanded physical resets. Keep the ramp, reward, turn sample weight six, KL caps, early noise, monitoring and bounds on rotation, fingers and the vertical output. Fixed64 and matched assisted panels near 9, 28, 47 and 66.5 minutes. Stop at 28 if fewer than 48 safe full lifts, no full exact turn and fewer than two early assisted travels of 60 mm with the same grip. Promotion still requires ordinary independent full-start and safety evidence.

The heldout warm support test yields eight clean placements of 24 for the release-capable parent with real history and seven with fresh history. The lowering actor gives one and zero complete final windows, with six and three valid plug-only windows. All 96 continuations are safe and all four heldout physical sources are represented. In the 20-update integration, ten warm resets restore with zero fallback and no contract event. Ordinary exploratory release has two warm and two cold arm-table collision stops, plus one warm loaded thumb DIP excursion. The monitor terminates these physical events. Once the weighted lanes complete, compare matched cold release against 80 percent warm-supported release draws on eight exact workers per branch, starting from the best r0378 checkpoint by verified same-grip placement, release safety and then safe deployment lifts. Keep the ordinary PPO noise, reward and 600-call horizon. Use 64 fixed full starts, 16 late carry starts and the same 24 withheld support starts near 10, 28, 47 and 65 minutes. Stop either at midpoint if fewer than four safe continuous placements, fewer than eight warm/heldout release completions, and no new safe full-start stage.

The assisted-stage PPO run records one true deployment-start turn under exploration at update 1550 on seed 428458259. It completes all 600 calls without safety or contract events. The exact window ends at 24.80 degrees tilt, 51.20 degrees relative rotation, 23.84 degrees wrist motion and zero passive rotation. The plug remains continuously held only another 80 ms and travels about 4.03 mm toward the goal before loss. This gives direct early-turn evidence alongside r0414 late assisted placement, without an intervening full carry. The trace and turn audit are in research/learning/assisted_stage_rewards_run/turn_witnesses.

The r0418 expanded planar PPO continuation starts at 18:02 UTC after the lowering trainer exits. The first batch has no hardware, stop or contract event. It uses eight exact v7 CPU workers and CUDA2 with r0295 weights and the r0363 expanded carry curriculum, plus the 65 percent horizontal transform. The training lane is research/learning/expanded_planar_run and its four fixed checks are in expanded_planar_eval. The task evaluator, criteria and current baseline remain frozen.

The r0415 distance ladder keeps all 66 shifted grasps through the six-call hold. The unchanged mean gives eight clean placements at zero shift and five at 20 mm, where starts remain inside the goal. There are zero continuous touches or placements from 40, 80, 160 and 240 mm under mean or ordinary exploration. At the first outside-goal level the plug moves at most 5.90 mm of the required 8 mm. Diagnose 34, 36 and 38 mm shifts, or 2, 4 and 6 mm outside the goal. Compare smaller exploration noise because ordinary 0.12 also removes all eight nominal placements. Only consistent outside-goal progress can advance this curriculum.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Mask completed stage rewards on late resets to learn the supported carry and release link under the ordinary exact monitor.
body.reflection: The final scheduled check gives 44 of 64 safe full lifts, 60 rests, two loaded middle MCP2 excursions and zero later stages. Three of 16 assisted held starts reach continuous safe support, and one completes the final window in the same grip sequence. Another finishes through recovery. Two held starts have safety events. The separate supported-release panel has no placements and no safety events. Select r0414 checkpoint 1652 for the next assisted curriculum because it verifies six same-grip placements versus one. The unscheduled end weights at checkpoint 2119 are retained without full evaluation.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed opposed clearance as in the original reward through lift and turn. During carry inside goal XY, value rises from zero to one across 8–12 mm true bottom clearance, remains one through 16 mm, and decreases by at most one half over the next 45 mm. The goal band requires uninterrupted airborne hand contact and pays only changes in the object state. Carry dwell and supported set-down conditions are unchanged. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup. Omitted if the assisted reset supplies this stage.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.name: finger grip

domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

body.text: The alignment midpoint r0423 meets its continuation rule with 19 positive lift windows and ten full alignment windows versus 17 and zero for r0295, while still missing an exact turn. On 128 disjoint training-only simulations, select first-lift boundaries with at least 24 degrees of palm-frame blade alignment and at least 55 degrees world tilt, without selecting on what happens later. Test continuations by the alignment actor and the existing turning actor once at least 12 physical sources are accepted. This asks whether the measured readiness change produces a transferable grasp. Require at least six safe exact turns before using the new contexts for PPO.

The r0420 full turn takes about 1.44 s from its first eligible anchor, and the complete held transfers take roughly another 2.5 s. With the current PPO gamma 0.995 and GAE lambda 0.95, a residual 75 calls later has trace weight about 0.015. Gamma 0.998 and lambda 0.985 increase that to about 0.277. Test the longer credit assignment against the original on two matched eight-worker PPO runs after the weighted branches end. Use r0423 alignment checkpoint 0616, the same validated reward and physical reset population, fresh critic and Adam in both, the current actor KL and pickup protections, and the same seed and 96-call batch horizon. Budget 72 minutes with fixed checks near 10, 28, 48 and 70 minutes. At 28 stop a branch if it has fewer than 48 safe lifts, no safe exact turn and fewer than four eligible near turns within five degrees of both angular thresholds. Stop at the scheduled endpoint if only assisted geometry changes.

The actor history spans 2.1 s at 30 Hz, while the actual r0367 pose estimator is entirely invalid around support. Replay the genuine sensor model on the full 24 verified physical paths at the same two sensor seeds as r0367. Measure time from the latest valid capture to touchdown and the error when that captured pose is expressed in the captured palm frame and carried forward. Consider a causal last-visible pose feature only if at least 12 of 48 replays exceed that history span and the remembered relative center stays within 20 mm at touchdown. The test uses no injected policy observations.

The narrower ladder reaches continuous support on two to four of 11 starts 2 mm outside the goal, yet none meets the final placement and rest window. Neither 4 mm nor 6 mm outside produces a continuous touchdown. At the nominal in-goal position, changing both exploration bias and innovation from 0.12 to 0.04 or 0.08 recovers six clean placements of 11 at each setting, with no safety event. The mean gets eight. Close the distance curriculum at this point. Check a disjoint 48-state near-goal panel from r0414 before deciding on reduced late-stage exploration. Require at least six more safe continuous placements than the ordinary 0.12 setting with no safety regression.

The r0427 sensor replay finds a capture gap above 2.1 s in 36 of 48 cases and a remembered palm-frame center within 20 mm in 23 of those. Median gap is 2.36 s. Median center error is approximately 19.0 mm after carrying the observed center with the palm, versus 335.7 mm for the stale world position. The remembered blade direction is off by a median 32.1 degrees. Preflight seven causal features consisting of the capture-aligned center, its current world estimate from the measured palm, and a flag for a previous valid observation. Keep the ordinary sensor inputs. Appended columns initialise at zero, and training uses PPO only. The inputs pass reset and long-occlusion checks with varied external time. Run a small exact smoke and v3 validation before choosing a long branch.

The r0425 collector yields 105 aligned first-lift contexts from 37 separate safe physical starts. On 24 withheld starts the alignment actor gives zero turns at all three noise scales. The turning actor gives four, four and three safe turns at the three scales, all on four distinct physical starts. All 144 continuations are safe, and none starts the measured 10 mm post-turn transport. This shows that some new aligned grasps support an active turn. Preserve 37 contexts from the other 13 starts for a training-only prefix comparison against the ordinary r0426 control after lanes become available. The same actor weights and action bounds should be used across that comparison. Withheld starts remain outside the optimizer.

The remembered-center PPO smoke completes 12 exact updates. Its single 615-input actor package validates under v3 across 900 calls with a measured 4.697 ms p99 round trip and no external time dependence. It has no task assessment or deployment standing. Hold the prepared observation variant for an exact comparison after a new lane opens. Judge the addition on actual turns, held carry and safe final outcomes rather than the sensor audit alone.

The weighted trainers finish at checkpoints 1937 and 1880, with final exact scheduled assessments underway. Start the recorded r0419 release-state pair and r0426 credit-assignment pair at 18:18:38 UTC, eight exact workers per branch. The release pair uses r0414 checkpoint 1652 with the same saved optimizer and critic, and differs only in 80 percent warm versus ordinary supported reset draws. The credit pair uses the same r0423 checkpoint 0616 actor with fresh critic and Adam, and changes only the gamma-lambda pair. Both credit first batches are safe. The release first batches show one physical hardware excursion in the shared early exploration. Monitor all four in research/learning/support_{cold,warm}_run and credit_{standard,extended}_run.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: lift_blade_alignment
reward_terms.formula: Increase in the best opposed, clear high-tilt blade alignment toward the demonstrated palm frame. Credit ramps between 9 and 24 degrees toward the negative palm normal during the first 0.35 s after the lift qualifies. One potential per continuous grip, refunded if the grip breaks or time ends before the qualified turn. No assisted snapshot credit and no change to the exact stage thresholds.

domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.lift_blade_alignment: Reward a change toward the reconstructed blade direction in the robot palm frame during first held lift. The checked near-turn and feasibility grasps occupy this range, and the reward refunds unqualified acquisition.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.text: Use the reserved aligned first-lift contexts when the alignment training workers free up. Compare with the standard r0426 credit arm at matched update counts. Keep parent checkpoint 0616, seed 773421, eight workers, fresh critic and Adam, standard gamma and lambda, alignment reward, pickup screen, policy update limits and ordinary reset fractions. Change only which learned physical prefix supplies the existing anchored turn mode. Spend 64 minutes with fixed checks near 10, 27, 45 and 63 minutes. At 27 stop if there are no safe exact full turns, fewer than four eligible near turns and no gain in the safe anchored-turn rate over the standard r0426 control. The current 24-start probe stays held out.

The r0428 disjoint 48-state final approach check confirms lower exploration. At innovation and episode-bias scales 0.04, 0.08 and 0.12, the same PPO mean completes 17, three and one same-grip assisted placements. The 0.04 cases span all six physical seeds and have 48/48 clean safety, versus 43 and 41 in the wider conditions. Prepare a PPO option scaling innovation and episode bias to one third during physically held or supported near-goal assisted steps. Store the actual variance in PPO likelihood and KL, retain ordinary deployment exploration, and keep the deployed mean unchanged. Run a short safety-monitored integration before scheduling matched long training.

The r0435 integration smoke completed 3840 exact station calls. All 40 eligible completed live contexts restored successfully, with zero fallbacks, qualifying turns or safety events. The separate r0436 reduced-noise integration completed 6912 exact calls, including 1288 phase-conditioned reduced-noise calls, with no hardware or contract failure. Schedule aligned_prefix_run to start when the original blade-alignment trainer releases its eight workers, for 64 minutes on CUDA2. All technical settings match credit_standard_run except replacing the r0248 pre-turn source with the disjoint reserved r0423 aligned first-lift contexts. Fixed ages 10, 27, 45 and 63 minutes. At midpoint apply r0435, stopping if no safe exact turn, fewer than four eligible near turns and no anchored-turn rate gain. The reduced-noise branch awaits a separate worker lane and matched cold-reset reference.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: A sixfold PPO surrogate weight on actual opposed airborne turn rows should convert robust lift into a qualifying finger turn while retaining pickup and useful later skill.
body.reflection: The scheduled 85-minute ordinary-curriculum endpoint preserves zero safety events with 58 safe lifts and 41 rests on fixed64. Thirteen have both standard rotation magnitudes, yet none meets the full turn interval. The median opposed clear time among lifts is 13.495 s. Assisted early transport reaches 59.12 mm and 12 of 16 clear 10 mm. No continuous low touchdown and 15 separate supported releases pass. Finish this study without retaining the change.

The expanded curriculum reaches 68.04 mm from an assisted early start, so test whether longer goalward exploration precedes a better held transport result. Compare standard raw noise with 2x and 4x variance-amplitude multipliers on the zero-mean episode bias of world-Y translation alone. Use the stronger carry checkpoint 1136, fixed 48 early exact reset draws from 16 source seeds, equal bias signs, identical innovations, and unchanged monitored dynamics. Measure whether the clipped PPO update on mixed physical curricula improves late actions at the first-order expense of deployment pickup. On normal rollout data, split the actor loss into deployment pre-lift, opposed turn, and late reset rows. Compare the gradients only when each group has at least 32 samples in an update. Use up to 80 ordinary PPO updates from the r0423 turn parent and r0414 lowering parent with their own reset mixes. Consider a paired projected-optimization study only if at least 30 updates qualify, at least 40 percent have cosine at most -0.15, and at least 25 percent of applied steps predict an increase in the pre-lift loss. body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.

body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. body.reflection: The scheduled 57-minute endpoint has 49 safe lifts, 38 rests and seven loaded physical position violations on fixed64. Twenty-two clear lifts show positive alignment and sixteen attain full alignment, above the baseline 17 and zero. Median clear opposition among safe lifts is 4.50 s. There is no exact turn or later stage. Assisted early motion reaches 53.28 mm, no low continuous touchdown. Finish the reward trial and investigate the observed early alignment through the matched first-lift context branch.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: lift_blade_alignment
reward_terms.formula: Increase in the best opposed, clear high-tilt blade alignment toward the demonstrated palm frame. Credit ramps between 9 and 24 degrees toward the negative palm normal during the first 0.35 s after the lift qualifies. One potential per continuous grip, refunded if the grip breaks or time ends before the qualified turn. No assisted snapshot credit and no change to the exact stage thresholds.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing
domain_randomization.distribution: supplied default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with occlusion measured by ray-capsule visibility and independently seeded delay, noise, two-sided orientation flips and dropout

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.lift_blade_alignment: Reward a change toward the reconstructed blade direction in the robot palm frame during first held lift. The checked near-turn and feasibility grasps occupy this range, and the reward refunds unqualified acquisition.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Cold supported release resets provide the unchanged matched comparison to release states with retained actuator and observation history.
body.reflection: First fixed64 gives 23 safe lifts, 22 rests and one loaded middle MCP2 excursion, no turn. Ten of 16 low assisted starts touch down continuously, and eight finish clean same-grip placement and robot rest. The cold separately supported group has zero placements, while exact withheld warm prefixes followed by this single actor complete 18/24 safely. Continue to the fixed midpoint and test transfer to distinct feasible grasp states.

Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.
