curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

held_carry_attempts.description: Assisted carry resets end on the first break in the starting grip before valid support. An early loss can initiate an independent checked carry reset with a fresh sensor seed. The monitor checks each complete action. Full starts and supported suffixes retain the ordinary deployment horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.turn_continuation: Uses the exact-window turn event. Forty percent pays immediately and the balance requires 0.20 s continuous opposed-to-held transport with 10 mm real progress and endpoint tilt at most 35 degrees.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.text: The planar checkpoint 0632 has a different near-turn grasp from most earlier PPO cases. Seed 1119031513 turns between 5.37 and 8.20 s with thumb-ring opposition, 31.42 degree endpoint tilt, 41.54 degree relative rotation, 19.06 degree wrist excursion and zero global and local passive rotation. The prior exact prefix collector stops after seven seconds. Check 128 disjoint twelve-second deployment prefixes for safe near-turn contexts with a gap at most twelve degrees, then measure exact PPO suffixes from eligible held contexts before allocating a training lane. Require at least four source draws near the criterion and at least four safe exact turns from distinct source draws on held-out continuations to justify a new curriculum. These context replays do not supply action labels.

The matched stage-gradient probes finish. On 69 eligible late-reset comparisons no pre-lift cosine is at or below -0.15, and the actual parameter change predicts worse pre-lift loss in three of 69. Only 15 opposed-turn updates meet the 32-row floor, with two negative cosines and zero predicted pre-lift worsening. Neither comparison meets the r0442 threshold. The diagnostic writes research/learning/phase_gradient_audit_results.json. Keep ordinary PPO updates and focus on the physical turn transition.

The r0446 disjoint early carry comparison gives 22/64 safe upright travels of at least 60 mm across eight physical sources, compared with 2/64 across two for the older bounded actor. Five of 64 exceed 110 mm across three sources, maximum 124.24 mm, compared with zero and 65.72 mm. Both have zero continuous goal touchdown. The planar actor has two physical arm collision stops, at indices 5306 and 5182. The gain clears the transport threshold but misses the zero added safety threshold. Replay the safe progress and both stops to distinguish actuator-authority, carry observability and actual contact loss before proposing another retained change.

Both r0445 policies finish all 48 separate fresh-feasibility resets without a safety event. Parent 1652 has one safe continuous touchdown and one final placement on a different reset, with zero same-grip completions. Cold checkpoint 0384 has zero continuous touchdown or placement and a 10 ms median clear hold compared with 1.005 s for parent. Their six and eight placements remain evidence on the related late grasp family. The first cold update gains did not generalize to the fresh feasibility grasps.

Exact replays of the r0454 planar trials reproduce both stops and all 22 safe upright motion outcomes. At the stops the plug is already grounded outside goal. Link7_R_capsule touches support_table with normal forces 13.51 and 3.33 N at 4.16 and 6.55 s. Among the moving cases nine retain uninterrupted grip through eight seconds. Median remaining y gap to the goal edge is 130.4 mm, median longest invalid pose-sensor gap 3.92 s, and median pose validity after approaching the leftmost held position is 2.94 percent. Sixteen of 22 lose valid pose for more than the 2.1 s history span. Median commanded palm y minus measured y at that plateau is -1.56 mm. This supports replaying the r0431 causal remembered center feature on these real PPO histories before a matched observation-only PPO study. The source trace and both collision contact lists are in early_carry_plateau_audit.json.

The r0452 twelve-second collector finds all 128 deployment prefixes safe, with four eligible contexts on two physical starts and one exact turn. Full 600-call replay of qualifying seed 643471431 has zero stops, contract failures or physical violations. The exact turn ends at 5.50 s with tilt 24.55 degrees, relative blade turn 60.76 degrees, wrist travel 27.44 degrees and local and global passive rotation zero. The thumb-ring grasp retains contact for another 0.17 s and moves 1.51 mm goalward at most. Clearance at turn is 5.17 mm. No carry, final goal or robot rest. Local three-view evidence is under expanded_planar_eval/checkpoint_0632/full_turn_643471431. Four exact prefix continuations give 1, 4 and 1 safe turns at noise scales zero, one third and one, all 12 safe, no transport. It does not satisfy the four-source curriculum threshold. Run a further disjoint 384 exact deployment prefixes at the same twelve seconds with cutoff and source minimum unchanged. Do not gate the checkpoint on the one turn.

There is a measured difference in post-turn clearance on the existing physically checked cohorts. Twenty-four complete fresh paths have 55.83 mm median clearance at the qualifying turn and 69.89 mm median peak in the next 0.20 s, with no early drop in clearance. The 55 partial PPO paths have 48.97 mm at turn, 45.73 mm median minimum and 51.48 mm median peak. The new planar full-start turn begins only 5.17 mm clear. Replay the 10 earlier truly qualifying PPO full-start turns and the new planar turn, with identical exact actor prefix and then raw vertical offsets 0, +0.20 and +0.45 for fifteen calls. Compare same-grip hold and upright travel under the actual action bounds. Consider a short refundable post-turn clearance reward only if at least four more safe holds reach 0.20 s or three new 10 mm held transitions qualify, with zero added safety events. The perturbations stay in the physics diagnosis, outside policy training.

Apply the prespecified midpoint stops to warm support and standard credit. Warm checkpoint 0937 has zero same-grip placements after 14 low continuous touchdowns, zero of 24 withheld warm placement-and-rest completions, and no later stage from deployment. It has 19 safe lifts of 64, ten more geometric lifts with a safety failure, and 25 upper middle MCP2 limit events. Standard credit checkpoint 0640 has 44 safe lifts, no exact turn, and zero locally eligible angular gaps at or below five degrees. Set both graceful stop markers. Extended credit checkpoint 0632 has 58 safe lifts and no safety events, meeting continuation, though still zero exact turns. Cold support midpoint holdout is still completing. Neither stopped actor enters a gate.

Use the freed warm-support lane for the r0436 reduced-near-goal-noise comparison from checkpoint 1652. This runs 62 minutes, eight exact CPU stations and CUDA3, same cold resets, parent action envelope, saved optimizer and critic, seed, reward, 16 attempts, raw std 0.12 and KL 0.04 as r0419 cold. The single change is multiplying both exploration bias and innovation by one third while an assisted late grip or support is inside the goal. Assess fixed64, low and supported 16-case suffixes and the same 24 withheld warm prefixes near 10, 28, 47 and 61 minutes. Apply the original midpoint stop if fewer than four clean low placements, fewer than eight held-out supported placements and no later full-start stage. To advance require at least eight clean low placements and either at least twelve withheld supported completions or transfer to the disjoint feasibility grasp family. Full-start safety and significance still govern gate selection.

Stop the cold-support control under its midpoint rule after its held-out panel finishes. Checkpoint 0978 has zero fixed safe lifts and no later stage, one hardware event, and 40 rests. All 16 low held starts reach a continuous support contact, zero finish placement and rest, and none of 24 held-out warm continuations succeeds. The first cold checkpoint 0384 remains its strongest assisted result. The reduced-noise branch from 1652 opened at about 18:55 and its first update is monitored and safe. The first post-turn clearance diagnostic wrapper imported a base history with the wrong dimension. It ran zero valid perturbations. The retry uses each original policy entry point in a separate package process, checks the exact turn-boundary state and changes only its in-memory vertical output bias for the following fifteen calls.

The r0458 matched perturbation replays preserve all eleven exact turn-boundary physical states. Offsets zero, +0.20 and +0.45 are all safe on eleven. Each retains three grips through 0.20 s and produces zero held 10 mm transport transitions. More upward palm authority alone does not explain the continued-grip difference. No post-turn clearance term is adopted.

Planar checkpoint 1032 extends the early 16-case held panel to eight safe upright travels of at least 60 mm and a maximum of 160.13 mm, while its fixed64 remains 55 safe lifts and no qualifying turn. Compare checkpoints 0632 and 1032 and cold-lowering 0384 on three fixed outside-goal y bands, with sixteen distinct physical starts per band, same verified snapshot and sensing for each actor and full 600-call window. Measure 0.10 s of upright held presence in goal before any interruption, continuous touchdown and final same-grip placement. If at least eight become safe held goal in a band, consider focusing carry resets at the next upstream band. If entry stays near zero, inspect the physical failure before using another reset distribution.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: The ordinary cold release context is the fixed control for supporting-state history during transfer from lowering.
body.reflection: The fixed midpoint has zero safe lifts, 40 rests, one measured physical position violation and zero later stages. All 16 low starts reach continuous touch. No original grasp places at rest. The two separate 16-case release and 24-case withheld warm cohorts also produce zero final placements at rest. Stop under r0461 and retain checkpoint 0384 as the strongest assisted result from this control.

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

held_carry_attempts.description: Assisted carry resets end on the first break in the starting grip before valid support. An early loss can initiate an independent checked carry reset with a fresh sensor seed. The monitor checks each complete action. Full starts and supported suffixes retain the ordinary deployment horizon.

warm_supported_release.description: A frozen earlier PPO actor reaches the first checkable support boundary from a physical held reset. Its station, monitor and observation history are restored. The continuing PPO actor receives only the suffix; prefix actions and rewards are excluded from the optimizer. Physical source starts are sampled uniformly.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.assisted_stage_rewards: Reward only the remaining stages on checked late curriculum resets. The complete deployment reward and physical safety penalties stay active throughout their ordinary windows.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: The standard credit horizon provides the matched control from checkpoint 0616.
body.reflection: At midpoint it has 44 safe lifts and 39 rests on fixed64, zero events and zero later stages. No eligible angular gap at or below five degrees, with the closest short by 26.76 degrees. Safe upright early movement peaks at 51.26 mm, and separate low and supported groups each have eleven final placements with no continuous low set-down. Stop under r0459.

reward_terms.name: release

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers

reward_terms.name: slip

reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: lift_blade_alignment
reward_terms.formula: Increase in the best opposed, clear high-tilt blade alignment toward the demonstrated palm frame. Credit ramps between 9 and 24 degrees toward the negative palm normal during the first 0.35 s after the lift qualifies. body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.

body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Continue using the 65 percent bounded expansion to improve held upright transport without disrupting reliable pickup.
body.reflection: The third checkpoint gives 55 safe lifts, 41 rests and four hardware events on fixed64 with no later stage. Seed 831238427 reaches 34.02 degrees while turning 69.62 degrees relative to the palm, zero local passive, while thumb and ring oppose. Eight of 16 early assisted trials travel at least 60 mm upright, maximum 160.13 mm. Four final low placements follow loss of the original grip, and fourteen separate supported release starts finish. Continue to the scheduled endpoint and check midrange same-grip goal entry.

body.text: Test observation history at the real early-carry boundary. On each of the eight physical starts with a safe upright 60 mm movement in the disjoint planar panel, select its best measured index and stop the original actor at the first 60 mm continuous upright displacement. Retain the same physical state, sensor, low-pass targets and controller. Compare four more seconds under the same actor, with its exact history or with history cleared at that boundary, requiring matching boundary position fingerprints. Consider a curriculum using real carry histories only if warm continuation produces at least four additional safe 40 mm movements or two new goal-entry holds. This narrow comparison diagnoses the retained state after travel and supplies no PPO action samples.

The first warm early-carry diagnostic reaches all eight matched 60 mm boundaries. All continuations are safe. Warm histories give four subsequent 40 mm upright movements, history reset gives one, and neither enters the goal with a held dwell. This falls one movement short of the prespecified history threshold. Independently, the early planar plateau center replay improves the median from 23.56 to 5.10 mm in seven of 22 cases with a valid cue and at least 0.20 s gap. Only two provide a cue across a 2.1 s gap. The deployed planar lifted panel has 59 prior valid histories but zero long unsupported gaps, and six short-gap histories with median memory error 30.41 mm. The older actor has 21 short-gap cases with 5.66 mm median error and four long-gap cases. Defer a full memory training comparison until a later-state cohort with adequate camera coverage exists. Replicate the stronger planar checkpoint 1032 on the unchanged disjoint 64 early-carry draws to see whether a larger source panel is available.

The disjoint 384-prefix result has four exact turn prefixes and one physical violation. `None` yields an old 10 mm curriculum boundary. Archived 100 Hz rows show intact unsupported opposition throughout the intended lead interval, with minima 1.71 to 8.64 mm in qualifying traces. The 10 mm initial lift was already satisfied. Re-extract monitored low pre-turn contexts with at least 1.5 mm clearance after a qualifying lift, still requiring safe opposed contact, no support, down palm and an active turn anchor. Hold the four qualifying source draws out for suffix testing. Seek distinct training donors from the original compatible starts and 256 new deployment prefixes. Keep the minimum four distinct held-out exact turns and at least four independent training source draws before a curriculum trial. Fixture and evaluation thresholds are unchanged.

The middle-distance diagnostic gives zero same-grip held entry, touchdown or placement for both planar actors in all three bands and the cold-release actor in the first two finished bands. This tests a different cold grasp family than the successful early movers. Test a shorter but otherwise complete manipulation as a possible curriculum. On twenty matched draws per condition, translate the grounded plug and the palm ramp endpoint by 0, 60, 120, 180 and 230 mm toward the same goal, keeping the blade pose, grip and other randomized physics, with real ramp, camera and contract monitoring. Evaluate the planar 0632 and the earlier qualifying-turn actor. Consider a training-only easier-start mix only if at least two shifted conditions have eight safe lifts each and there is a qualifying turn or held goal entry on displaced starts. No shortened-path demonstration or scripted action is supplied to the actors.

The low-context preflight recovers 12 eligible late pre-turn states on each side of the physical split. The 12 withheld states are safe at all three noise levels. The original mean completes 12 exact turns across all four sources, one-third noise completes eight across all four, and full noise completes seven across three. There is no 10 mm continuation. Full 600-call replays keep the turn in three of the four newly screened sources, all safe, with no carry. Plan a matched 68-minute PPO pair from exact planar checkpoint 0632 and its saved Adam and critic. On both arms use one-third Gaussian exploration during true opposed anchored reset turns only, preserving the original full-start exploration. The control restores the earlier PPO pre-turn contexts. The variant restores the disjoint later low-clearance PPO contexts. All other hyperparameters, action transform and early-to-goal reset pool are shared. Run an exact short integration first.

The later planar 1032 early-carry replication uses the identical 64 disjoint paired states. It preserves 22 safe upright 60 mm movements and raises the 110 mm count from five to fourteen, maximum 165.52 mm, with 62 safe rollouts in each. Run the same warm versus history-reset 60 mm boundary diagnostic on checkpoint 1032. Keep the original effect threshold of at least four extra safe 40 mm movements or two same-grip held goal entries. This tests whether the growing carry range is available with almost no saved history or benefits from the actual PPO context.

The r0474 exact smoke completes 4608 monitored calls. Fifty-six live low contexts restore with no fallback. There are 642 reduced-noise opposed samples, 26 anchored exact turns, two exact held transport transitions and no hardware, contract or stop event. All four withheld cache pairs match bit for bit for their 80-call suffixes. Use fixed ages 10, 28, 47 and 66.5 minutes in both 68-minute continuations. Stop at 28 only when there is no new safe full-start turn, fewer than four locally eligible full-start angular gaps within five degrees, fewer than eight verified anchored 10 mm transport transitions across at least four sources, and fewer than six of twelve same held-out contexts turn. Use the previously specified physical source split and match the number of draws and contexts if they differ. No warm or assisted result justifies gate promotion without full-start evidence.

The later planar carry history replication restores all eight matching boundaries safely. Both warm and reset histories produce seven additional upright 40 mm movements and zero held goal entry. This fails the carry reset history adoption condition and removes the first checkpoint warm advantage in the replicated actor. The longer trajectories still merit physical and sensor review. The completed middle-distance study gives zero held goal entry, continuous support or same-grip placement in every band for all three actors. Safety is 44/48, 45/48 and 48/48. More cold resets from that grasp family are not supported by this result.

The one screen-to-full turn disagreement is physical seed 479789206. Its standard passive relative rotation rises from 10.1 degrees at 12 seconds to 21.1 degrees by 20, while the custom interval remains geometrically valid. The gap is the full-episode 20 degree predicate and does not indicate a policy interface defect. Continue to use 600-call exact verdicts for selection. In the new low-context study, monitor whether any reported turn is later lost on the global passive budget before deciding whether a post-turn training penalty is warranted.

Stop the corrected aligned first-lift branch under r0435. Its midpoint checkpoint 0664 has 48 safe lifts, 22 rests, five loaded position violations, no exact turn and no locally eligible angular gap at or below five degrees. The restored early aligned contexts yield zero exact turns in 304 safe episodes compared with 21 in 268 for the standard pre-turn context at a comparable checkpoint. Neither moved 10 mm after an exact turn. The expanded planar branch has finished its scheduled training. Its latest fixed checkpoint 1504 has one safe exact turn, 54 safe lifts and three early physical events. Check a separate 128-start full panel for its actual stage and safety rates before any gate consideration.

reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay

domain_randomization.name: proprioception

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

held_carry_attempts.description: Assisted carry resets end on the first break in the starting grip before valid support. An early loss can initiate an independent checked carry reset with a fresh sensor seed. The monitor checks each complete action. Full starts and supported suffixes retain the ordinary deployment horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.turn_continuation: Uses the exact-window turn event. Forty percent pays immediately and the balance requires 0.20 s continuous opposed-to-held transport with 10 mm real progress and endpoint tilt at most 35 degrees.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.text: Continue the planar method for another 72 minutes from endpoint 1504. The fixed early maximum increases from 47 to 119 to 160 to 217 mm and fixed deployment now has one true safe turn, though no full carry. Resume its critic, optimizer and actual current 0.000015 learning rate, retaining the existing 0.00025 maximum, 0.000015 floor and eight-update pickup screen. Use eight exact CPU workers on CUDA1 and a fresh reproducible rollout seed 773422. Preserve the action transform, reward, exploration, carry pool and original pre-turn contexts. Assess fixed ages 10, 28, 47 and 70 minutes and the same low, release and early held probes. At 28 stop if no safe full-start turn and no held goal entry, together with either fewer than six 110 mm early movements or at least six hardware episodes. Require clean paired full-start improvement for gate selection.

Planar endpoint 1504 has 107 safe lifts, two safe exact turns and 71 rests in the independent128 full-start panel. It has three additional early middle MCP2 violations, no complete carry and no contract errors. Keep it out of the gate. The shorter grounded-start probe does meet its curriculum prerequisite on the earlier r0248 actor. The 60 and 120 mm shifts yield 14 and eight safe lifts and two and three safe exact turns, respectively. Compare the same fixed observations under the wider 65 percent planar action transform as a diagnostic common foundation. Require at least 31 of the original 38 combined safe lifts and four of its seven exact turns across zero, 60 and 120 mm, with at most two extra hardware events, before pairing shorter-start PPO under the wider transform. The earlier actor weights and ramp bytes are held fixed.

The unchanged r0248 weights with the diagnostic wider planar transform validate contract v3 at 0.900 ms p99. Across the three paired shorter-pickup conditions it retains 36 of the original 38 safe lifts and improves seven to eight safe turns, with three versus two hardware events. It meets r0486. Plan a 72-minute matched PPO pair from the same r0248 actor, fresh critic and Adam, seed 9103775, eight exact workers each and the diagnostic wider transform, with ordinary early-to-goal and anchored curricula. The variant alone replaces 60 percent of existing pregrasp resets with equal 60 and 120 mm shortened grounded pickups. These use the full monitored ramp, the same pre-lift exploration scale as normal ramps, and a demonstration reference aligned to their actual start. Keep the original ordinary deployment episode fraction and gate positions. Fixed checks at 10, 28, 48 and 70 minutes plus 24 disjoint shifted starts at the same two distances. At 28 stop the variant if no exact safe full-start turn, fewer than three safe shifted turns and no safe shifted held carry. Stop the control if it has fewer than 48 safe lifts, no exact turn and no shifted held carry. Run when two lanes are free after the shorter-reset integration smoke.

Complete the shifted-pickup integration smoke. Of 24 PPO updates, six ordinary deployment and six shortened-start episodes finish cleanly, with six and four safe lifts respectively, and zero hardware, contract or stop events. The exact paired body counts in r0487 are 34 retained safe lifts plus two new versus 38 old, and six retained turns plus two new versus seven old. There are two newly flagged hardware trials and one original flagged trial clears. This meets the original paired thresholds. Separately the full 20-second repeat of the endpoint early carry panel has no held goal entry or continuous placement. Four Link7-to-table collisions all follow loss of the original grip, at 7.17 to 14.64 seconds and 1.98 to 16.43 N measured normal force. Keep the shorter-start pair ready for the next two worker lanes.

At the same 176 updates, the low-context arm gives 50 exact turns in 140 safe anchored episodes and control 24 in 152. Three low-context episodes have the 10 mm turn-continuation reward. Two also satisfy the full frozen turn predicate, both from start 190079329. Both smoke transitions satisfy the exact turn too, both on the same source. The active checkpoints originally counted the shaped reward event in the transport curve. Preserve those curves and check the raw episode stage and source IDs for the r0476 midpoint condition. New trainer invocations now count anchored transport only when the exact turn also passes.

The reduced near-goal-noise midpoint 1230 has zero deployment lifts, 61 rests and zero limits or stops. In the fixed low group seven of 16 reach continuous support and all seven finish the same-grip final placement and rest check. Six more reach final placement after recovery, and the full low group has two other safety events. This meets the prespecified continuation condition for the late-stage branch. Repeat the same 48 fresh feasibility grasp resets used for r0445 to assess transfer before the next milestone.

The matched low-context curriculum returns from 0.04 opposed-turn exploration to 0.12 immediately after a qualifying turn. That switch could disrupt the same grip during the brief travel transition. On the twelve held-out exact low contexts and four independently seeded perturbations per context, use identical 0.04 noise and episode bias through the same first local turn, then compare retaining 0.04 versus 0.12. Pair by context and replica and confirm the pre-turn event timestamps agree. Consider a PPO schedule change only if it gains at least six safe exact-turn continuations held for 0.20 seconds or three additional true 10 mm transitions, with no added safety failures. These stochastic continuations are diagnostic only.

The shorter-pickup pair starts at about 19:31 UTC after extended credit releases its workers. The standard and 60 percent shifted-pregrasp variants both use the checked a1caa2e wider-transform package, the r0248 weights and eight exact CPU workers. Their first batches are safe and use the intended option values. Extended credit saves final 1776 and has its scheduled checkpoint 1752 assessment underway. The first low-context checkpoint 0240 has 62 safe deployment lifts, 59 rests and zero exact turns or safety events. In the fixed withheld 12 warm turn continuations, it gives seven safe turns and five physical held 10 mm transitions. Older-context checkpoint 0280 has seven safe full-start turns but seven early hardware events, and its held-out continuations give ten safe turns and zero measured 10 mm transitions.

The first low-context actor completes five measured 10 mm held transitions across two of four exact withheld source starts, with same-grip time 0.63 to 1.41 seconds. It has zero deployment-start turns. Check whether restored states can move earlier within the same true physical trajectories and still let that actor finish. Restore at leads near 0.45, 0.75 and 1.05 seconds before the qualifying turn, with the exact 1.5 mm post-lift allowance, monitored unsupported opposition and no change to any gate criterion. Use the four withheld physical sources and compare to their later states. Consider a curriculum that steps back through the turn only if earlier contexts still yield at least four safe exact turns across three distinct physical starts and two measured 10 mm continuations.

The earlier-anchor probe restores all 12 safely. It gives three safe exact turns at each noise setting, with two and three measured 10 mm motions. The four-turn criterion is unmet. The paired post-turn noise probe uses 48 safe trials per condition. Keeping 0.04 after the turn gives 35 exact turns, 27 safe 0.20-second holds and zero 10 mm transitions. Returning to 0.12 gives 34 exact turns, 22 holds and five 10 mm transitions. The lower scale falls short of the additional hold threshold and loses measured transport. Keep the existing post-turn noise return.

The seven fixed earlier-context failures at checkpoint 0280 are all loaded lower middle MCP2 around 0.43–0.48 seconds. Against the safe paired low-context actor on those starts, their measured palms are 3.20–3.98 mm lower in world x and 1.64–2.28 mm lower in z at the event. Contact begins 30–60 ms earlier. Test only the nominal package ramp offsets x +3.5 mm, z +2 mm and their combination, plus x +5 and z +3 mm, without changing trained weights or the action transform. Match the seven risk starts across four exact sensor draws each. Only variants with all 28 safe can continue to full same-seed turn retention and fresh lift and safety checks. Require at least five of the seven learned turns and 22 of 24 safe fresh lifts before an independent gate slate.

Checkpoint 0280 joins a verified full-start turn to a held 10 mm transition on two different fixed starts. Seed 353604967 retains contact for 1.55 s and reaches 21.27 mm goalward. Seed 465145517 retains 1.48 s and reaches 15.32 mm. No fixed start holds the plug in goal. Look for at least four distinct such transitions in a new 128-start full-length exact diagnostic before making a new carried-context curriculum. The stage count and hardware risks will both be recorded. The first ramp screen shell used a detached standard-input descriptor and exited before running any cases. The same r0495 conditions now execute from a local script.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Both Gaussian innovation and episode bias are reduced during true opposed airborne turn rows of live anchored resets. The stored conditional scale is used in the PPO likelihood and KL. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Previously learned low-clearance pre-turn contexts improve the transition into safe held travel while retaining normal pickup.
body.reflection: Fixed64 has 62 lifts and 59 rests, no hardware events or later stage. Within the same 12 withheld assisted contexts, seven true turns and five measured held transitions across two sources, all safe. Eight early assisted cases reach 60 mm upright and two reach 110 mm. Fourteen separate supported releases, no continuous low touchdown. Continue the matched study.

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

held_carry_attempts.description: Assisted carry resets end on the first break in the starting grip before valid support. live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Both Gaussian innovation and episode bias are reduced while an assisted carry or release is within the goal and held or supported. The actual conditional scale is used in PPO likelihood and KL. Full starts keep the original exploration.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Lower noise on assisted in-goal states should preserve physically exact support and release.
body.reflection: At midpoint the 64 normal starts have no safe lifts, 61 rests and zero safety events. Seven of 16 low assisted starts finish safe same-grip placement and rest, with six more following recovery and two other safety events. Thirteen of 24 withheld warm support prefixes finish placement and rest, with 21 of 24 safe. The separate 48 feasibility grasps produce zero same-grip placement while remaining safe. Continue under r0460.

Every candidate retains physical limit failures, so none qualifies for retention testing. The iteration writer also failed before upload when the paired context catalog had no redundant counts field. It now computes counts from the immutable contexts and treats legacy transition-bonus counters distinctly from verified turn sequences. Re-run the affected iteration uploads.

reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: lift_blade_alignment
reward_terms.formula: Increase in the best opposed, clear high-tilt blade alignment toward the demonstrated palm frame. Credit ramps between 9 and 24 degrees toward the negative palm normal during the first 0.35 s after the lift qualifies. curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.lift_blade_alignment: Reward a change toward the reconstructed blade direction in the robot palm frame during first held lift. The checked near-turn and feasibility grasps occupy this range, and the reward refunds unqualified acquisition.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.text: Fixed middle MCP2 floors -0.025, zero and +0.020 rad give 15, 12 and 17 safe prefixes of 28, all with remaining physical events. This closes the fixed floor and ramp variants. Test whether the actual lateral contact load is a precursor to the joint excursion. Replay the original sent command prefix for each of the seven fixed risk starts and the matched safe low-context actor with the same physical start and sensor. Read true constraint and actuation loads and encoder/anatomy geometry at the monitored 100 Hz ticks. Require a useful precursor at least two policy calls before failure on five of seven starts without comparable alarms in the matched safe prefixes before designing a training-only safety potential. Also confirm all 48 r0491 pairs have identical local pre-switch turn timing, 35 with a turn. Its five higher-noise held transitions span two sources.

The fourteen r0503 pickup prefixes match their archived physical endpoint states exactly. At the fixed matched risk starts an outward constraint load above 0.16 N m appears 70 to 110 ms before all seven hardware events, while their safe paired checkpoints peak at 0.1584 N m. The affected actual joint is still around -0.04 to -0.08 rad when first flagged. Freeze 0.16 and test the independent 128 cohort fault starts, their paired low-context approach, and 24 other safe same-actor starts. Consider a training-only risk term only with warning at least two calls earlier on 80 percent of at least five independent faults and no more than one false alarm in the 24 same-actor safe prefixes.

The fixed 0.16 N m load threshold does not generalize. Of nine new independent pickup faults it warns two policy calls early on three. It also flags six of 24 safe prefixes from the same actor and two of nine matched safe-actor prefixes. There is no training load penalty. The independent128 has 111 safe lifts, four safe exact turns, nine hardware violations and no carry or contract problem. Two turns start uninterrupted upright travel on seeds 1028780962 and 1895335386, with 11.51 and 14.03 mm goalward and 1.13 and 2.03 seconds of retained hand contact. This replicates the first transition effect across new starts but misses the four-source independent curriculum threshold. The full-start safety remains insufficient for a gate.

At the r0483 midpoint stop the low learned context arm on checkpoint 0664. Fixed64 has 58 safe lifts, zero exact turns, no deficit within 5 degrees, six completed anchored transport segments from the same source and two of 12 withheld exact turns. All four stop conditions apply. Continue the older-context arm on three safe fixed turns and 8/12 withheld turns despite four distinct hardware failures. Continue expanded planar checkpoint 0640 under r0485 on six first assisted upright held goal entries lasting 0.69 to 2.27 s, with eight of 16 making 110 mm and zero same-grip touchdowns. Inspect their 191–221 mm terminal clearances and use disjoint physically sampled holds to test the remaining lowering gap.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Both Gaussian innovation and episode bias are reduced during true opposed airborne turn rows of live anchored resets. The stored conditional scale is used in the PPO likelihood and KL. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Low learned turnout contexts provide the same initial grasp as deployment and could preserve it during transport.
body.reflection: Fixed64 has 58 safe lifts and 61 rests, zero turns or safety events. No angular deficit within five degrees, six exact anchored transport cases all from one training source, and only two safe withheld turns with no grip surviving another 0.20 s. Early carries maintain eight at 60 mm, two at 110 mm and peak 161.05 mm, without held goal. Six recovered low final placements and fifteen independent supported releases. All four midpoint stop conditions hold.
