curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

held_carry_attempts.description: Assisted carry resets end on the first break in the starting grip before valid support. An early loss can initiate an independent checked carry reset with a fresh sensor seed. The monitor checks each complete action. Full starts and supported suffixes retain the ordinary deployment horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.turn_continuation: Uses the exact-window turn event. Forty percent pays immediately and the balance requires 0.20 s continuous opposed-to-held transport with 10 mm real progress and endpoint tilt at most 35 degrees.

checks.station_model: Simulation v5 has zero failures in the published station scenarios. The blocked index retains sustained torque and reports a residual drift warning.
checks.hardware_response: Contract monitor enforces each 100 Hz state and policy row. Stop, hardware, contract or nonfinite state ends the training episode. Fallen-below-table objects also terminate the training episode.
checks.reward_tolerances: 40 mm keypoints, 100 mm and 45° on palm pose, 0.44 rad median posture. The retargeted palm cue lies near 90 mm above actual contacts on this embodiment.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Continue the increasing assisted traverse of the r0421 expanded planar curriculum with matching optimizer state.
body.reflection: Fixed64 has 42 safe lifts, nine hardware events and no exact turn. Nine early assisted states make upright progress of 60 mm, eight exceed 110 mm and peak is 214.26 mm. Six maintain supported-by-hand upright goal entry for at least 0.10 s, lasting 0.69 to 2.27 s. End clearances for these grips are 191 to 221 mm and no continuous supported lowering occurs. Five recovered low final placements and fifteen independent supported releases. The held goal entry satisfies the midpoint continuation trigger.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction

domain_randomization.name: finger grip

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay

curriculum.description: Settled randomized positions and velocities only. Reward phase is allowed to skip earlier conditions in intermediate reset episodes. Deployment resets use the full 1.5 s ramp, full task criteria and 20 s horizon.

shorter_pickup.description: The grounded plug and nominal palm ramp translate together toward the same goal. The exact station ramp, contract, sensor and mechanics apply. The demonstration reference uses the shifted object start and the corresponding reached ramp pose.

held_carry_attempts.description: Assisted carry resets end on the first break in the starting grip before valid support. An early loss can initiate an independent checked carry reset with a fresh sensor seed. The monitor checks each complete action. Full starts and supported suffixes retain the ordinary deployment horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

reference.startup: Per-trial adaptation from true fixed task start and goal (0.425, −0.068, −0.2935) m.
reference.shaping: State-driven phase reference tracking with symmetric object keypoints, reachable wrist and tolerated finger posture. Phase changes on simulated physical criteria.
reference.turn_continuation: Uses the exact-window turn event. Forty percent pays immediately and the balance requires 0.20 s continuous opposed-to-held transport with 10 mm real progress and endpoint tilt at most 35 degrees.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Both Gaussian innovation and episode bias are reduced while an assisted carry or release is within the goal and held or supported. The actual conditional scale is used in PPO likelihood and KL. Full starts keep the original exploration.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: One third exploration only in late assisted held or supported goals may improve supported placement while maintaining the exact physical transition.
body.reflection: Fixed64 has zero lifts, 48 rests and zero safety events. Twelve of 16 low assisted starts touch continuously, one has a final placement after switching grip and none completes same-grip. Eleven of 24 withheld warm support cases place safely and all 24 are safe, with zero full stage credit from these assisted suffixes. The earlier seven matched finishes are absent here. Await the scheduled endpoint.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

body.text: The r0508 exact independent diagnostic finds 18 held upright goal arrivals from seven sources in 64 cases. Neutral is safe on all 18 and lowers 50 mm on four, with no continuous tabletop support. Downward settings −0.45, −0.9 and −1.35 have 12, 17 and 17 arm-collision stops while the original hold is still continuous, and zero same-grip touchdowns. No warm lowering curriculum is retained under the registered rule. Replaying the 18 identical arrival boundaries to locate the colliding geometry and plot height at first contact.

Test whether the c0280 early lower-middle limit can be avoided by rotating the approach ramp while preserving its later thumb–ring turns. Prior r0248 at +8 degrees yaw was clean on 32 targeted and 32 fresh prefixes but lost all ten repeated turns. For the new wider actor compare nominal, +6 and +8 world yaw, and ±2 degrees about world x or y, with the original start position, weights and decoder. Pair three sensor draws on each of the nine r0505 independent failure starts. For deployment screening require all 27 targeted safe, then all fresh32 prefixes safe, at least 5 of 11 repeated turns and at least 27/32 safe lifts from an independent full panel. If safety holds but turning drops, consider a separate PPO matched start-orientation study after the current shorter-distance midpoint. No altered envelope or guard.

Check an assisted grip-stability curriculum before changing training. Use the 15 distinct safe full-start exact turns from c0280 fixed and independent128 and shorter-control c0216. Continue each identical warm physical prefix after its local turn under nominal glove sliding friction and factors 1.35 and 1.70, with the same network, real motor limits and monitors. Evaluate the next 90 calls. Advance only if a scale adds at least four safe 10 mm same-grip transitions across at least three distinct physical seeds and adds at most one safety failure, or if it brings at least three safe 60 mm motions. Any adopted augmentation would be training-only and annealed to the original plant before normal evaluation.

The r0517 friction diagnostic reaches the registered criterion. Nominal, 1.35 and 1.70 give 4, 8 and 9 safe held 10 mm transitions, with zero added failures among all 45 suffixes. Four distinct sources improve already at 1.35. No setting gives a safe 60 mm traverse. Use 1.35 in a 64-minute matched PPO curriculum comparison from older-context c0280, same eight exact workers per arm, optimizer, seed 7259117 and anchored contexts. Increase friction only after the actual local turn in a restored airborne hold, through first contact loss or support. Use full factor in the first quarter and anneal to 1.0 by two thirds, leaving the original distribution for the final third. All fixed tests use nominal physics. Smoke 18 updates before full launch. Fixed assessment near 10, 30, 48 and 62 min. At 30 stop an arm if no safe full exact turn, fewer than 4 heldout exact turns, zero nominal measured 10 mm transport and no assisted held goal. To retain the variant require a nominal full-start gain with no safety issue under the task gate. Report the augmented and nominal transitions separately.

In the r0515 collision replay, every −0.90 stop is Link7_R_capsule against support_table, with all 17 still holding the plug 72.9 to 117.9 mm above the support. All 12 −0.45 stops are the same geometry. Eleven retain hand contact at the stop, correcting the earlier blanket statement. The twelfth loses contact and reaches support at the stop. The r0516 +8 degree yaw start is safe on the targeted27 and fresh32, validates at 0.600 ms p99 and lifts all eleven repeated turning starts, but reproduces zero turns. Only 12/32 fresh lifts. Reject the c0280 orientation change, while documenting the geometry dependence.

Four arm-collision stops and a loaded index lateral limit occur only in nominal cold carry and release episodes. The matched 64-minute control and 1.35-to-1.0 variant launch at 20:06 UTC on CUDA3 and CUDA2 with eight exact CPU workers apiece. The c2392 reduced-noise endpoint in r0520 closes that arm with zero full lifts, two same-grip low assisted placements and 14/24 exact withheld support placements with rest. No change retained.

Apply the r0487 shorter-pickup midpoint rules at c0616. Stop the shifted-pregrasp arm with zero full exact turns, one qualifying turn across 24 shifted starts and no shifted carry. It lifts safely on 51 of 64 full starts. Continue the unchanged-start control with 52 safe full lifts, 13 exact turns, 56 rests and three separate hardware failures. All 13 turn attempts lose the original grasp or make less than 10 mm of held motion. The control gives seven safe shifted turns across 24 and no carry. Its independent nominal128 evaluation is underway. Neither package enters the task gate.

body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.

Continue under the fixed decision rule.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw

held_carry_attempts.description: Assisted carry resets end on the first break in the starting grip before valid support. An early loss can initiate an independent checked carry reset with a fresh sensor seed. The monitor checks each complete action. Full starts and supported suffixes retain the ordinary deployment horizon.

live_pickup.description: A prior PPO checkpoint runs a short monitored deployment prefix. Training begins in the resulting opposed grasp with its live actuator, sensor and causal actor history. Prefix actions never enter optimizer batches. Other reset modes retain their original fractions. Preserve the true lift and turn-window anchor from the prefix. Score subsequent turns using the ordinary deployment reward. These remain assisted episodes in the curves. An anchored suffix ends if it loses the physical grip that connected it to the starting turn. Full starts run the deployment horizon and can retry. Each monitor-checked prefix is saved after its first draw per worker. Repeat draws restore its full physics, actuator, sensor, contract and reward state.

body.text: The c0640 independent arrival geometry has median 192.0 mm of plug clearance, plug 14.1 mm below the measured wrist and 38.7 degrees wrist mismatch to reconstructed near-goal frame 190. At seventeen Link7–table stops during direct lowering, median plug clearance is 97.7 mm, plug center is 11.5 mm above the wrist and mismatch is 46.4 degrees. In 24 complete physical feasibility replays, median held arrival clearance is 54.5 mm, the plug is 49.1 mm below the wrist, and wrist reference mismatch is 20.2 degrees with a maximum 23.7. Maximum upright same-grip carry clearance across those witnesses is 98.54 mm. Test whether allowing the held wrist to reorient toward the demonstrated approach before a small descent prevents the collision. Keep exact history and plant, with matched neutral and descent-only controls. The intervention is diagnostic and cannot enter the exported policy. Require at least four new safe 50 mm descents across at least three sources and at least two continuous touches before using this held boundary for a continuation curriculum.

The nominal-start shorter-pickup control c0616 repeats on independent128 with 100 safe lifts, 17 safe exact turns, 104 rests, 14 physical violations and no carry or placement. `None` of the 17 turned grips earns a measured 10 mm hold toward the goal, consistent with the 13 earlier fixed starts. No gate. Expanded planar checkpoint 1072 increases the assisted held goal count to seven of 16 and safe upright progress to 238.11 mm, but stays 196 to 220 mm clear at the end of those holds. Continue exact checks until the planned endpoints.

The 100 mm held-height deadband lies above the maximum upright carry clearance of all 24 feasible starts. Add a signed actual-object clearance penalty above that band during uninterrupted carry or lowering, capped at 3.2 and with no refund on a drop. This differs from the earlier in-goal clearance-only approach because it acts throughout transport. The exact three feasible preflight witnesses keep every bonus and receive zero new loss, static holds receive zero, random commands stay negative, and all six high c0640 held arrivals accrue 2.90 to 3.20 loss on unchanged physical traces. Plan a 68-minute matched PPO reward comparison from c1072 after the current two runs end. Both resume its critic and Adam at LR .00010 and use the original exact reset mix and nominal physics. The sole matched reward difference is the carry-height term. Fixed ages 10, 29, 47 and 66 min. At midpoint stop an arm if it has fewer than four of 16 safe upright held goal entries, zero same-grip touchdown and no safe exact full turn. To keep the change require at least four new safe held entries 100 mm or lower or two continuous supported set-downs on independent starts, and a qualifying task gate before selection.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.

body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Continue the wider planar actor on exact checked early carry contexts while measuring the carried goal entry and descent.
body.reflection: Fixed64 has 44 safe lifts, 51 rests, four hardware events and no exact turn. Nine of 16 early starts carry 110 mm upright, peak 238.11 mm. Seven hold upright in goal for at least 0.10 s across six physical sources, with clearance still 196–220 mm and no continuous tabletop contact. Recovered low placements 11 of 16 and distinct supported release 15 of 16. The ascending held transport still fails to become a set-down.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.text: The r0525 wrist preparation test recovers the lowering motion. Across all 18 matched arrivals, gain 1.2 toward frame 190 for 18 calls before a −0.45 descent is safe on all 18 and lowers every plug at least 50 mm. Neutral is safe on all 18 but lowers only four. Direct descent and gain 0.65 each have 12 arm collisions and four safe descents. Only one gain-1.2 case reaches continuous in-goal upright support and none finishes with that grip. One other case is placed and rested after a contact gap. The two-contact adoption threshold is unmet. Check 96 explicitly disjoint reset indices at nominal and the stronger preparation plus −0.45 or −0.60 descent. Advance only if at least two fresh continuous upright in-goal touchdowns come from two distinct physical sources, with no more than two added safety events versus neutral and at least four added 50 mm descents across three sources. No action changes are retained.

The 30 full exact c0616 turns use thumb–middle and produce no 10 mm held transport. The 11 c0280 turns use thumb–ring and four produce held transport. Two tuning-slate physical starts turn with both. Test diversity before changing the curriculum. Collect 768 fresh full-window exact c0280 starts under the same package and nominal plant using sample seed 77248483. Retain only safe true full-turn physical traces and admissible live approaching-turn boundaries. The prior independent128 missed its four-source transport threshold and remains unchanged. Advance this separate larger cohort only if at least 20 distinct safe starts furnish eligible boundaries and at least eight fresh exact turns move 10 mm under the same grip. Withhold one quarter of physical sources before new training, preserving disjoint seeds and restored sensor history. No teacher actions or altered suffixes.

The disjoint wrist diagnosis meets the registered physical threshold. Of 96 new reset indices, 21 arrive in a held upright goal. Neutral safely lowers 50 mm on seven and gives no continuous support. With the same high-gain wrist preparation and −0.45 descent all 21 are safe and all lower 50 mm, four touch continuously across two physical sources, and one also finishes placed and rested. The −0.60 setting gives four safe touches and one additional arm collision. These are assisted diagnostic outcomes. Collect physical pose and velocity snapshots only from the earlier panel under the −0.45 preparation, withholding the two physical support sources from the new bank and all normal deployment starts. Check six exact passive hold calls. Require 24 retained states from at least five sources, including six at 35 mm or lower across three sources, before testing a state-only lowering reset curriculum. No diagnostic commands, history, action labels or weights enter PPO.

The first r0532 cold-reset qualification finds only six eligible upright in-goal snapshots across three physical sources, despite all 17 earlier diagnostic cases lowering by 50 mm. All six pass the six-call physical hold unchanged. Four are at or below 35 mm across three sources. This misses the 24-state, five-source and six-low adoption thresholds. Use one wider prospective physical collection with new indices and sensing, adding intermediate clearance bands and keeping both support sources excluded. Do not train unless the combined checked bank meets the original thresholds.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: release_progress

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.text: The new c0240 nominal held turn has a cross-table error. Four of the full-start turned grips reach x above 520 mm while carrying left only as far as 51 mm in y. All 24 exact feasible traces remain below x 498.38 mm after their turns, with median maximum x 477.45 mm and median +325.92 mm y travel. The c0240 post-turn y target margins are typically within ±0.4 mm, so simply increasing the existing action envelope has no direct evidence. Preflight a signed physical cross-track loss outside the x goal interval plus 20 mm tolerance, only after the turn and while the same grip is held. Require zero new penalty on the three complete reference witnesses and a peak penalty of at least 1.0 on three of the four problematic held carries before considering training. Existing full rewards, criteria and hardware limits stay fixed.

The c1688 independent panel has five distinct full-start same-grip 10 mm transitions, with 10.21–25.11 mm of real travel and 0.30–0.80 s of continued thumb–ring hold. Keep its hardware failure in the diagnosis and screen ramp changes separately. Prepare a training-only post-turn context preflight from the five safe exact trajectories, with physical prefix history restored and no prefix actions in optimization. The cross-track preflight also meets r0544. All three complete witnesses retain all bonuses and receive zero new penalty, holds stay zero and random negative. Peak loss is 1.50–1.65 on all four problematic objective carries. Plan a later 68-minute matched exact PPO reward comparison, using c0240 if its fresh full panel yields at least four true 10 mm transitions and c1688 otherwise. Use identical saved optimizer states, seed, ordinary friction and LR .00010 in both arms. Judge carried x and y, safety, exact turning and held goal. Predeclare slots and fixed checks before launch.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation. The live contract monitor uses compiled singleton FK. Its full checks run at the ordinary cadence. Sixteen paired audits have identical decisions and logged arrays.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. The previous critic and optimizer states resume from the same checkpoint. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. The same backtracking also checks a tighter mean Gaussian KL on true deployment transitions before the first measured lift. The condition only selects which training samples constrain the update. The exported actor uses ordinary v3 history. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic. Multiply the clipped actor surrogate of verified held, opposed turn states by 6 relative to other on-policy samples, then normalize all weights by their rollout mean. The critic loss and analytic KL remain unweighted.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: The wider-planar continuation aims to turn early assisted carry movement into an upright held arrival and a supported set-down.
body.reflection: Fixed64 gives 53 safe lifts, 45 rests, one hardware violation and no exact later stage. Seven early assisted carries exceed 110 mm and the peak is 239.24 mm. Six keep the plug upright in the goal for 1.63–2.41 s while 199–217 mm above support. Zero continuous touchdowns, fourteen recovered low ends and fifteen separately supported releases. The endpoint does not connect the carry to a placement. Final training file c1680. The separate height-band comparison uses the earlier c1072 parent.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed movement toward a blades-up relative turn from the best sampled high-tilt starting pose in the same opposed grip. The original directional score applies to assisted starts.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: Forty percent of the deployment turn bonus pays at qualification. The balance pays only after a continuous held transition lasting 0.20 s, at most 35 degrees blade tilt and 10 mm real planar progress toward the goal. An interruption discards the unpaid part. Assisted reset credit is unchanged.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

body.text: The c0240 full-start transport improvement does not replicate. Its independent128 gives 99 safe lifts, three exact turns, 59 rests, fifteen other violations and no 10 mm transport. Use c1688 as the planned cross-track parent and warm-context diagnostic source. The checked 59 cold lowering states remain diagnostic. Both c1072 and c2392 produce zero safe continuous tabletop support under both nominal mean and standard 0.12 exploration. Each mean has zero safety events and exploratory runs have one and two respectively. The r0541 training criterion is unmet. The c1688 fine grid has only two changes clear all targeted32, +4 degrees yaw and +4 mm height. Yaw repeats one of twelve true turns with all lifts and rests, so reject it. Assess the height variant under the same prospective gate prerequisites.

Predeclare r0545 cross-track comparison from nominal c1688 for 68 minutes, eight workers per arm, matched seed 4812269, saved critic and Adam, LR .00010, unchanged exact pre-turn reset, ordinary friction and ordinary v3 action transform. The sole arm difference is the physical held x-band term. Check near 10, 29, 47 and 66 minutes, including fixed full64, withheld anchored turns and early and low carries. At midpoint stop an arm for zero safe full exact turn, no safe held goal, fewer than two safe nominal 10 mm anchored transports from distinct sources and fewer than four local angular deficits within five degrees. Keep only a gate-qualified improvement. First run the 14-update smoke. Both fixed ramp-only variants of c1688 fail turn retention and will not be gated. The +4 mm variant repeats two of twelve safe exact turns while preserving all twelve lifts and rests.

Extract a matched before-turn and after-turn context set from the same five fresh c1688 full-start transport witnesses. Each has three physical call boundaries on each side, all from its unchanged nominal rollout. The after-turn reset must restore the actual completed finger turn, opposed airborne grip, at least 10 mm clearance and at most 35 degrees tilt. Check bit-exact cached replay against fresh prefix playback. Before any continuation training, require at least twelve accepted post-turn boundaries across all five sources and at least six safe nominal 10 mm transitions measured from the restored boundary across at least three sources. Run identical normal and one-third exploratory noise as secondary evidence. The actor receives causal history only and the optimizer receives no prefix actions.

The first held cross-track PPO smoke stopped before simulation because the new reward module omitted its term index. The offline scoring preflight had already passed because it uses the term names. Add the exact index and rerun the same 14-update smoke. The queued launcher still requires a completed smoke checkpoint before starting either long run.
